title: Senior Product Manager - Fleet and Lifecycle Management
descriptionHtml:
Datadog is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help lead the evolution of our fleet and lifecycle management capability, the product surface that gives customers visibility into, and control over, the observability software running across their infrastructure.

This capability manages the deployment lifecycle for core observability agents and OpenTelemetry collectors running on customer hosts and containers. The Senior PM will expand the scope of fleet capability to additional Datadog software components, making it the single place customers go to see everything running in their environment, at any version, in any deployment model, and to manage it remotely and safely at scale, for both human operators and, increasingly, AI agents acting on their behalf.

This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role. You'll partner with multiple engineering teams and be responsible for defining and delivering a coherent, unified fleet experience across UI, API, and MCP for customers.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do

  • Own and evolve the product vision and roadmap for a unified fleet and lifecycle management capability spanning multiple product lines and deployment models.
  • Define what "managed" means for each new software component as it's brought into fleet, balancing consistency of experience with the realities of each component's operational model.
  • Drive a phased expansion plan, sequencing new components into fleet based on customer value, technical complexity, and dependency readiness.
  • Partner closely with engineering leads across several teams to align on shared architecture principles to support disparate software components.
  • Represent the voice of the customer for a capability that must work equally well for human operators using a UI and for AI agents/automated tooling operating programmatically.
  • Build the business case, define success metrics, and communicate roadmap and trade-offs to engineering, design, sales, and executive stakeholders.
  • Stay closely connected to customers and design partners to validate priorities and de-risk major roadmap bets.

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex, technical, cross-product capability.
  • Experience shipping infrastructure, DevOps, IT operations, or observability/monitoring products, ideally involving fleet management, configuration management, or software lifecycle/deployment tooling.
  • Demonstrated ability to build product direction across multiple engineering teams with differing priorities, and to drive alignment without direct authority.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, defining scope and sequencing capabilities that deliver customer value incrementally.
  • Strong technical fluency; you don't need to write code, but you should be comfortable discussing architecture trade-offs with engineers.
  • Experience designing products for emerging AI-agent/automation use cases is a strong plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you can distill a sprawling, multi-team initiative into a clear narrative for different audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Kubernetes-based deployment models and operator patterns.
  • Experience with remote configuration or feature-flagging infrastructure at scale.
  • Familiarity with BYOC (bring-your-own-cloud) or customer-hosted software deployment models.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)
  • Free, global Spring Health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+
  • Competitive global benefits and giving programs

title: Indirect Tax Manager
descriptionHtml:
Datadog is seeking an Indirect Tax Manager to oversee U.S. sales and use tax compliance, support related audits, and coordinate VAT/GST obligations across our global entity portfolio. You will partner with external advisors and cross-functional teams to address evolving indirect tax requirements, strengthen controls, and embed tax considerations into business systems and processes. This role offers the opportunity to manage complex, multi-jurisdictional workstreams while helping scale a global indirect tax function. You will also expand your expertise across tax technology, e-invoicing, compliance operations, and international tax matters as Datadog continues to grow.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Review U.S. multi-state sales and use tax filings prepared by the team, ensuring accuracy and alignment with established nexus and taxability positions
  • Support U.S. sales and use tax audits, notices, and inquiries by coordinating documentation, technical analysis, external advisors, and communications with tax authorities
  • Coordinate VAT/GST compliance and recovery activities across Datadog’s international entity portfolio, partnering with advisors across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM
  • Monitor changes in nexus, taxability, VAT/GST, e-invoicing, and e-reporting requirements, and communicate relevant impacts to internal stakeholders
  • Partner with Accounting, Revenue, Legal, Procurement, and Engineering to incorporate indirect tax requirements into billing systems, ERP configurations, controls, and new market or product initiatives
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, audit-readiness materials, workstream tracking, and SOX-aligned controls that support a scalable indirect tax function

Who You Are:

  • Experienced in progressive indirect tax roles within public accounting, an in-house tax function, or a combination of both
  • Knowledgeable in U.S. multi-state sales and use tax, including nexus analysis, taxability, compliance, and audit support
  • Familiar with international VAT/GST regimes and experienced coordinating compliance across multiple jurisdictions and external advisors
  • Experienced using tax determination and ERP systems; experience with Avalara and NetSuite is preferred
  • Able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, analyze detailed financial information, and maintain accuracy in a fast-moving environment
  • A clear communicator who can translate technical indirect tax matters for Finance, Legal, and business stakeholders; experience with tax automation, AI-enabled process improvements, SOX environments, or relevant professional certifications is a plus

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

  • Expand your expertise across U.S. sales and use tax and international VAT/GST matters
  • Gain experience supporting a global, multi-entity tax function in a growing technology business
  • Partner with teams across Finance, Legal, Procurement, Revenue, and Engineering
  • Develop practical experience with tax technology, automation, e-invoicing, and systems implementation
  • Strengthen your capabilities in audit management, process design, internal controls, and cross-functional program delivery
  • Contribute to the development of scalable processes and operating practices for a global indirect tax organization

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

title: Senior Product Manager - Bits Agent Builder
descriptionHtml:
As the Senior Product Manager for the Actions & Automations team, you will own the ecosystem that enables customers, partners, and Datadog teams to build, deploy, and operate AI agents on Datadog. You will drive the strategy and execution for the platform capabilities, developer experience, integrations, and extensibility model that make Datadog the best place to build agents that understand and act on production systems.

Modern engineering organizations are entering a new era where software is not only monitored and operated by humans, but increasingly by AI-powered agents. As agentic workflows reshape how teams build, operate, secure, and troubleshoot systems, customers need a platform for creating specialized agents, connecting them to business and engineering systems, governing their behavior, and extending them to solve unique organizational problems. You will define and build the ecosystem that makes this possible.

Agent Builder sits at the intersection of Datadog's products, AI capabilities, and ecosystem strategy. You will have the opportunity to work across the breadth of the Datadog platform, partner with teams throughout the company, and help establish Datadog as the foundation for operational AI.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture, the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Datadog's Agent Builder platform and ecosystem.
  • Own the core platform capabilities that enable customers and partners to create, customize, deploy, and manage AI agents.
  • Drive the extensibility model for agents, including integrations, tools, actions, context sources, APIs, SDKs, and developer workflows.
  • Shape how agents perform actions across Datadog products and third-party systems.
  • Partner closely with AI, platform, infrastructure, and product teams across Datadog to establish common agent architecture patterns and platform standards.
  • Develop a deep understanding of emerging agent frameworks, orchestration patterns, evaluation techniques, governance models, and operational best practices.
  • Be equally comfortable discussing LLM architectures, tool-calling systems, evaluation frameworks, and developer platforms with engineering teams as you are working directly with customers to understand their needs and workflows.
  • Evangelize Datadog's vision for operational AI through customer engagements, conferences, blogs, industry events, and thought leadership.
  • Work with world-class Product and Engineering teams to develop and communicate roadmaps that inspire our teams' best work and deliver meaningful customer value.
  • Support and empower Sales, Account Management, Marketing, and Solutions teams to drive adoption and customer success.
  • Contribute to a culture of learning and collaboration across the department and broader organization.
  • Raise the bar in product management.

Who You Are:

  • An experienced Product Manager, ideally at a SaaS, infrastructure, platform, developer tools, or AI company.
  • You have a strong technical background and can engage deeply on topics such as AI systems, APIs, platform architecture, developer tooling, distributed systems, and integration patterns.
  • You have experience building platforms or ecosystems that enable other developers, teams, or products to create value.
  • You are excited by the opportunities and challenges of AI agents and have a strong point of view on how agentic systems will transform software development and operations.
  • You have sharp product intuition and can navigate ambiguity, making sound prioritization decisions in fast-moving technology landscapes.
  • You are naturally collaborative and thrive in environments where success depends on aligning many teams around a shared vision.
  • You have excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to present and defend ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You have a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • You are customer-minded with a high quality standard for the products you build.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Partner Solutions Architect (Pan-EMEA GSI)
descriptionHtml:
The Team:

We are Datadog's in-house product experts. The technical solutions team enables Datadog's worldwide growth by educating potential clients and ensuring that existing customers are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, presentations, technical evaluations, and ongoing support. Technical solutions is a growing global team that collaborates constantly to share knowledge and continuously advance our technical skillset.

The Opportunity:

The Partner Solution Architect (PSA) is a Datadog expert who will work closely with Datadog’s Director, Adoption Services, and is aligned to our Channels & Alliances business segment. The PSA is responsible for supporting a variety of technical initiatives and activities for our partners (for example: cloud migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation). They are accountable for the outcome of these initiatives, and frequently collaborate with both Datadog and Partner resources to drive success. The PSA is a trusted technical advisor for our Partner channel.

You Will:

  • Ensure the successful onboarding, training, enablement, and certification of partner technical resources;
  • Participate in periodic joint business planning and review sessions to ensure direct alignment between Datadog and Partner technical teams;
  • Collaborate internally to support Partner technical initiatives such as end-customer demonstrations and proofs of value; partner team enablement workshops; assessment, advice, and coaching on lead practices;
  • Advocate on behalf of Partners’ technical concerns (use cases, feature requests, support issues, e.g.) with Datadog internal teams and personnel, helping to bring those concerns to resolution;
  • Analyze and understand Partner service offerings on a regular basis and provide recommendations to enhance the value of those services through greater or improved adoption of Datadog features and capabilities;
  • Collaborate with Datadog’s product management, engineering and technical services teams to help identify and prioritize new features and capabilities;
  • Continuously help curate and evolve lead/best practices for Datadog platform adoption and success.

You Are:

  • Possess a solid technical grounding with hands-on experience of IT Development and/or Operations;
  • A demonstrable track-record and never-ending passion for learning;
  • A self-starter, tech-savvy professional with solid business acumen; ability to articulate Datadog value from server room to boardroom;
  • Confident presentation skills;
  • Must be a current EU resident
  • Desired hands-on experience in two or more of the following areas:
    • Observability: Datadog, Splunk, AppD, New Relic or Dynatrace
    • Public Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, or Alibaba
    • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Cloud Foundry
    • Dev/Scripting: Python, Javascript, Ruby, Perl, PHP, Go
    • Config Mgmt: Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef
    • CI / CD: Jenkins, Gitlab

Bonus Points:

  • Previous experience working in a technical role for or supporting channel partners (Systems Integrators, Managed Services Providers, e.g.);
  • Previous experience using Datadog and/or other cloud monitoring tools (APM, Infrastructure, Logs, Synthetics, NPM);
  • Previous experience with root-cause-analysis, troubleshooting, debugging

  • Generous and competitive global and US benefits

title: Manager I, Engineering - Security Libraries
descriptionHtml:
The Security Libraries team owns the customer-side integrations behind Datadog’s run-time security products — App & API Protection, Workload Protection, and Code Security — shipping and maintaining security capabilities across seven open-source language libraries (.NET, Java, Go, Node.js, Python, Ruby, PHP) and a set of HTTP proxy integrations (Envoy, NGINX, and HAProxy), running inside thousands of production clusters worldwide.

Recent work spans exploit prevention (RASP), WAF detections, API Security, code security (IAST and SCA), and AI-assisted onboarding. As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead part of this polyglot team, setting the technical bar and team culture while driving the pace at which new detections and AI-assisted capabilities reach customers. This is a hands-on role: you’ll balance people leadership, product and roadmap ownership, and the operational health of code that runs in production at massive scale, with room to grow into more of Datadog’s security portfolio over time.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead, grow, and develop a team of roughly 4-8 library engineers — coaching, giving direct feedback, and empowering senior ICs as technical leaders
  • Own team delivery and productivity: planning, milestones, reviews, and the on-call rotation
  • Set product direction with Product Management and balance priorities across App & API Protection, Workload Protection, and Code Security
  • Stay technically close to the work — apply strong technical judgment, contribute code where it matters most, and keep quality and architecture high
  • Build strong relationships and drive alignment across the language teams and product, backend, and frontend partners
  • Shape team identity and culture, and own accountability when problems occur

Who You Are:

  • Experience managing a team of engineers — setting direction with Product Managers, owning a backlog, and running delivery
  • A senior software-engineering background with strong technical judgment
  • A track record developing people: coaching, direct feedback, and helping engineers, both senior and struggling, grow
  • Strong cross-team communication, comfortable driving alignment across many stakeholders
  • Experience building libraries, SDKs, developer tooling, or systems/run-time software
  • Pragmatic product-engineering experience — you’ve worked with Product Managers and weighed technical trade-offs against customer impact

Nice to Have:

  • An application security background (WAF, RASP, IAST/SCA) or adjacent observability/APM experience
  • Hands-on experience with one of our languages (.NET, Java, Go, Node.js, Python, Ruby, PHP) or open-source stewardship
  • Experience leading distributed or multi-language teams across many stakeholders

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

title: Technical Escalations Engineer II (Revenue and Cost Management) - APJ
descriptionHtml:
As Datadog’s in-house product experts, the Technical Escalation Engineering (TEE) team plays a critical role in driving our global success. We enable our customers, from the world’s most innovative startups to the largest enterprises.

Through deep technical expertise, relentless problem-solving, and exceptional customer engagement, we educate, guide, and troubleshoot, delivering high-impact solutions that shape the customer experience. Whether through hands-on technical call, in-depth fact findings meeting, or complex investigations, we set the gold standard for technical excellence and customer advocacy.

As part of our TEE team, you’ll tackle the most challenging technical problems, collaborate directly with Engineering and Product to refine and evolve our platform, and mentor teams worldwide, elevating the technical bar at every level.

As part of the Technical Escalation Engineering (TEE) team, you’ll operate at the heart of Datadog’s ecosystem, working at the intersection of Technical Solutions, Engineering, Product, and our Customers. Every challenge you take on will directly impact the performance, scalability, and success of both our clients and our platform. You’ll be in an environment that moves fast, challenges you daily, and rewards curiosity, ownership, and technical excellence.

This is your chance to shape the future of observability and security, driving innovation, mentoring teams, and influencing product direction while witnessing your expertise make an immediate and lasting impact. 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 

What You’ll Do:

  • Become the expert on usage metering, revenue-impacting behavior, and Cloud Cost Management within Technical Solutions, helping customers optimize usage and control spend across all Datadog product lines.
  • Lead escalations involving unexpected usage, missing metering data, usage spikes, billing anomalies, unclear attribution, or limits enforcement (e.g., quotas, plans, exclusions, overages).
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Finance to escalate bugs, align on expected behavior, improve usage visibility, and drive transparency and fairness in billing and usage tracking.
  • Build internal guides, tooling, diagnostics, and playbooks — plus customer-facing content — that help teams confidently handle billing- and revenue-related questions and forecast, reduce, and monitor observability costs.
  • Enable the global Solutions team by running training sessions and building scalable resources that empower others to support usage, billing, and cost-related conversations effectively.
  • Act as a voice of the customer, surfacing feedback and patterns to help shape the roadmap for usage visibility, billing transparency, and cost management.

Who You Are:

  • Curious and detail-oriented when it comes to how usage is measured, attributed, and billed across products — including usage limits, overages, metering discrepancies, plan entitlements, and customer contract constraints.
  • Passionate about helping customers optimize their cloud footprint, with a strong grasp of cloud cost drivers, usage attribution, and spend analysis.
  • Familiar with cloud billing models (AWS, Azure, GCP) — usage types, tags, accounts/projects — and how that data is exposed via APIs and billing exports.
  • Comfortable digging into data retention, high-cardinality signals, metric volume, log ingestion, and overage prevention, and able to translate telemetry volume into cost impact.
  • Familiar with APIs, product usage metrics, tagging strategies, and the nuances of account-level configurations and multi-org setups.
  • Experienced working across technical and business boundaries — equally comfortable with backend telemetry pipelines and customer-facing impact and urgency.
  • Analytical and precise, able to communicate usage and cost impact clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity, data anomalies, and edge cases, and committed to finding root causes that drive customer trust.

  • Familiarity with Datadog, integrations ecosystem, or similar observability platforms is a strong plus.

title: Director, Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Datadog's Tel Aviv engineering site builds across some of our fastest-moving product areas — from Product Analytics, to Universal Service Monitoring, to Security Monitoring, to the Software Delivery tools that help engineers everywhere ship and operate software safely. It's a site with real engineering depth, and we're investing in the on-site senior leadership to match it.

We are looking for a Director of Engineering, based in Tel Aviv, to lead a multi-team engineering organization in one of these areas, and help shape the site as it grows. In this role, you will partner closely with product managers and with engineering leaders across Tel Aviv, Paris, and the US to shape the roadmap; grow and develop the team to match the business needs; raise the bar on engineering practices and craft; and play a central role in building the culture of a site we're investing in for the long term.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture — the relationships it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. This role is based in our Tel Aviv office, where being present on site is central to anchoring and growing the team.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage and grow a team of talented engineers, making sure they deliver high-quality, timely work and that they're happy, motivated, and developing in their careers
  • Hire and develop senior talent, engineers and managers alike, raising the seniority bar on site as we scale
  • Grow and develop a team of engineering managers — coaching them as leaders and building the layer of leadership the site needs as it scales
  • Partner with product managers and designers to shape the future of the product
  • Work with engineering leaders in Tel Aviv, Europe, and the US to deliver cross-cutting projects across a multi-hub organization
  • Help shape the future of the Tel Aviv site and the broader engineering organization

Who You Are:

  • You are a product-building leader with real product sense, comfortable working hand in hand with product and design to decide what to build, not just how to build it
  • You came up through engineering and can earn the trust of senior engineers in a fast conversation; you favor breadth and adaptability, and you can ramp quickly into a technical domain you didn't start in
  • You integrate AI into how you lead and how your teams build, treating AI-first thinking as core engineering practice rather than a feature bolted onto the product
  • You have hired, grown, and developed engineering teams, creating long-term plans for people's growth and motivation
  • You have managed managers — you've hired, coached, and developed engineering managers, and led an organization with multiple layers of leadership beneath you
  • You have operated in multi-geography companies at scale, and you can read and work effectively across different sites and company cultures
  • You want to be the senior engineering leader on the ground in Tel Aviv — setting the technical and cultural bar, and building a site rather than inheriting a finished one
  • You have a customer-focused mindset and a relentless drive to build products that address real needs
  • You bring real depth in at least one of our areas — web and product analytics, agentic or developer-experience products, low-level systems and networking, or security engineering

title: Engineering Manager I, Commercial Audit
descriptionHtml:
As the Engineering Manager for Commercial Audit, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for scaling Datadog’s security and compliance posture through automation, tooling, and engineering excellence. Our GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) function is a critical partner to the broader Security and Engineering organizations, ensuring that Datadog not only meets rigorous global regulatory standards but does so in a way that is efficient, scalable, and integrated into our cloud-native infrastructure. You will manage a team of engineers and analysts who are transitioning to a GRC engineering direction to treat compliance as a software problem, leveraging AI, custom tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native services to turn complex regulatory requirements into actionable, automated controls.

You will lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Datadog’s Commercial Audit initiatives. This is a high-impact leadership role where you will grow a team of engineers and analysts responsible for directly maintaining our compliance programs and related audits (e.g., SOC2, PCI, HIPAA, ISO) while looking to improve efficiency and effectiveness through platforms and tooling. You will act as a bridge between technical engineering, legal, and compliance, enabling the organization to move fast while maintaining a secure and compliant environment. You will champion a culture of "compliance-as-code," identifying opportunities to automate evidence collection, streamline control testing, and reduce manual toil for both your team and our partner engineering teams.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Datadog’s commercial security compliance efforts, shifting from manual audit processes to automated, scalable platforms and methodologies.
  • Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of engineers and analysts, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Partner within Information Security to operationalize a common control framework that integrates seamlessly into Datadog’s architecture and processes.
  • Drive the development of internal tooling to automate evidence collection and dashboarding, reducing operational friction across the organization.
  • Define and track program metrics: control coverage, audit efficiency, and automation adoption
  • Collaborate with broader internal engineering teams to embed compliance-by-design into our infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native service adoption.

Who You Are:

  • You build strong, trusted relationships across engineering, legal, product, and executive stakeholders. You remain calm under pressure, navigate disagreement with diplomacy, and consistently bring people to alignment without creating unnecessary friction.
  • You are a steady, low-ego leader who earns trust through consistency, diplomacy, and sound judgment. You can navigate difficult conversations, resolve conflict constructively, and maintain strong working relationships across diverse teams.
  • You have experience leading or managing teams in security engineering, GRC, or risk management with a focus on leveraging AI to build automation and tooling for transitioning to a GRC engineering approach.
  • Strong technical background with the ability to review code (Python, Go), interpret architecture diagrams, and understand infrastructure (Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Azure).
  • Deep understanding of the modern compliance landscape (e.g., HIPAA, SOC2, PCI, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) and experience implementing them at scale in cloud-native environments.
  • You are a clear communicator who can translate complex technical or regulatory requirements into "plain language" for engineers, leadership, and external auditors alike.
  • You possess a systems-thinking mindset—you look for upstream root causes and downstream impacts rather than solving problems in isolation.
  • Experience in a SaaS or cloud infrastructure company where security scale and complexity are first-order challenges.
  • Experienced people leader with a focus on mentorship, team growth, and inclusion. You know how to build trust and alignment across diverse teams.
  • You operate with both rigor and pragmatism. You know when to build a bespoke engineering solution and when to leverage existing platforms or processes.

Nice to Haves:

  • Prior experience working as an auditor (e.g., QSA) or directly facilitating audits, with the ability to negotiate scope and timelines effectively.

title: Senior Staff Product Designer, Design Lab
descriptionHtml:
Datadog is entering a new chapter in how our product looks, feels, and operates. Our Design Lab is defining a new visual direction for the platform, and we’re looking for a Senior Staff Visual Product Designer to help turn that direction into a coherent product experience.

Datadog is dense, technical, and used by people working through complex problems—often under real pressure. The challenge is not simply applying a new aesthetic. It is rethinking hierarchy, layout, navigation, interaction, and product patterns so the experience becomes clearer, more cohesive, and more expressive without losing the power our users rely on.

This is a hands-on product design leadership role for someone who combines strong visual judgment with deep product and systems thinking. You’ll work alongside visual designers, motion designers, product designers, Design Systems, and Engineering to ensure the new direction changes how Datadog works—not just how it looks.

What You'll Do

  • Co-develop Datadog’s next visual direction by applying and stress-testing it across representative product journeys.
  • Translate visual principles into concrete decisions about hierarchy, layout, navigation, information architecture, interaction, and behavior.
  • Use visual language to clarify complex, data-dense experiences — hierarchy, density, and attention.
  • Hold the visual quality bar across work you don't own, and align teams around it.
  • Prototype, test, and refine new patterns before they become systemized.
  • Partner deeply with Product Design, Design Systems, and engineering to turn successful concepts into durable system guidance and implementation.
  • Create clear artifacts, pilots, and narratives that help teams adopt the direction and raise the product quality bar.
  • Influence stakeholders across design, engineering, product, and executive partners.

You will report directly to the Design Director and work as part of a small, focused team defining the future state before it scales across hundreds of designers and engineers.

Who You Are

  • You have 12+ years of experience in product and/or visual design.
  • Your craft is elevated, and you can execute it yourself at a high bar.
  • You're product-native. You understand how visual design and product design act on each other in practice.
  • You use visual language to clarify an experience, and you can say why a decision improves it.
  • You think in information architecture, hierarchy, and holistic system work.
  • You've taken a concept and turned it into patterns that scaled across a real product.
  • You're comfortable operating in ambiguity and in large, complex organizations.
  • Your portfolio demonstrates shipped product surfaces with exceptional visual quality.
  • You are a persuasive collaborator who can make recommendations and align designers, engineers, product partners, and executives.

Why This Role Matters

DRUIDS powers every Datadog experience. The decisions made in this role will shape how millions of interactions feel across web, mobile, and emerging AI-driven surfaces. This is an opportunity to bring a new visual direction into a complex, engineering-forward platform and raise the craft bar across the organization.

title: Developer Engagement Lead
descriptionHtml:
Developer Engagement Lead

Reports to: Head of Developer Growth · New York, NY

NOTE: This is not a traditional social media or community management role. It’s a developer growth role that sits within the Product org.

Developers are already talking about Datadog - on Reddit, Discord, Hacker News, GitHub, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, forums, and places we probably haven’t found yet.

We’re hiring a Developer Engagement Lead to make sure we’re part of those conversations.

You’ll own how Datadog listens, responds, and participates across developer channels. That means running our existing developer social accounts, building our presence in new communities, creating the monitoring and response systems that help us find relevant conversations quickly, and connecting developers with the right people inside Datadog.

This is a builder role. We’re not looking for someone to manage a content calendar or simply moderate a community. We want someone who can build the operating model for developer engagement at scale.

What you'll own

  • Build our developer listening and engagement system. Create the tooling and workflows to monitor conversations about Datadog, our products, our competitors, and the problems developers are trying to solve across Reddit, Hacker News, Discord, GitHub, X, LinkedIn, Stack Overflow, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
  • Turn monitoring into action. Build a process for identifying conversations worth joining, determining when Datadog should respond, and routing questions or feedback to the right engineer, PM, DevRel, support, or product expert.
  • Own our developer channels. Run @datadogdevs on X and Datadog Developers on LinkedIn, including publishing, engagement, replies, and experimentation.
  • Expand where Datadog participates. Establish and grow our presence in places where developers already spend time. That may include launching Discord, creating a stronger Reddit strategy, building participation models for Hacker News or GitHub, or identifying entirely new channels.
  • Make Datadog more responsive. Define response guidelines, escalation paths, ownership models, and expectations so developer conversations don’t disappear into screenshots and Slack threads.
  • Participate directly. Know when to respond as Datadog, when to pull in an expert, when an engineer should answer under their own name, and when the best response is simply to listen.
  • Create feedback loops into Product. Surface recurring questions, pain points, objections, competitive mentions, product feedback, and emerging developer conversations to Product, Engineering, Developer Growth, and other relevant teams.
  • Get more technical voices into the conversation. Make it easy for Datadog engineers, PMs, researchers, and other experts to participate directly in developer conversations instead of relying exclusively on brand accounts.
  • Turn shipped work into conversations. Find compelling ways to bring releases, changelogs, technical content, demos, events, and engineering work into the places developers are already talking.
  • Build measurement that matters. Define how we measure developer engagement beyond follower counts and impressions. Track things like conversations joined, response coverage, sentiment and recurring themes, participation from technical teams, traffic, product discovery, trials, and signups.
  • Run experiments. Test new platforms, formats, tooling, workflows, response models, and engagement programs with a clear hypothesis and readout. Keep what works and move quickly past what doesn’t.

Who you are

You understand how developers behave online. 

You’ve built an audience, community, engagement program, developer program, or similar function, and can point to outcomes you changed.

You have strong judgment about when a company should join a conversation and when it shouldn’t.

You are naturally curious. If developers suddenly start discussing something relevant to Datadog, your instinct is to understand why, find the thread, and figure out whether we should participate.

You think in systems. If ten people are manually forwarding Reddit posts into Slack, you want to build something better.

You’re comfortable with tooling, automation, monitoring platforms, APIs, AI, and lightweight workflows. You don’t necessarily need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable working closely with engineers and technical products.

You can create structure where none exists: monitoring rules, triage processes, response playbooks, escalation paths, reporting, and measurement.

You know how to earn participation from internal experts rather than simply assigning them another marketing task.

You move quickly, have strong judgment, and know what can ship immediately versus what needs another set of eyes.

You have opinions about developer culture, platforms, formats, and internet behavior — and you update those opinions when the evidence changes.

Your background

You may come from Growth,Developer Marketing, Audience Development, Product, Media, Social, Technical Communications, or somewhere entirely different.

What matters most is that you can show us how you’ve built participation around an audience, created systems that scale engagement, and turned what people were saying into action.

Experience working with a technical or enthusiast audience is especially valuable.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience building social listening or community-monitoring systems
  • Deep familiarity with Reddit, Discord, Hacker News, GitHub, Stack Overflow, X, or similar developer platforms
  • Experience launching or operating a Discord or other owned developer space
  • Experience creating triage, escalation, or response workflows across large organizations
  • Familiarity with developer tools, infrastructure, observability, security, AI, or open source
  • Experience using automation or AI to scale monitoring and engagement
  • An existing developer audience or active participation in technical communities
  • Strong instincts around short-form technical content and video

title: Senior Capture Manager
descriptionHtml:
Senior Capture Manager, Federal Systems Integrators - Public Sector

As the Senior Capture Manager, Federal Systems Integrators (FSI), you will lead joint capture and channel coordination across Datadog's federal systems integrator and prime-contractor ecosystem, serving as the connective tissue between those partners and Datadog's internal federal sales teams. You will make sure capture activity happening inside FSI partner organizations is visible to, aligned with, and reinforced by Datadog's own federal sellers, and vice versa, so that partner-led and direct-led motions strengthen a pursuit rather than duplicate or collide with it. The role reports to the Channel & Alliances (C&A) organization and works cross-functionally with federal sales, distribution (Carahsoft, Vertosoft), deal desk, and legal to drive joint capture outcomes on priority federal pursuits.

Travel: Less than 25%

Clearance: An active U.S. government security clearance is preferred but not required. Candidates without an active clearance are encouraged to apply.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the joint-capture strategy and partner alignment for a portfolio of approximately 20 priority federal programs, engaging 12-24 months ahead of RFP release
  • Manage each named program as a distinct capture effort, coordinating dedicated engagement across agency stakeholders, FSI partners, and independent software vendors (ISVs)
  • Identify requirements, shape acquisition strategy, engage agencies, primes, and partners, and position Datadog ahead of procurement
  • Act as the primary liaison between FSI partners and Datadog's internal federal sales teams, ensuring each side knows what the other is doing on a given program
  • Build and maintain a documented capture plan for each named program covering mission, stakeholders, funding, acquisition path, competition, partners, Datadog's position, and next milestone
  • Identify and resolve channel conflict early, surfacing where a partner-led and direct-led pursuit are converging on the same account or contract vehicle and brokering a single aligned approach
  • Partner with distribution (Carahsoft, Vertosoft) to keep pricing, SKU naming, and quoting consistent across contract vehicles, including the GSA Schedule and SEWP (Solutions for Enterprise-Wide Procurement)
  • Coordinate teaming strategy with FSI partners, including how partners team with primes and other systems integrators, and flag most-favored-nation (MFN) or pricing-consistency issues to deal desk before they become customer-facing problems
  • Coordinate Requests for Information (RFIs) and sources-sought responses in partnership with federal sales, solutions engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders. This role shapes response strategy and reviews submissions but is not solely responsible for authoring them.
  • Advance qualified pursuits through customer discovery, partner teaming, and architectural inclusion, then transfer qualified pursuits to Account Executives (AEs) and Partner Sales Managers (PSMs) for execution
  • Build durable working relationships with FSI partner capture and Business Development (BD) leads and with Datadog's federal account teams so coordination happens proactively, not only when escalated

Who You Are:

  • 8-10+ years of experience in capture management, channel/alliances, or business development within U.S. federal technology sales, with direct exposure to partner-led (sell-thru) motions through systems integrators or primes
  • Experience specifically bridging channel/alliance partners and internal direct sales teams, ideally in a partner-liaison or joint-capture role rather than a standalone direct capture role
  • Working knowledge of government contract vehicles (GSA Schedule, SEWP) and how pricing, SKUs, and quoting flow through public sector distributors such as Carahsoft and Vertosoft
  • Established relationships with, or experience working alongside, major federal systems integrators and primes
  • Working familiarity with cloud infrastructure, observability, cybersecurity, or DevSecOps concepts, sufficient to represent Datadog's technical category credibly with partners and agencies
  • Confident resolving channel conflict diplomatically, able to align a partner-side team and an internal federal team on a single approach without either side feeling sidelined
  • Able to quickly understand deal structure concepts relevant to multi-partner environments - MFN clauses, teaming agreements, pricing consistency across distributors - and explain them to others verbally and in writing
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including translating between partner-facing and internal-facing audiences

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

How Success Is Measured:

This role carries defined leading indicators rather than a direct bookings quota, since captures in this motion typically run 12-24 months before transferring to an AE/PSM for close. Success is measured through capture plan completeness and quality, the rate at which programs advance through discovery, partner teaming, and architectural inclusion, and the portfolio's contribution to qualified sourced pipeline and closed bookings over time. Detailed year-over-year targets are tracked internally as part of the C&A scorecard.

Benefits and Growth:

  • Meaningful ownership of high-value federal programs from early shaping through capture, with direct influence on how Datadog wins in the federal market
  • New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • An inclusive company culture and the opportunity to join our Community Guilds
  • Generous global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

title: Regional Manager, Sales Engineering - Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
Regional Manager, Sales Engineeringとして、Sales Engineersとフロントラインリーダーで構成されるチームを率い、担当地域における技術的な実行力、業務の卓越性、チームメンバーの成長を推進していただきます。

チームパフォーマンスのオーナーシップを持ち、実行基準を形作り、Sales部門のリーダーシップと密接に連携しながら戦略に影響を与え、成果を改善し、個々の案件を超えたインパクトをスケールさせる、いわば「フォースマルチプライヤー(force multiplier)」としての役割を担っていただきます。

Datadogでは、オフィスカルチャーによって築かれる人間関係やコラボレーション、そこからもたらされる創造性を大切にしています。私たちは、従業員それぞれに合ったワーク・ライフ・ハーモニーを実現できるよう、ハイブリッド・ワークプレイスとして運営しています。

業務内容：

  • Sales Engineersのチームを率い、指導・育成し、定期的なフィードバックと構造化された育成プログラムを通じてパフォーマンス、エンゲージメント、長期的なキャリア成長を推進する
  • シニアSalesリーダーシップと自信を持って連携し、地域戦略、複数四半期にわたるプランニング、年間キャパシティプランニング、フォーキャストの整合を担い、2〜3四半期先を見据えてリソースニーズと事業優先度を予測する
  • 戦略的かつインパクトの大きい商談においてエグゼクティブとしての存在感を発揮し、チームとともにシニアレベルのステークホルダーとの連携と技術的信頼性を提供することで、地域レベルの現場での実行をオーナーシップする
  • 評価、顧客エンゲージメント、案件の進行を含む、地域内の技術的セールスサイクル全体を通じて一貫した高品質なデリバリーを監督する
  • IC(個人貢献者)からマネージャーレベルまで、トップタレントの採用・オンボーディングを行い、高パフォーマンスなチームを構築し、構造化されたオンボーディングとイネーブルメントによって立ち上がりを加速させる
  • リソース配分、稼働率、KPIトラッキング、生産性、スキル開発を含む地域内の業務を管理し、担当エリア全体で効果的なカバレッジを確保する
  • Sales、Product、Marketing、Enablement、Supportとシニアレベルで部門横断的に連携し、地域戦略、GTM実行、顧客体験の整合を図る
  • プロセスの改善、データ品質の維持、評価フレームワークのスケール、チームの有効性と事業インパクトを高める施策への貢献を通じて、地域全体の業務の卓越性を推進する

募集要項：

  • 顧客対応型の技術組織においてSales Engineersおよび/またはフロントラインリーダーをマネジメントした経験3年以上。チームパフォーマンスの管理、メンバー育成、高パフォーマンスチームのスケールにおける実績を持つ方
  • Sales Engineering、Solutions Engineering、または技術系の顧客対応職における経験7年以上
  • シニアSalesリーダーシップと戦略的パートナーとして、地域戦略、長期プランニング、フォーキャストの整合において連携した実績
  • 複数四半期にわたるプランニングと日々のチーム実行・優先事項のバランスを取りながら、戦略レベルと業務レベルの両方で活動できる能力
  • 部門を横断し、シニアレベルにも影響を与えられる強力なコラボレーション力
  • パブリッククラウド(AWS、Azure、GCP)、Kubernetes、APM/トレーシング、セキュリティ、開発者体験、オブザーバビリティに関する背景・知見
  • AIツールを活用し、それをスケールさせる実証済みの能力
  • 変化を受け入れ、好奇心を持つ成長志向のマインドセット
  • 顧客対応をサポートするために必要に応じて出張できること

Datadogは、さまざまな立場の人々を大切にしています。誰もが初日から上記の資格をすべて満たすわけではないことは理解しています。それでも構いません。テクノロジーに情熱を持ち、スキルを伸ばしたいと思っている方は、ぜひご応募ください。

福利厚生とキャリア成長：

  • 新入社員への株式付与（RSU / 譲渡制限付株式ユニット）および従業員株式購入制度（ESPP）
  • 継続的な専門能力開発、製品トレーニング、キャリアパスの提供 
  • 社内ネットワーク構築のためのメンターおよびバディ・プログラム 
  • インクルーシブな企業文化、コミュニティ・ギルドへの参加機会
  • 幅広く手厚い医療関連の福利厚生制度
  • 企業型確定拠出年金（401K）
  • ペットの養子縁組と保険プログラム

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about solving the technical problems that developers face on a daily basis? Are you looking for a place where you can grow your product marketing career and put your own stamp on how work gets done in the future? Datadog’s Product Marketing Managers get to work across new products and features that are mission critical to our customers' success and impact all areas of the business to help move Datadog forward. 

You’ll own go-to-market strategy for a portion of Datadog’s solutions, crafting narratives tailored for customers migrating to the cloud, and partnering closely with Datadog’s product, marketing, and sales teams to drive growth. This is a high-impact opportunity to scale Datadog’s product suite.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Drive go-to-market strategy 
  • Create engaging content to promote product & feature launches
  • Own the messaging and positioning that will be leveraged for digital marketing campaigns and industry events, including our annual conference DASH
  • Work cross functionally with product, sales, and customer success to increase product usage and customer adoption
  • Enable our amazing sales & customer success teams to win new logos and expand upselling opportunities
  • Develop pitch decks, ebooks, case studies, blogs, webinars, short-form demo videos, and customer testimonials

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of Product Marketing experience, specifically within Enterprise B2B SaaS 
  • Prior experience focused on Infrastructure Monitoring, Application Performance Monitoring (APM), Log Management, Security Monitoring, or Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM)
  • Storyteller with the ability to communicate with a technical audience 
  • Demonstrated ability to develop content, collateral, product positioning and messaging, as well as enablement assets 
  • Passionate about FaaS, SaaS, cloud computing, DevOps and product-led growth strategy

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits & Growth:

  • Generous and competitive benefits package
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
  • Continuous career development and pathing opportunities
  • Employee-focused best in class onboarding
  • Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program

title: Software Engineering Intern
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for Software Engineering Interns to help build and scale the systems that power Datadog’s observability and security platform. Interns contribute directly to real-world engineering challenges across backend, frontend, infrastructure, data engineering, and developer tooling while working alongside experienced engineers and mentors. You’ll help design, build, and improve systems that process and analyze massive volumes of metrics, logs, and application data in real time. Whether you’re interested in distributed systems, Kubernetes, AI-powered products like Bits AI, or developer platform tooling, you’ll work on meaningful projects that deliver impact for customers at global scale.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 

What You’ll Do:

  • Contribute to production systems that process and analyze large-scale observability and application data in real time
  • Build and improve distributed systems across backend infrastructure, developer platforms, and cloud-native services
  • Help identify and solve performance, reliability, and scalability challenges in critical services supporting Datadog’s growing customer base
  • Own and deliver technical projects from design through deployment with guidance from experienced engineers and mentors
  • Develop technical expertise through hands-on experience with technologies such as Kubernetes, distributed systems, and cloud-native infrastructure
  • Collaborate with fellow interns, mentors, and engineers while building software that delivers impact at global scale

Who You Are:

  • Expected to graduate in 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field from a university in Spain
  • Demonstrate strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and software design
  • Comfortable coding in one or more programming languages and excited to use AI-assisted tools to enhance software development and problem solving
  • Have experience using AI coding tools or a strong interest in learning how to use them effectively while exploring how AI can improve engineering practices and products
  • Available to complete a full-time or part-time internship beginning in February 2027. At this time, we are only able to support internship start dates in February 2027.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

  • Work on meaningful technical challenges alongside engineers across the globe
  • Participate in mentorship and buddy programs designed to support learning and development
  • Join an in-person intern cohort and expand your network through engineering talks, social events, and community engagement opportunities throughout your internship
  • Receive relocation support and travel benefits where applicable
  • Enjoy office perks including snacks, drinks, and catered lunches on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Please ensure that you submit your CV/resume in English. If possible, please apply using your personal email address instead of your university email address.

title: Senior Product Manager - Journey Monitoring
descriptionHtml:
Today, organizations struggle to ensure their most important digital experiences are working as intended because observability data is scattered across products and siloed in logical layers of their technical stack. We're building the system that fixes this: Journey Monitoring, a single centralized hub that brings together Real User Monitoring (RUM), Synthetics, and Product Analytics to bridge the gap between system health and user success. You'd be building a product that establishes a new functional observability layer, enabling teams to auto-discover journeys, track conversions and uptime side-by-side, and trace root causes across their full stack without cross-team handoffs.

What you'll do:

  • Drive the product vision and roadmap spanning the Journey Monitoring hub, including the journey map, details reports, automatically inferred journeys, and cross-product data federation.
  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery to launch, working with a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and other PMs across the Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM) products.
  • Deeply understand the needs of distinct key personas: SREs and engineers (who monitor uptime and troubleshoot technical performance), product managers (who track conversion and investigate behavioral drop-offs), and business leaders (who care about outcomes and revenue impact).
  • Design the functional observability layer that makes end-to-end flow monitoring intuitive — including the auto-discovery of user journeys from real traffic, Experience Level Objectives (XLOs), and seamless Bits AI integrations for automated root-cause investigations.
  • Define how behavioral data and technical data come together to automatically surface whether a drop in conversion is caused by a technical failure (like a breached SLO) or a behavioral friction point.
  • Engage directly with early customers and internal dogfooding users to iterate on usability, refine the journey map, and optimize the cross-sell and up-sell paths for customers with partial DEM product adoption.
  • Independently research the competitive landscape across digital experience and business process monitoring vendors like Dynatrace, New Relic, Contentsquare, and Amplitude.
  • Work with GTM teams to define positioning and messaging that establishes Journey Monitoring as the shared unit of analysis across engineering, product, and business teams.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Product Management, with at least some of it spent on data-intensive, analytics, or digital experience monitoring products.
  • You have domain knowledge of Real User Monitoring, Synthetics, Product Analytics, Application Performance Monitoring (APM), and how to bridge the gap between technical metrics and business outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills - you can write SQL, interpret complex data, and use data to drive product decisions.
  • Experience with AI-powered products is a strong plus - you understand how to integrate AI workflows (like Bits AI root-cause analysis) to simplify cross-team triage.
  • You have a strong sense of ownership with an entrepreneurial mindset - this requires someone comfortable with ambiguity and speed to push a major new capability to General Availability.
  • Sharp communication skills with the ability to interact with technical stakeholders and executives alike.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or equivalent experience is a plus.

Benefits and Growth:

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)
  • Free, global Spring Health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+
  • Competitive global benefits and giving programs

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - Incident Response
descriptionHtml:
Datadog Incident Response is an end-to-end incident operations solution native to Datadog’s unified observability and security platform. It brings the entire incident lifecycle — from alert to resolution — together in one place so engineers can respond fast with confidence instead of losing time switching between disconnected monitoring, paging, and incident tools.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager (PMM) - Incident Response, you will develop go-to-market strategy for new products and features, create the content that enables our sales and partner teams, and touch on all areas of the business while helping move Datadog forward. We give our Product Marketing Managers the opportunity to collaborate, investigate, and idealize how we can gear our product strategy to yield the highest results.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and drive the go-to-market strategy for Datadog Incident Response products, such as Incident Management, On-Call, and Incident AI as an expert of your product area.
  • Create quarterly GTM plans with input and alignment from from cross-functional stakeholders that map to Incident Response business objectives.
  • Launch new features with compelling messaging and positioning, developing assets such as slide decks, blogs, product demos, webinars, and solution briefs.
  • Develop high-impact sales enablement assets (battlecards, pitch decks, demos) grounded in deep market and competitive insights.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to execute campaigns across webinars, paid media, organic channels, and sponsored events.
  • Drive customer marketing initiatives including case studies, testimonials, and storytelling that showcase customer value and outcomes.
  • Identify new growth opportunities and creative ways to accelerate adoption and expansion of Incident Response products.

Who You Are:

  • Experienced in product marketing, go-to-market strategy, or related roles (typically 5+ years) marketing highly technical products
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with stakeholders across Product Management, Sales, Marketing, and Enablement
  • Strong problem solver who can identify gaps, propose solutions, and operationalize them into scalable programs
  • Strong written and verbal communicator with experience creating compelling content and delivering presentations
  • A proactive self-starter who takes ownership and drives projects from idea to execution
  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution
  • Passionate about technology, with a solid understanding of modern engineering workflows, operational practices, and the tools/ processes teams commonly use to build, operate, and troubleshoot their systems

Bonus Points:

  • Domain expertise in Incident Response, Incident Management, On-Call, Service Management, ITSM, or Observability.
  • Experience marketing highly technical products to Developers, SREs, and IT decision-makers.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
  • Continuous career development and pathing opportunities
  • Employee-focused best in class onboarding
  • Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program
  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

title: Senior Sales Engineer - Majors (West)
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Enterprise Sales Engineer, you’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to both customers and Sales. You’ll lead complex technical evaluations, align solutions to business outcomes, and help shape deal strategy in high-impact opportunities.

This role goes beyond delivering demos - you’ll own the evaluation experience end-to-end, influence key stakeholders, and help drive successful outcomes across enterprise accounts.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical strategy across your accounts as a peer to the Account Executive - a standing weekly 1:1 with each AE you support, and a standing weekly account team call with the full ecosystem where you carry POV status, technical blockers, and the explanation behind any usage movement.
  • Own the technical explanation behind consumption movement in your accounts. Work with the CSM and TAM to separate legitimate growth from misconfiguration, make sure legitimate growth gets quantified before renewal, and flag forward-looking usage the customer has signalled rather than explaining it backwards a month later.
  • Lead discovery in every meeting, not only in discovery meetings - including meetings where you were invited to present. Leave each meeting knowing something about their business you did not know going in.
  • Deliver engaging product demos, technical presentations, solution workshops, etc. that connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes for diverse stakeholder audiences including executives 
  • Full ownership of the technical evaluations (POVs) end-to-end: scoping use cases and requirements, defining competitive success criteria, building a project plan with clear timelines, and holding all participants accountable to the process
  • Identify, develop, and leverage technical champions across multi-stakeholder environments, building a structured plan for champion cultivation and influence throughout the deal cycle and beyond
  • Contribute to product direction through active participation in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, bringing field insights and customer patterns to PM and engineering teams
  • Drive operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems 
  • Identify and proactively resolve technical and organizational blockers by collaborating across Product, Support, and GTM teams before customers are impacted
  • Contribute to team enablement by mentoring peers, sharing best practices, and creating reusable assets that scale knowledge across the region

Who You Are: 

  • 7+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role within an enterprise environment
  • Skilled at influencing and adapting communication across technical, business, and executive audiences 
  • Advanced background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences
  • Experience displacing or consolidating away from an entrenched incumbent inside an account where that incumbent has internal advocates
  • A consultative, outcome - oriented approach to problem-solving and customer engagement
  • Demonstrated depth over breadth. You have worked a very small number of very large organisations over long horizons, and can describe how your understanding of one account compounded across quarters.
  • Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement initiatives
  • Demonstrated capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it 
  • Growth mindset of embracing change and being curious 
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

title: Manager I, Engineering - Applied AI/ML Product Analytics Suite
descriptionHtml:
Datadog’s Product Analytics suite spans Product Analytics, Session Replay, Feature Flags, and Experimentation. Together they give product teams a complete, quantitative and qualitative picture of how users experience their applications, plus the tools to release, measure, and improve those experiences with confidence.

Our team of Applied Scientists makes this space smarter and more autonomous, researching, prototyping, and industrializing AI/ML capabilities that make the suite proactive and agentic by default: AI-driven event understanding and instrumentation, conversational analytics, automated insight reporting, and UI/UX issue detection from session replays. The ambition is to let product teams act with autonomy, moving from question to insight to safely released change without depending on engineering or analysts.

As the Engineering Manager for this team, you’ll lead a team of Applied Scientists through an early-stage, high-impact opportunity: defining the team’s technical vision, growing its footprint, and shaping how AI capabilities get built and delivered across the suite. This is greenfield work, both in the R&D itself and in the team you’ll grow around it.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and grow a team of Applied Scientists researching, prototyping, and industrializing AI/ML capabilities across the suite
  • Define the technical vision and roadmap for the suite’s agentic and proactive AI/ML capabilities: event understanding, conversational analytics, insight reporting, and session-replay issue detection
  • Stay hands-on as a technical contributor and reviewer, helping the team move from research prototypes to production-grade capabilities
  • Shape how AI capabilities get built and delivered across the suite, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership
  • Hire and onboard Applied Scientists as Datadog scales its investment in applied AI/ML
  • Represent the team’s progress and priorities to stakeholders across Product Analytics and Datadog’s broader AI efforts

Who You Are:

  • An experienced technical leader with a background in applied AI/ML, ideally with hands-on research or applied science experience of your own
  • A people manager, whether established or early in your management journey, backed by strong technical credibility
  • Comfortable operating in greenfield ambiguity: defining direction and structure where little exists yet, rather than executing against an established roadmap
  • Experience taking ML/AI capabilities from research prototype to production, ideally in an analytics, NLP, or user-behavior domain
  • A clear communicator who can translate technical AI/ML concepts for product and engineering stakeholders
  • Motivated by early-stage, high-impact work and comfortable with the ambiguity that comes with it

title: Staff Engineer - Cloud Networks
descriptionHtml:
Datadog’s Cloud Networks team designs, builds, and maintains the production network infrastructure that powers everything built on top of our platform across AWS, GCP, Azure, and beyond. In this role, you’ll set technical direction for how we scale our multi-region, multi-cloud network footprint while keeping reliability and performance high. You’ll partner closely with internal teams and Cloud Service Providers to troubleshoot complex connectivity issues, integrate new networking capabilities, and improve the foundations our engineers and customers rely on. This is a high-impact opportunity to drive meaningful improvements in scale, resiliency, and cost efficiency.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture, the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and operate cloud network infrastructure across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Neoclouds in a multi-region environment.
  • Own connectivity between clouds, customers, and developers—ensuring scalable, secure, and reliable network paths.
  • Set clear technical direction for expanding data centers and evolving the network while maintaining stability and performance.
  • Improve cross-site and cross-region connectivity patterns to support Datadog’s growing platform needs.
  • Lead deep investigations into latency, packet loss, and connectivity failures – from pcap and path analysis through to escalations with cloud providers that may originate from customer support
  • Identify and deliver network-related efficiency and cost-saving opportunities that positively impact business health.

Who You Are:

  • You have deep networking expertise. You understand BGP, route policies, path selection, prefix advertisement, and what breaks in large-scale networking.
  • You have substantial experience designing, building, and evolving large-scale Software-Defined Networks—including interconnected environments.
  • You enjoy building software and reach for code as the default way to operate a network—performing as a strong developer in a networking-heavy domain.
