title: Research Science Intern (PhD)
descriptionHtml:
Datadog AI Research — Scholars Program with Carnegie Mellon University

Datadog AI Research (DAIR) is partnering with Carnegie Mellon University to support a small number of PhD students working on open research problems grounded by ongoing efforts at Datadog/DAIR. 

You will frame a problem, run your own experiments, and write up what you find, with compute and data at a scale most academic labs cannot provide.  You will collaborate with colleagues working on the same questions.

The Lab And The Research:

DAIR is an industrial research lab motivated by practical challenges in observability and software operation: detecting and diagnosing failures, understanding complex production environments, and helping engineers operate software more effectively. The lab focuses on creating specialized foundation models, post-training and evaluating AI agents, and building frontier-scale machine learning systems. By combining fundamental research with Datadog's large-scale, real-world data and infrastructure, the lab develops new AI capabilities and translates them into practical systems with meaningful impact.

Internship projects are shaped with your DAIR mentor and your CMU faculty advisor. You do not need prior experience with observability, monitoring, or infrastructure.

What You'll Do:

  • Own a research project end to end: framing the question, running the experiments, writing it up
  • Work directly with a DAIR mentor engaged in the same problem, and stay connected to your advisor and lab
  • Publish, and use the work toward your dissertation
  • See research reach production, when it works

Who You Are:

  • Currently enrolled in a PhD program at Carnegie Mellon in machine learning, computer science, statistics, or a related field
  • Depth in at least one area relevant to the research above
  • Comfort running real experiments — training models, working with GPUs, reading and reimplementing recent papers
  • Evidence you can do research: conference or workshop papers, preprints, open-source contributions, or a lab project you can discuss in depth
  • Research taste. You can explain why a problem matters and what would change if it were solved.
  • Honest empiricism. You report the ablation that didn't work.
  • Support from your faculty advisor.

Not Required:

  • A long publication record. How you think matters more than how much you've published.
  • Observability, monitoring, or SRE background.
  • A perfect match to the areas above.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

This job is available in various departments within our company; to conform to US export control regulations, some of these roles may require candidates to be eligible for any required authorizations from the US government.

If possible, please apply using your personal email address instead of your university email address.

Students can sign up for a free Datadog Pro account to learn more about our platform and products.

descriptionHtml:
About Datadog:

Datadog is the essential monitoring and security platform for cloud applications. We bring together end-to-end traces, metrics, and logs to make your applications, infrastructure, and third-party services entirely observable. These capabilities help businesses secure their systems, avoid downtime, and ensure customers are getting the best user experience.

The Team:

The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team analyzes company financial data (revenue, customers, headcount, expenses, etc.) in order to support the business’ growth and success. Within FP&A, the R&D Finance team enables the financial strategy behind Datadog’s Engineering and Product organizations. We partner directly with technical leadership to drive decision-making around our most critical investments.

The Opportunity:

As a part of the R&D Finance team, this person will be key in supporting our product and engineering leadership team. Reporting to the Senior Manager, you will help create our annual budget and financial targets and work with operational leaders to support execution against our goals. Your work will be highly cross-functional and strategic, and you will play a pivotal role in connecting the dots across the organization through a financial lens, in order to help ensure operational alignment and inform decision making.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with senior business leaders to manage their departmental budgets on a regular basis, including but not limited to the company’s co-founder and CTO 
  • Manage financial forecasts and analytics, which include data across revenue, customers, product, company expenses, and headcount / workforce.
  • Help manage significant portions of the company’s spend, including but not limited to AI and GPU spend across the company.
  • Work on trend, ROI, and profitability analyses on both product and customer levels to support data-driven decision making
  • Work with finance management on quarterly Board materials, including coordination and consolidation across stakeholders
  • Assist in planning and budgeting cycles, ensuring consistency in tools, templates, and processes across the organization
  • Work on ad hoc projects and strategic initiatives for senior management, which may include assessing potential acquisition opportunities and/or negotiations with strategic partners like cloud vendors
  • Become proficient with various financial planning and business intelligence (BI) tools, including but not limited to Pigment, Tableau, and Metabase

Who You Are:

  • 2+ years of professional experience in FP&A / Strategic Finance, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, and/or other related field
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, or economics
  • Mastery of Excel and PowerPoint with proven experience in building financial models and managing complex data
  • You are a clear, concise communicator and team player with a humble mindset and ‘can-do’ attitude 

Bonus Points:

  • Solid understanding of Pigment is a plus, but not required
  • Experience in or understanding of a consumption-based software business model
  • Proficiency in use of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude)

Benefits and Growth: 

  • Generous and competitive benefits package
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
  • Continuous career development and pathing opportunities 
  • Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

Work Location (Hybrid):

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. This role will require you to work in the office 3 days per week, and flexible the remainder. 

#LI-Hybrid

Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is:$99,000—$132,000 USD

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. title: Senior Talent Planning Analyst
descriptionHtml:
The People Analytics Team at Datadog uses data to help our growing organization make better people decisions.

We're expanding our workforce planning capabilities to support how we grow and structure our teams. In this role, you'll help build and maintain the data foundation behind our headcount and capacity models, partnering with FP&A, Recruiting, and PBPs to keep workforce planning grounded in clean, trustworthy data. 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture – the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Automate and expand Datadog’s headcount-driven capacity modeling, improving the underlying data pipelines and insights that they surface
  • Build and maintain data models covering headcount, positions, and hiring pacing, keeping them accurate as business context changes
  • Own the position data audit process, establishing and maintaining a source of truth for open, filled, and planned positions across the business
  • Support workforce forecasts by analyzing attrition, mobility, hiring, and promotion trends in partnership with the broader People Analytics Insights team
  • Partner with our People Tech teams (HRIS, Recruiting Ops, developers) to shape the headcount management tech roadmap, driving for infrastructure and tooling that reduces friction and unlocks better data
  • Serve as a point of contact for stakeholder questions on workforce planning data, handling day-to-day communications and support requests
  • Contribute to the overall maturity of workforce planning at Datadog by improving how data is sourced, modeled, and shared
  • Run external benchmarking analyses to inform headcount planning by researching labor market data, translating it into internal-ready insights, and publishing findings for stakeholders

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of experience in workforce planning, people analytics, FP&A, or a related analytical role
  • Experience building or maintaining financial/headcount forecasting models, translating trends into forward-looking projections for capacity planning
  • Proficiency in SQL and other data analysis tools, as well as dashboarding and standard BI tools such as Tableau
  • Familiarity with position management concepts, ideally in Workday or a comparable HRIS
  • Strong attention to data quality and detail: you maintain a healthy paranoia around the numbers and will proactively catch inconsistencies
  • Clear communicator who can explain data and findings to challenging, non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to speed up analysis, automate repetitive workflows, and surface insights

Benefits and Growth:

  • Generous and competitive benefits package
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
  • Continuous career development and pathing opportunities 
  • Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
  • Best in breed onboarding
  • Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally
  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
As a Customer Success Manager, you will proactively drive new product attachment and effective strong relationships across our existing customer base through on-boarding, up-selling and cross selling. You’ll advocate for the customer internally and focus on a positive customer experience. Interactions are rooted in relationship-management, first and foremost, while also advocating for growth opportunities. Customer Success Managers follow a well-defined methodology that helps them identify the customer's unique needs and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Partner with the sales team to ensure smooth transition and onboarding experience
  • Proactively build relationships with customers to create mutual trust 
  • Successfully carry-out the full-sales cycle for any growth opportunities in existing customer accounts
  • Act as advisor to customers to ensure they’re leveraging the Datadog solution effectively
  • Monitor and identify usage trends to uncover renewal risks and promote greater adoption rates
  • Collaborate cross-functionally across internal Datadog teams (Support, Product, Finance, and Legal)

Who You Are:

  • A strong communicator with excellent attention to detail
  • Motivated by building long-term and long-lasting relationships
  • Driven by the opportunity to make a visible impact with your work
  • 5+ years of experience in a customer account facing roleCustomer-minded, always aiming to provide the most value possible
  • Excited by working in an ever-evolving and fluid solution focused environment
  • Experienced in negotiating contract terms and overcoming pricing objections without direct guidance for up-sell and cross sell activities
  • Proven track record of achieving account expansion targets, with success measured by the growth and retention of a portfolio of accounts.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Best-in-breed onboardingSales training in MEDDIC and Command of the MessageAn inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community GuildsIntra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networkingContinuous professional development, product training, and career pathingNew hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)Generous global benefits

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Customer Success Manager (CAM) 는 온보딩, 상향 판매 및 교차 판매를 통해 기존 고객 기반 전반에 걸쳐 새로운 제품 애착을 적극적으로 유도하고 강력한 관계를 효과적으로 구축하게 됩니다. 내부적으로 고객을 옹호하고 긍정적인 고객 경험에 집중하게 됩니다. 상호작용은 무엇보다도 관계 관리에 뿌리를 두고 있으며, 성장 기회를 옹호하기도 합니다. 고객 성공 관리자는 잘 정의된 방법론을 따라 고객의 고유한 요구 사항을 파악하고 Datadog 제품의 가치를 명확하게 전달합니다. 

Datadog은 사무실 문화를 통해 구축되는 관계와 협업, 창의성을 중시합니다. 우리는 데이터독 직원들이 자신에게 가장 적합한 일과 삶의 조화를 이룰 수 있도록 하이브리드 업무 환경을 운영합니다.

담당 업무

  • 영업팀과 협력하여 원활한 전환 및 온보딩 경험을 보장 
  • 고객과의 관계를 적극적으로 구축하여 상호 신뢰 구축  
  • 기존 고객 계정의 성장 기회에 대한 전체 영업 주기를 성공적으로 수행 
  • 고객이 데이터독 솔루션을 효과적으로 활용할 수 있도록 조언자 역할을 수행 
  • 사용 추세를 모니터링하고 파악하여 갱신 위험을 발견하고 채택률을 높임
  • 내부 데이터도그 팀(지원, 제품, 재무, 법무) 간에 부서 간 협업 

자격 요건

  • 디테일에 대한 뛰어난 집중력을 갖춘 우수한 커뮤니케이터
  • 장기적이고 지속적인 관계 구축을 통해 동기 부여가 되는 분
  • 업무를 통해 가시적인 영향을 만들 수 있는 기회에 동기부여가 되는 분  
  • 고객 중심, 항상 최고의 가치를 제공하기 위해 노력하는 분
  • 끊임없이 진화하는 유동적인 솔루션 중심 환경에서 근무하실 수 있는 분
  • 업셀/크로스셀 활동을 위한 계약 조건을 독립적으로 협상하고 가격 이의제기를 극복한 경험
  • 담당 고객 포트폴리오의 성장 및 유지 성과를 기반으로 계정 확장(Account Expansion) 목표를 달성한 검증된 실적

Datadog은 모든 계층의 사람들을 소중히 여깁니다. 모든 사람이 입사 첫날에 위의 모든 자격 요건을 충족하지 못할 수도 있습니다. 괜찮습니다. 기술에 대한 열정이 있고 경험을 쌓고 싶다면 지원하실 것을 권장합니다.

혜택 및 성장:

  • 최우수한 수준의 온보딩
  • MEDDIC 및 Command of the Message 의 영업 교육 
  • 포용적인 기업 문화, 커뮤니티 길드 가입 기회
  • 사내 네트워킹을 위한 부서 내 멘토 및 버디 프로그램 
  • 지속적인 전문성 개발, 제품 교육 및 커리어 경로 제공 
  • 신규 채용 우리사주(RSU) 및 직원 주식 매입 계획(ESPP)
  • 풍성한 글로벌 혜택

위에 나열된 혜택 및 성장은 근무 국가 및 데이터독 고용의 성격에 따라 달라질 수 있습니다.

title: Regional Director - Enterprise Sales
descriptionHtml:
Our Director, Enterprise Sales will provide strategy, mentorship, and guidance for a team of Enterprise Sales Executives who are responsible for driving new business through the full sales cycle.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Manage, hire, train and ramp a team of Enterprise Sales Executives responsible for new and expansion bookings
  • Achieve annual Enterprise bookings quota with monthly and quarterly targets
  • Develop and manage Enterprise Sales Executives on productivity metrics such as deal size, win rate, and forecast accuracy as well as how to lead a customer through a proactive sales cycle
  • Coach Sales Executives through building executive relationships with Named Enterprise accounts in their territories and through complex Enterprise deals and negotiations
  • Shape the direction of the go-to market strategy and execution for your region
  • Work collaboratively with Marketing, Product and Success to build targeted messaging and collateral, and mapping a customer journey for the specific business needs of your region
  • Conduct weekly forecast meetings 
  • Support direct reports by participating and leading in client and prospect meetings. Engaging other corporate resources as required

Who You Are:

  • Experienced in managing a high performing Enterprise Sales team for a B2B technology company
  • A strong relationship builder with 5+ years of overall Enterprise sales experience working with Fortune 1000 companies 
  • Confident in managing complex sales processes with multiple stakeholders and negotiations with pricing based on business value, legal and procurement 
  • Knowledgeable in selling to C-level executives in the IT space 
  • Experienced in setting quotas and managing people against those quotas
  • Passionate about coaching others with a successful track record as an individual contributor and can share relevant and complex closing experience with a growing team
  • Ideally based in Tokyo, and willing to travel across Tokyo for customer meetings. Able to travel abroad up to 4 times a year for company events in the USA and APAC. 
  • Role requires regular travel to client sites, within your area and other regions, using various modes of transportation (car, train, air), depending on business needs.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth: 

  • High income earning opportunities based on self performance
  • New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing 
  • Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message 
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking 
  • An inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community Guilds

  • Retirement savings match
  • Pet adoption and insurance program

title: Regional Director - Enterprise Sales
descriptionHtml:
エンタープライズセールス ディレクターは、セールスサイクル全体を通じて新規ビジネスの創出を担うエンタープライズセールスチームに対し、戦略策定、メンタリング、指導を行います。

Datadogでは、オフィスで育まれる人間関係や協働、そしてそこから生まれる創造性を大切にしています。社員一人ひとりが自分に合った仕事と生活の調和を実現できるよう、ハイブリッドな働き方を採用しています。

主な業務内容：

  • 新規および既存顧客からの売上拡大を担うエンタープライズセールスチームのマネジメント、採用、育成、早期戦力化
  • 月次・四半期目標を管理し、エンタープライズ部門の年間受注目標を達成
  • 案件規模、成約率、売上予測精度などの生産性指標に基づくメンバーの育成・マネジメント、および顧客を主体的に導く営業プロセスの定着
  • 担当テリトリーの指定エンタープライズアカウントにおける経営層との関係構築や、複雑な大型案件・交渉を進めるためのコーチング
  • 担当リージョンにおけるGo-to-Market戦略および実行方針の策定
  • マーケティング、プロダクト、カスタマーサクセスの各部門と連携し、地域固有のビジネスニーズに合わせたメッセージや営業資料を作成するとともに、カスタマージャーニーを設計
  • 週次の売上予測会議を実施
  • 顧客・見込み顧客との商談に参加し、必要に応じて主導することで直属のメンバーを支援。状況に応じて社内の関連リソースも活用

求める経験・スキル：

  • B2Bテクノロジー企業において、高い成果を上げるエンタープライズセールスチームをマネジメントした経験
  • Fortune 1000企業を対象としたエンタープライズ営業経験（通算5年以上）と、強固な関係を構築する力
  • 複数のステークホルダーが関与する複雑な営業プロセスを管理し、事業価値に基づく価格交渉や法務・調達部門との交渉を推進できること
  • IT領域の経営層（Cレベル）に対する営業知識と経験
  • 営業目標を設定し、その達成に向けてメンバーをマネジメントした経験

title: Manager I, Engineering - Code Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Code Intelligence sits at the intersection of agentic engineering and product, running agents against real customer source code in production. This is a chance to own an AI-native team at the center of a business-critical growth area. High visibility, high leverage, and squarely in the fastest-growing part of the AI agent space.


At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead and develop an existing engineering team, building trust, setting technical direction, and establishing a high bar for ownership and execution.
  • Own the roadmap and execution across four areas: source code indexing, PR Agentic Reviewers (agents that generate artifacts like metric descriptions on customer pull requests), shift-left work (extending code-writing agents to make direct changes to customer repos), and closed-loop feedback and evaluation systems including LLM-as-judge.
  • Set the team's product strategy independently while partnering day-to-day with product teams company-wide — this team functions as its own product org.
  • Build and operate scaled LLM and agent software in production: LLM APIs, agent frameworks, harness and tool-use layers, prompt and eval tooling, and closed-loop evaluation systems that measure and improve agent output quality.
  • Partner closely with customers and internal stakeholders to deeply understand needs and translate them into technical direction.
  • Drive the team's AI-native development practices, setting high standards for safety, validation, and increasing agent autonomy over time.

Who You Are:

  • Experienced engineering manager with a track record of shipping products with direct customer interaction, not just internal stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience building scaled LLM software: LLM APIs, agent frameworks, prompt and eval tooling, harness and tool-use development, and closed-loop evaluation systems including LLM-as-judge.
  • Strong product and customer mindset — you put solving customer problems first and know how to ship and iterate quickly.
  • Comfortable setting your own product strategy in an ambiguous environment rather than executing a pre-defined roadmap.
  • SDLC and developer tooling background is a plus but not required — strong AI and agent experience is what matters most.
  • Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

descriptionHtml:
The Senior Sponsorship Sales Manager - Global Conferences will own the strategy, sales, and execution of the sponsorship program for DASH, Datadog’s flagship annual conference, while also supporting sponsorship strategy and sales for global Datadog Summits. You will manage the full sponsorship sales cycle, from developing packages and prospecting through negotiation, closing, renewal, and partner experience. title: Senior Design Manager - Design Systems
descriptionHtml:
The way products get built is changing. Agents write a growing share of shipped interfaces, designers work in code, and a design system's output is bigger than a component library. At Datadog we're redefining ours for that world, and evolving how the product looks and feels at the same time.

DRUIDS is the design system behind every Datadog surface, used daily by more than a hundred designers and thousands of engineers across thirty-plus products. You'll lead the team that owns it: designers and design engineers who set the system's direction, hold the quality bar for what ships, and build the tools that make designing in code the default way to work. The team partners closely with product designers, frontend engineers and PMs across the company.

This is a hands-on leadership role in a technical, engineering-forward company. You'll be expected to have a point of view and defend it, to be the person the design org asks about quality, and to make the call when work isn't good enough yet. Much of what a design system should be right now hasn't been settled — here or anywhere else. If you're a designer who never stopped making things, and you'd rather decide what a system should be than maintain one that already exists, this is the role.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do

Lead the team and set its direction

  • Decide what DRUIDS owns, what it ships, and what stays with product teams.
  • Own where the system goes next. Have a view on what a design system should be, and argue for it.
  • Turn direction into a roadmap, and work with partners on what gets built and when.
  • Coach the designers and design engineers on your team, be clear about what each person owns, and hire as the team grows.

Own craft and quality

  • Own the craft and quality of components, patterns, and principles.
  • Decide what's good enough to go into DRUIDS.
  • Raise the quality of the product through the system, and through the way design gets made here.
  • Say when work isn't good enough.

Own the tooling the system runs on

  • Own the tooling that makes the system usable, and the workflows people use to build with it.
  • Work out how design quality gets evaluated, by people and by agents, and where that belongs in how software gets shipped.
  • Decide what the system ships beyond components, and which formats and surfaces it needs to reach.

Stay close to product design

  • Keep a pulse on what’s getting built and where teams are struggling.
  • Define how the system shows up for product teams  — the touchpoints, relationships and working models needed to support them.
  • Make the system something teams want to use.

Who You Are

  • You have 8+ years in product design, 3+ of them managing.
  • You've managed a design system team and grown it.
  • You read and write front-end code, and can have conversations about it.
  • You design, have opinions and a point of view.
  • You are a clear communicator.
  • Your feedback improves quality and direction.
  • You can build relationships with fellow leaders and influence them
  • You've developed reports, and you've handled people who weren't performing.
  • You want to work in an engineering-forward company.

About Datadog

descriptionHtml:
The Global Safety & Security Team falls under the Operations Team that runs many day-to-day operational functions that help keep our employees safe, happy and productive. We work closely with leadership and employees to ensure that Datadog continues to scale rapidly, yet smoothly and remains a fantastic place to work.

We’re seeking an experienced team member to join our growing global team and play a critical role in keeping Datadogs and its assets safe and secure. You will work directly with the Global Head of Global Safety & Security and cross-functional teams to support safety and security operations across the enterprise. Ideal candidates will be passionate about leadership, security operations, building programs, workplace health and safety, project management, customer service and collaboration. This position is based in our Sydney or Singapore office and will require domestic and international travel. The role will focus particularly on developing our safety compliance, security program development and maturity, incident, investigations and crisis management programs.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

  • Providing ad-hoc coverage for the EMEA and AMER region may be required at the discretion of the Global Head of Global Safety & Security.
  • Oversee a variety of responsibilities, including investigations, health and safety compliance, security risk management, travel safety, event security, budgeting, crisis management, emergency response, property loss management and global safety and security system management. Enforce Datadog’s security policies and regulations regionally.

Maintain regular communication with stakeholders to ensure alignment on global safety and security initiatives and ensure all teams are trained on emergency plans and incident response protocols.

title: Senior Product Manager - Feature Flagging
descriptionHtml:
At Datadog, we're on a mission to build the best platform in the world for engineers to understand and scale their systems, applications, and teams. We operate at high scale, enabling seamless collaboration and problem-solving among Dev, Ops, and Security teams globally for tens of thousands of companies. Our engineering culture values pragmatism, honesty, and simplicity to solve hard problems the right way.

Feature flags used to be simple on/off switches. That's changing fast. Flags are becoming a control plane: they're tied to observability, they drive rollout decisions, and AI agents build and run more of this work every day. Datadog is building the platform for that future, and we are now expanding our Feature Flagging & Experimentation product to pair flag decisions directly with observability signals and to modernize the flagging workflow for an SDLC increasingly run by agents.

As a Senior Product Manager for Feature Flagging, you will own product strategy and drive execution across flags-plus-observability integration and agentic-era flagging workflows. You will set direction for a critical area of the roadmap, work closely with the observability, RUM, and APM teams, and report directly to the Director of Product leading this team. You'll be relied on to make sound, independent product judgment calls with limited oversight, bring engineering credibility to every decision, and drive B2B go-to-market strategy alongside sales.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. This role is based in New York City and works from our office 3 days a week to support that collaboration.

What you will Do:

  • Find every place where a flag decision and an observability signal should talk to each other - rollout gating, anomaly-triggered rollback, experiment diagnostics - and ship a roadmap that unlocks observability and experimentation differentiators in Datadog Feature Flags

  • Work closely with the observability, RUM, and APM teams to make flags a real signal across the platform

  • Design flagging workflows for a world where agents write and merge code, find where today's flag tooling slows agentic development down, and set the bar for what a modern, AI-native flagging platform looks like

  • Ground your product calls in real knowledge of CI/CD, release cycles, and observability tooling, and reason concretely about server vs. client compute tradeoffs and how flags behave differently in browser vs. native apps

  • Work with engineers as a peer - read code, follow the technical debate, and make the call when tradeoffs get messy

  • Get into deal cycles directly and know what it takes to close enterprise flagging deals

  • Own what good documentation and developer experience looks like for this product, and find and fix the enablement gaps across a large sales org

  • Own this product area from vision through GTM execution, and communicate progress and strategy to senior leadership and executives

Who you are:

  • You have +5 years of experience working closely with engineering teams, ideally as an engineer yourself, with a track record of owning a product area end to end

  • You have +2 years writing code that shipped to production through a full release cycle, and know what to expect from CI/CD, flagging, and observability tools because you've used them

  • You have real technical understanding of software architecture - why teams trade off server vs. client compute, and how browser and native apps differ

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills: you read and listen fast, write and speak clearly, and can talk to engineers as a peer

  • You have B2B experience - you've personally helped close deals, you know what makes developer docs and devex good, and you can diagnose and fix enablement problems across a large sales team

  • You are AI-fluent: you've shipped code with agentic tools yourself and know firsthand where AI tooling creates friction in the SDLC

  • You are based in New York City and able to work from our office 3 days a week

  • Bonus: prior experience with observability tooling, experimentation platforms, or distributed systems

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

title: Program Manager, Recruiting Enablement
descriptionHtml:
As the Program Manager, Recruiting Enablement, you will design, build, and deliver the training that helps Datadog’s recruiters, sourcers, coordinators, and hiring managers do their best work, including how they use AI across the hiring process. You’ll turn new tools, processes, and AI workflows into e-learning, live sessions, and job aids that people use on the job, then keep them running in our learning platform. You’ll partner closely with our Senior Enablement Program Manager to shape the enablement roadmap. You’ll have a real say in what gets built and why, while owning the design and quality of everything we ship. This is an opportunity to shape how a growing global team learns, and to grow your craft in instructional design, facilitation, and AI-assisted content creation.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the recruiting onboarding experience and development track as programs in their own right — scope, design, delivery, and results
  • Partner with the Recruiting Enablement team on the roadmap, intake, and prioritization, bringing your own read on where the team’s gaps are
  • Design learning across the recruiting lifecycle, from intake and sourcing to interviewing and closing, including how teams apply AI to sourcing, screening, scheduling, and candidate communication — and where human judgment still has to lead
  • Partner with our AI Enablement leader to bring AI programming to the recruiting team — translating broader AI initiatives into recruiting-specific training, and surfacing what recruiters actually need back to that roadmap
  • Build e-learning in Articulate Rise 360 and Storyline, plus facilitator guides, job aids, videos, and knowledge checks, using AI tools to speed up production
  • Facilitate live training, virtually and in person, for teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, and coach subject matter experts to deliver sessions themselves
  • Support the rollout of new tools and processes with training plans, launch communications, and office hours that help people adopt them
  • Run our team's day-to-day work in Docebo, our learning management system, as the first point of contact for learner questions: publish courses and learning plans, package SCORM content, troubleshoot issues, and partner with our Learning Technology team on releases and escalations
  • Measure what's working through completion, confidence, and manager-reported readiness, and keep content current with clear owners, source files, and review dates
  • Continuously improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of the program — content refreshes, automation, and better measurement of what actually moves recruiter performance

Who You Are:

  • 4+ years in instructional design, enablement, learning and development, or talent acquisition, including time building training for a recruiting or People team
  • Have a portfolio of curricula, e-learning, and job aids you designed and shipped, and a record of running several projects at once
  • Skilled in Articulate Rise 360 or Storyline and grounded in adult learning methods such as ADDIE or SAM
  • An engaging facilitator who can hold a room of experienced recruiters, in person and virtually, and build trust with partners you don't manage

  • Fluent with AI in your own practice — you use it to draft, storyboard, generate assessments, produce media, and cut build time, and you can show the before and after
  • Able to judge where AI belongs in a hiring process and where it doesn’t, with a working understanding of the bias, candidate experience, and consistency risks that come with it
  • Able to break complex problems into smaller pieces and design practical solutions, grounded in internal data, industry best practices, and adult learning principles
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, and able to prioritize well in an environment with competing demands
  • Comfortable operating globally — designing for regional nuance across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC rather than exporting a single-market program

title: Manager II, Technical Enablement Management
descriptionHtml:
We are Datadog's in-house product experts. The Technical Enablement Management (TEM) team empowers customers through technical training sessions, ensuring they maximize the value of Datadog. We combine deep technical knowledge with a consultative approach, demonstrating best practices and tailoring training to specific use cases.

As a Manager on this team, you will play a critical role in strengthening our relationships with Sales and Customer Success teams across APJ, developing and coaching the Technical Enablement Managers (TEMs) who report to you, and evolving our enablement programs to better support customer adoption and success. You will lead a distributed team of Technical Enablement Managers covering markets across Asia and ANZ. Manager 2 leaders at Datadog are people-first managers, trusted collaborators, and operational owners. In APJ you will also be the most senior enablement voice in the region, so you will spend as much time building awareness and credibility with Sales and Customer Success as you do managing delivery.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the positioning and enablement strategy for Sales and Customer Success teams in APJ, driving attach rates by positioning training as a value-added service and increasing consumption of complimentary offerings
  • Build demand upstream: engage Sales and Customer Success teams across the region at scale, keep positioning and materials current, and drive consistent use of the request process
  • Act as the quality gate for incoming work, scoping requests to the right offering, focusing broad asks into targeted sessions, and aligning demand to business need
  • Analyze customer training adoption and feedback, evaluating programs for ROI to inform which offerings to scale, evolve, or retire
  • Develop sales tools and enablement resources that help internal teams confidently position and sell training to customers

  • Build and maintain the intake and capacity-planning mechanisms the team runs on, including pre-session questionnaires, triage, prioritisation frameworks and accurate time tracking, and continuously iterate on tooling and processes to improve efficiency and scalability
  • Lead, coach and mentor a team of TEMs across APJ, conducting regular 1:1s, performance evaluations and session shadowing, identifying performance gaps early and managing performance formally when coaching alone is not enough
  • Proactively monitor team KPIs (utilization, CSAT, productivity, session delivery against demand, and attendance rates), diagnosing trends and gaps, and assign workload so that TEMs achieve an 80% productivity target while balancing training delivery, content creation and enablement activities
  • Champion the use of AI tools within the team to improve productivity from content creation and session prep through to reporting and QA, coach TEMs on effective and responsible use, and identify opportunities to apply AI to scale enablement delivery and improve program ROI
  • Actively participate in recruiting, hiring and onboarding across the team and the broader organization

  • A clear communicator who can influence without authority and align stakeholders around common goals
  • Energised by bringing a service to new internal audiences, and able to make the case as compellingly on the twentieth telling as on the first
  • Able to hold priorities firmly when demands compete, renegotiating scope with partner teams while keeping the relationship strong
  • Deliberate about priorities, with a track record of choosing what not to take on and delegating rather than absorbing
  • Culturally adaptable across Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia and ANZ, adjusting approach per market rather than applying one style everywhere
  • Direct and transparent, setting clear expectations and healthy boundaries, and calm when plans change at short notice
  • Exceptionally self-organised, owning their own scheduling, follow-up and administrative rhythm
  • A strategic thinker who balances customer needs with business goals, evaluates program ROI and drives cross-functional alignment, with a track record of implementing scalable enablement programs in a growing company
  • Data-driven, comfortable using metrics and KPIs to inform decisions and optimize performance
  • Demonstrated capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it, with a growth mindset of embracing change and being curious
  • Technically proficient, with knowledge of modern infrastructure, monitoring solutions, and cloud technologies

title: Executive Assistant II - San Francisco
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant with at least 3-7 years of experience to support high level executives. The ideal candidate will be proactive, highly organized and capable of managing complex schedules and administrative tasks. This role requires strong interpersonal skills, attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion. 

At Datadog, Business Operations run the day-to-day operations for Datadog and help to keep our employees safe, happy and productive, which means every day is different. Business Operations work closely with leadership and employees to ensure that Datadog keeps scaling smoothly and remains a great place to work.

Datadog is looking for an Executive Assistant who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment to provide exemplary support for high level executives.This highly visible and professional position requires diligent attention to detail, impeccable time management skills, and an ability to multitask. This role reports directly to the Head of Executive Support.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage and maintain executive schedules, coordinate internal and external meetings, arrange calls, dinners, events, etc.
  • Coordinate and manage projects and follow-up on action items
  • Assist in the preparation of agendas and materials for meetings
  • Work with the Executive Support Team on projects related to new hires, events, office functions, socials, offsite meetings, etc

Who You Are:

  • 3-7 years of experience supporting multiple leaders and high level executives
  • Tech-savvy with a strong interest in using technology to improve work efficiency
  • Proficient in Google Workspace

title: Manager, Accounts Payable
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager, Accounts Payable to lead Accounts Payable and Expense operations. This role will manage individual contributors and may oversee team leads while ensuring invoices, payments, reconciliations, tax reporting, and employee expenses are processed accurately and on time.

The Manager, Accounts Payable will own team performance and execution while driving process improvements, automation, and reporting. You will work across Procurement, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Finance, and other teams to resolve complex issues, strengthen controls, and improve the procure-to-pay experience.

The ideal candidate is a reliable people leader who uses business context and data to make decisions, advises stakeholders, and delivers measurable operational improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop AP and Expense team members.
  • Manage team performance, staffing, workload allocation, and day-to-day execution.
  • Build a high-performing team with clear expectations, strong accountability, and consistent results.
  • Oversee invoice processing, purchase order matching, coding, approvals, payments, vendor inquiries, and employee expense operations.
  • Ensure AP and Expense activities are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with company policies and controls.
  • Own balance sheet reconciliations, AP close activities, accrual support, aging reviews, and related reporting.
  • Lead annual 1099 reporting and support other AP-related tax and compliance requirements.
  • Serve as the primary AP contact for internal and external audits, ensuring requested documentation is accurate and complete.
  • Monitor unmatched invoices, open purchase orders, payment exceptions, duplicate payments, credits, and other outstanding items.
  • Identify inefficiencies across AP and Expenses and lead process improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability;
  • Drive automation and AI initiatives related to invoice processing, matching, approvals, reconciliations, exception handling, and reporting.
  • Develop reporting and insights using tools such as Zip, Ramp, Tableau, ERP systems, and other operational data sources.
  • Establish and monitor performance metrics, including processing volume, aging, cycle times, exception rates, and on-time payments.
  • Partner across Procurement, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Finance, and business teams and lead cross-functional initiatives when needed.
  • Evaluate complex issues using business context, advise team members and stakeholders, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Escalate risks and issues that could affect costs, controls, service levels, or short-term business goals.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in accounts payable, Expenses, accounting operations, or procure-to-pay, including people-management experience.
  • Proven ability to lead teams, manage performance, and deliver reliable results.
  • Experience owning and improving an operational area with measurable impact.
  • Strong knowledge of invoice processing, purchase orders, payments, expense management, reconciliations, accruals, and the monthly close.
  • Experience managing 1099 reporting and supporting internal and external audits.
  • Experience using procurement or finance platforms such as Zip, NetSuite, and Ramp.
  • Sound judgment when addressing diverse challenges, applying policies, and escalating financial or operational risks.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and reliability in a high-volume environment.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Business Systems drives efficiency across Datadog through business process analysis, systems automation and integrations, AI agent and MCP development, and vendor/software review. The team is increasingly embedded in cross-functional initiatives across People, Finance, GTM, Legal, Recruiting, and Technical Solutions — translating ambiguous business problems into scoped, buildable solutions and owning delivery end-to-end.

This is not a generalist BSA role. Each Senior BSA will own a cluster of business functions end-to-end, acting as an internal product manager for their domain rather than processing inbound requests reactively. There are two openings, each covering a different domain:

People, Recruiting, Legal or Finance, GTM, Procurement

As the role evolves alongside AI, Senior BSAs leverage agentic tools for data aggregation and context gathering while remaining the critical human-in-the-loop layer — owning business context and product outlook, validating use cases, managing stakeholder relationships, and making the judgment calls agents can't.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.


What You’ll Do: 

  • Discovery and scoping: Translate ambiguous asks from business stakeholders into well-defined requirements that Business Systems Engineers can build against. Many stakeholders don't know what they want or the cross-functional impact of what they're asking for — you surface both before engineering begins.
  • Cross-functional visibility: Identify dependencies, downstream impacts, and integration considerations that requesting teams miss.
  • Proactive opportunity identification: Develop deep domain knowledge to identify automation and AI opportunities before they become inbound requests, shifting the team from reactive intake to strategic partnership.
  • Stakeholder relationship ownership: Serve as the primary point of contact for your domain, reducing ad hoc consultations that currently land on the team lead and senior ICs.
  • Systems and governance: Review system configuration, data integrity, and vendor fit within your domain and make recommendations to stakeholders and BSEs; maintain clear documentation (process diagrams, system flows, user guides); ensure compliance with security and privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, SOX).


Who You Are:

  • Prior experience as a Business Systems Analyst or in a similar role, ideally within a high-tech or SaaS environment
  • Experience owning a business domain end-to-end; comfortable operating like an internal product manager
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and manage relationships with senior leadership
  • Proven track record using AI/agentic tools for data aggregation and context-gathering, while knowing where human judgment is still required
  • Demonstrable experience turning business processes into agentic or automated workflows in a prior role
  • Experience in managing projects, particularly those involving multiple stakeholders and complex integrations
  • Familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance standards (e.g., SOX, GDPR, SOC, ISO)
  • 4+ years as a business system administrator (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, Workday, Zendesk) or a business systems analyst leading complex, cross-functional projects or a similar role
  • 4+ years managing multiple projects simultaneously and formulating business design documents
  • You are comfortable with deciphering technical documentation (e.g., API documentation) and translating business to technical requirements
  • By domain:
    • People, Recruiting, Legal domain: exposure to HRIS/ATS/contract lifecycle systems (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse) and the cross-functional dependencies between them
    • Finance, GTM, Procurement, Technical Solutions domain: exposure to financial systems, deal desk, or procurement/vendor management tooling (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, Zendesk, Zip) and downstream data integrity implications

title: Manager II, Technical Enablement Management
descriptionHtml:
We are Datadog's in-house product experts. The Technical Enablement Management (TEM) team empowers customers through technical training sessions, ensuring they maximize the value of Datadog. We combine deep technical knowledge with a consultative approach, demonstrating best practices and tailoring training to specific use cases.

As a Manager on this team, you will play a critical role in strengthening our relationships with Sales and Customer Success teams across APJ, developing and coaching the Technical Enablement Managers (TEMs) who report to you, and evolving our enablement programs to better support customer adoption and success. You will lead a distributed team of Technical Enablement Managers covering markets across Asia and ANZ. Manager 2 leaders at Datadog are people-first managers, trusted collaborators, and operational owners. In APJ you will also be the most senior enablement voice in the region, so you will spend as much time building awareness and credibility with Sales and Customer Success as you do managing delivery.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the positioning and enablement strategy for Sales and Customer Success teams in APJ, driving attach rates by positioning training as a value-added service and increasing consumption of complimentary offerings
  • Build demand upstream: engage Sales and Customer Success teams across the region at scale, keep positioning and materials current, and drive consistent use of the request process
  • Act as the quality gate for incoming work, scoping requests to the right offering, focusing broad asks into targeted sessions, and aligning demand to business need
  • Analyze customer training adoption and feedback, evaluating programs for ROI to inform which offerings to scale, evolve, or retire
  • Develop sales tools and enablement resources that help internal teams confidently position and sell training to customers
  • Drive consistency in training delivery, content utilization and reporting across the team, evaluating delivery quality and distinguishing facilitation gaps from content gaps
  • Build and maintain the intake and capacity-planning mechanisms the team runs on, including pre-session questionnaires, triage, prioritisation frameworks and accurate time tracking, and continuously iterate on tooling and processes to improve efficiency and scalability
  • Lead, coach and mentor a team of TEMs across APJ, conducting regular 1:1s, performance evaluations and session shadowing, identifying performance gaps early and managing performance formally when coaching alone is not enough
  • Proactively monitor team KPIs (utilization, CSAT, productivity, session delivery against demand, and attendance rates), diagnosing trends and gaps, and assign workload so that TEMs achieve an 80% productivity target while balancing training delivery, content creation and enablement activities
  • Champion the use of AI tools within the team to improve productivity from content creation and session prep through to reporting and QA, coach TEMs on effective and responsible use, and identify opportunities to apply AI to scale enablement delivery and improve program ROI
  • Actively participate in recruiting, hiring and onboarding across the team and the broader organization
  • Collaborate with Technical Solutions leadership, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering and Product teams to address urgent needs and implement process improvements

Who You Are:

  • An experienced people manager, results-driven, with a strong focus on executing strategies that drive measurable business impact and revenue growth
  • A strong coach and mentor who invests in career development and builds inclusive, high-performing teams, and who has authored the things that let a team scale: career progression frameworks, structured onboarding and a consistent coaching cadence
  • Has built demand for a services or enablement function by going out to Sales and Customer Success rather than waiting for inbound requests, and can point to a measurable before and after
  • A clear communicator who can influence without authority and align stakeholders around common goals
  • Energised by bringing a service to new internal audiences, and able to make the case as compellingly on the twentieth telling as on the first
  • Able to hold priorities firmly when demands compete, renegotiating scope with partner teams while keeping the relationship strong
  • Deliberate about priorities, with a track record of choosing what not to take on and delegating rather than absorbing
  • Culturally adaptable across Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia and ANZ, adjusting approach per market rather than applying one style everywhere
  • Direct and transparent, setting clear expectations and healthy boundaries, and calm when plans change at short notice
  • Exceptionally self-organised, owning their own scheduling, follow-up and administrative rhythm
  • A strategic thinker who balances customer needs with business goals, evaluates program ROI and drives cross-functional alignment, with a track record of implementing scalable enablement programs in a growing company
  • Data-driven, comfortable using metrics and KPIs to inform decisions and optimize performance
  • Demonstrated capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it, with a growth mindset of embracing change and being curious
  • Technically proficient, with knowledge of modern infrastructure, monitoring solutions, and cloud technologies
  • Experienced (5+ years) in Training, Presales, Post-Sales, Consulting, or another customer-facing role, with a history of success
  • Educated in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Requires up to 25% travel across the APJ region, primarily to drive and promote enablement adoption with Sales and Customer Success along with team development and cross-functional planning

title: Recruiting Operations Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
Datadog’s Recruiting Operations team is on a mission to scale and optimize the Recruiting organization through operational efficiency, best-in-class tooling, analytics, and programs. We are looking for a Program Manager to own our sourcing tools and workflows and to build the capability that lets our sourcers find and engage the people who will build the next decade of Datadog.

In this role, you will own our sourcing tech stack end to end. Today that means Gem as our candidate relationship management system and LinkedIn Recruiter as our primary sourcing channel, but you will own the question of what the stack should be: which tools we invest in, which we retire, how they fit together, and how they connect into Greenhouse. You will set the roadmap, hold the vendor relationships and renewals, define how sourcing performance is measured, and partner with sourcing leadership to turn a collection of tools into a genuine competitive advantage in how Datadog finds talent.

AI is changing sourcing faster than any technology shift in the last decade, and we want someone who is excited to be at the front of it. Our platforms are shipping AI capability continuously — assisted search, drafted outreach, agentic workflows — and much of it is genuinely useful while some of it is not. You will be the person who tells the difference, decides what Datadog adopts, designs the workflows that put it to work, and makes sure we use it in a way that is fair to candidates and defensible to regulators. Datadog builds for the AI era; we want our recruiting function to operate like it.

through them, drive real adoption of the CRM across the team, and tell us honestly where we are leaving capability on the table. You will also work with the owner of our ATS to make sure data flows cleanly from sourcing into the hiring pipeline.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture — the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the sourcing tech stack end to end — configuration, administration, integrations, user and license management, and the multi-year roadmap for how it evolves
  • Own Datadog’s AI sourcing strategy: identify where AI can meaningfully change how our sourcers work, build the roadmap for adopting it, and lead the implementations that follow
  • Evaluate emerging AI sourcing capability with a critical eye — run structured pilots, separate real capability from vendor marketing, and make clear recommendations
  • Design AI-assisted and agentic sourcing workflows alongside sourcers and iterate them based on what the data says is working
  • Define how we measure AI efficacy in sourcing, establishing human baselines and holding AI-assisted workflows to them
  • Own responsible AI use in sourcing: human-in-the-loop standards, partnering with Legal and Privacy on evolving requirements including NYC AEDT bias audit obligations and the EU AI Act
  • Own vendor relationships and commercial outcomes for sourcing tools, including renewals, negotiations in partnership with Procurement, seat forecasting, and holding vendors accountable to their roadmaps
  • Evaluate, pilot, and select new sourcing technology, including building the business case, running structured evaluations, and leading implementation — and make the call to retire tools that are not earning their place
  • Partner with sourcing leaders to continuously optimize sourcing workflows end to end — prospect identification, outreach sequencing, pipeline nurture, talent pool strategy, and handoff into Greenhouse
  • Own CRM adoption as an ongoing program, not a project: set usage standards and build enablement, measure against targets
  • Partner with the Greenhouse owner in Recruiting Operations on integration architecture and data model decisions, ensuring prospect and candidate data flows cleanly between sourcing and the hiring pipeline
  • Ensure sourcing tools and outreach practices remain compliant with data privacy, candidate consent, and regional legal requirements across the markets we hire in, partnering with Legal and Privacy as neede

Who You Are:

  • Experienced in recruiting operations, HR technology, or a related field, with a track record of owning a platform rather than only executing projects within one
  • Genuinely excited about AI and what it can do for recruiting, with hands-on experience evaluating or deploying AI-powered tooling — and the judgment to be skeptical where skepticism is warranted
  • Able to evaluate AI capability on evidence rather than demo: you design the pilot, set the baseline, and measure against it before recommending adoption — and you’re comfortable building prompts and agentic workflows yourself
  • Thoughtful about responsible AI and candidate data privacy in hiring, including bias and fairness, transparency, human oversight, and the regulatory landscape around automated employment decision tools
  • Hands-on with a recruiting CRM (Gem strongly preferred) and LinkedIn Recruiter, and deeply familiar with how sourcing works day to day — ideally from having sourced yourself
  • Experienced at driving and sustaining tool adoption, with concrete examples of moving a team from low to high usage and keeping it there
  • Commercially capable — comfortable owning vendor relationships, building a business case, forecasting license needs, and holding your own in a renewal conversation
  • Comfortable owning a roadmap and influencing without authority: making prioritization calls, saying no, and bringing sourcers and leadership along with you
  • Humble, thoughtful, and driven by a sense of purpose in helping others succeed

title: Manager, Revenue Accounting
descriptionHtml:
About Datadog: 

Datadog is the world-class monitoring and security platform for cloud applications. We’re dedicated to creating, developing, and supporting our product and customers, allowing for seamless collaboration and problem-solving among Dev, Ops and Security teams globally. Built by engineers, for engineers, our SaaS product is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries to enable digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers’ entire technology stack. Given the resilience of cloud technologies and importance placed today in digital operations and agility, Datadog continues to innovate and is well positioned for the long term. 

The Team:

Datadog's Finance team collaborates with teams across the organization, providing commercial, operational, and analytical support to ensure that Datadog's business continues to grow as rapidly and efficiently as possible.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a Manager, Revenue Accounting to join our growing Finance team at Datadog. This role owns the revenue close and technical revenue accounting for a high-growth, usage-based business, manages and develops a team of revenue accountants, and partners cross-functionally to scale our order-to-cash and billing processes as the Company grows.

You Will:

  • Own the monthly revenue close, including review and approval of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and supporting schedules prepared by the team.
  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of revenue accountants — set priorities, review work product, and build bench strength as the team scales.
  • Own technical revenue conclusions under ASC 606, including review of memos for complex and non-standard arrangements, variable consideration, and RPO disclosures.
  • Own the design, documentation, and operation of SOX controls across revenue and order-to-cash, and drive remediation where gaps are identified.
  • Partner with Deal Desk, Legal, Sales Systems, Order Operations, and Customer Success on non-standard deal structures ahead of signature, and on escalated customer billing matters.
  • Lead process and systems improvements across the order-to-cash cycle, partnering with Financial Systems on NetSuite and Salesforce enhancements and billing automation.
  • Own the revenue workstream for the annual audit and quarterly reviews, including walkthroughs, PBCs, and technical discussions with our auditors.
  • Prepare and review key internal revenue metrics, flux analysis, and commentary for finance leadership.
  • Lead ad-hoc projects and analyses as they arise.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 2+ years directly managing and developing people; public company and/or Big 4 experience preferred; 
  • BS/BA degree in Accounting
  • Deep working knowledge of ASC 606, including application to usage-based and multi-element SaaS arrangements
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present conclusions to senior leadership
  • Proven ability to influence and drive outcomes across cross-functional teams
  • Hands-on, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated to improve existing processes

Bonus Points:

  • CPA 
  • Usage-based or consumption billing experience at scale
  • Experience owning SOX controls in a revenue environment
  • Experience working with NetSuite and/or Salesforce
  • Experience with Snowflake, SQL, or Tableau

title: Senior Sales Engineer - AI Accounts
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Sales Engineer on Datadog's AI Accounts team, you'll serve as the technical lead for a small portfolio of the world's leading AI labs — accounts that today represent a meaningful share of Datadog's revenue and are growing faster than any cohort in our business. You'll own the technical relationship end to end, work shoulder-to-shoulder with customer engineering teams in production, and help define how Datadog shows up for a cohort whose buying behavior looks nothing like traditional enterprise.

This team was piloted earlier this year and is now being formalized. You'll be joining early enough to shape the playbook rather than inherit one.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical relationship across a small portfolio of AI labs, go deep on how each customer trains, serves, and scales their models (and/or the downstream products and platforms), and become the person their engineers call first
  • Partner with your AE to drive expansion inside accounts that grow unpredictably and fast: identify new workloads and teams as they spin up, and get in front of them before a need becomes a ticket
  • Lead discovery inside flat, engineering-led organizations where influence sits with individual contributors rather than titles, and where there are no formal scoping calls to rely on
  • Run full-scale POVs in production rather than controlled pilots: instrument real workloads at real scale, prove value against the customer's own success criteria, and work through the operational realities of doing that safely
  • Act as an extension of the customer’s engineering/observability team rather than an external operator - this requires judgment about which standard gates serve the customer and which to break
  • Work Slack-native and asynchronously as the default, with the responsiveness and proactive posture these accounts expect: flag new features, bugs, and incidents before they ask
  • Bring product and engineering in early and often, and close the loop fast — leadership needs near-real-time signal from this cohort, and you'll be a primary source of it
  • Deliver technical narratives that land with engineers who pay for capability first and rationalize cost second - savings is a downstream conversation, not an opener
  • Build reusable assets and patterns from each engagement so the next lab onboards faster than the last
  • Keep activity, deal progress, and customer context documented and current

Who You Are

  • 7+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a comparable technical customer-facing role; equivalent depth gained inside an AI lab, AI infrastructure company, or ML platform team is equally welcome
  • Hands-on depth in the AI/ML infrastructure stack: GPU fleet management, distributed training, inference serving, model and agent evaluation, and the observability challenges specific to each
  • Strong foundation in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM and distributed tracing, and modern, agentic observability practice and usage patterns (i.e. MCP)
  • Comfortable in flat organizations - able to engage an IC and a founder in the same week and calibrate to both without reaching for hierarchy
  • Biased toward doing: you'd rather solve a customer's problem and explain the shortcut afterward than ask permission first, and you have the judgment to know where that line sits
  • Thrive in ambiguity and unpredictable growth - scoping, timelines, and account trajectories will change under you, repeatedly
  • Actively coachable. The strongest people we hire ask for a dry run, take the feedback, and visibly change what they do on the next attempt
  • Persistent about access. Getting time with people operating at this pace is hard, and you treat that as an interesting problem rather than a demoralizing one
  • Demonstrated capability using AI tooling in your own workflow and scaling it to others — credibility with this cohort depends on being a practitioner, not an observer
  • Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement
  • Willing to travel for multi-day onsites with customer engineering teams and for industry and research conferences

descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Enterprise Sales Engineer, you’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to both customers and Sales. You’ll lead complex technical evaluations, align solutions to business outcomes, and help shape deal strategy in high-impact opportunities.

Work with the CSM and TAM to separate legitimate growth from misconfiguration, make sure legitimate growth gets quantified before renewal, and flag forward-looking usage the customer has signalled rather than explaining it backwards a month later.

  • Identify, develop, and leverage technical champions across multi-stakeholder environments, building a structured plan for champion cultivation and influence throughout the deal cycle and beyond
  • Contribute to product direction through active participation in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, bringing field insights and customer patterns to PM and engineering teams
  • Drive operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences

title: Compensation Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Team: 

At Datadog, People Operations is more than just human resources—it’s a data-driven team dedicated to constantly improving the way we hire, develop, and support our most valuable asset: our people. Our People team are strategic problem solvers who work closely with leadership and employees to ensure that Datadog keeps scaling smoothly and remains a great place to work.

The Opportunity:

As a Compensation Program Manager, you will combine compensation expertise, program management, analytics, systems thinking, and stakeholder management to help build and scale our compensation programs. You will own critical compensation processes from strategy and design through execution, communications, enablement, and continuous improvement.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both strategic problem solving and hands-on program execution, can translate complex compensation concepts into simple experiences for managers and employees, and thrives in a highly cross-functional environment.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute scalable compensation programs and processes, including compensation and equity cycles, governance, timelines, and tools, in partnership with People, Finance, HRIS, Payroll, Legal, and business leaders
  • Build dynamic compensation models and scenario analyses to support budgeting, workforce planning, and compensation design for cash/equity
  • Provide operational analysis, reporting, and insights related to compensation programs, trends, market data, and internal equity
  • Oversee compensation functionality and data in our systems and partner with HRIS and Analytics to continually enhance compensation and total rewards tooling
  • Lead communications and change management for compensation programs and processes, including FAQs, manager resources, training, and enablement
  • Partner cross-functionally to drive complex compensation initiatives from design through implementation and continuously improve processes and employee experience

Who You Are:

  • Five to seven years or more, of compensation or related experience
  • A flexible, low-ego approach to building and scaling the function, comfortable operating across high-level strategic program design and hands-on analytics, reporting, data cleanup, and operational execution
  • Experience managing compensation programs and annual cycles, including equity programs and/or other variable compensation
  • Strong analytical rigor and experience building dynamic models and scenario analyses
  • Experience implementing and using compensation benchmarking data, market pricing methodologies, reporting, and compensation technology
  • A good understanding of RSUs and other equity offerings
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to translate complex compensation concepts into digestible information for leaders and employees
  • A “systems” thinker oriented towards process improvement, scalability, and efficiency
