title: Research Manager - Foundation & World Models
descriptionHtml:
As a Research Manager within Datadog AI Research (DAIR), you will lead a team working on fundamental research in foundation models and world models while remaining deeply engaged in the technical direction of the work. You will advance large-scale pre-training and multimodal learning across the diverse signals generated by distributed systems, including metrics, traces, logs, topology, and events. You will provide technical leadership to a team of researchers and research engineers, mentor and develop highly technical talent, shape research direction, and collaborate with Datadog’s product and engineering teams to translate research advances into products. This role is designed for an exceptional researcher or technical leader who wants to maintain a strong hands-on research identity while developing and leading a high-performing team.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead research in foundation models, world models, and multimodal learning, setting the technical direction for ambitious research programs grounded in observability and security
  • Guide and mentor researchers and research engineers while remaining closely involved in research strategy, experimentation, model development, and technical problem-solving
  • Train large-scale multimodal models on diverse telemetry data, including metrics, logs, traces, topology, events, and other non-text modalities
  • Advance approaches to pre-training, representation learning, world modeling, scaling, and evaluation for models that learn the dynamics of complex distributed systems
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Research, Product, and Engineering to translate research advances into scalable Datadog capabilities
  • Contribute to research publications, present at top-tier conferences such as NeurIPS, ICLR, and ICML, and help open-source key model artifacts and benchmarks

Who You Are:

  • You hold a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or have equivalent experience, with deep expertise in areas such as foundation models, world models, multimodal learning, or generative modeling
  • You have demonstrated the ability to lead technically ambitious research at meaningful scale, whether in an industry research lab, startup, academic environment, or another research setting
  • You have extensive hands-on experience designing, training, or evaluating large-scale deep learning models (such as large language models), with experience in multimodal or non-text data considered a strong plus
  • You have a track record of research impact through influential publications, significant model or system contributions, widely used research artifacts, or equivalent technical achievements
  • You have operated at a senior technical level and have experience leading, mentoring, and developing teams of researchers or engineers, while remaining deeply hands-on in technical direction and execution
  • You want to develop and support a research team while maintaining a strong technical identity, and you can communicate complex research findings effectively across technical and non-technical audiences

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

title: Event Marketing Manager - Global Sponsorships (NAMER/LATAM)
descriptionHtml:
We are a fast-moving, analytically driven B2B marketing team. We show innovative companies how they can improve their applications and get to market faster. We do hundreds of events, thousands of marketing campaigns, research and evangelize ideas that move our industry forward, and more. We are a team of innovators that take exciting and unexpected ideas and bring them to life – and have fun while doing it!

Datadog is seeking an Event Marketing Manager to join our high-performing team and support third-party events and tradeshows across the North America and Latin America regions. As a key member of Datadog's Event Marketing team – the driving force behind our high-impact, experiential marketing programs – you will play a critical role in executing best-in-class events that generate leads, pipeline, and scale our brand presence. With hundreds of events run globally each year, this role requires someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of delivering high-quality event experiences, consistently meeting deadlines, and collaborating cross-functionally. If you're passionate about creating impactful brand experiences and excited to help shape Datadog's event footprint across NAMER & LATAM, we'd love to hear from you!

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead Datadog's end-to-end presence at large-scale third-party (sponsored) events in North America & LATAM regions, including strategy, planning, logistics, onsite execution, staffing, audience engagement, and performance measurement.

  • Enhance operational workflows by improving planning processes, lead capture mechanisms, reporting templates, and execution frameworks.
  • Track, analyze, and report on event KPIs, ROI, and budget accuracy; ensure data integrity and timely post-event follow-up.
  • Identify new event opportunities, market trends, and innovative experiential approaches to strengthen Datadog's presence in NAMER and LATAM.
  • Model calm, professional behavior in high-pressure situations and help foster a positive, proactive, and collaborative team environment.
  • Manage event logistics including vendor sourcing, booth configuration, shipping, asset coordination, and onsite operations.
  • Ensure seamless onsite execution through detailed planning, strong contingency management, and confident troubleshooting.
  • Travel up to 50% to support events in NAMER and LATAM.

Who You Are:

  • 4-6 years of event management experience in a high-tech, B2B, or fast-paced environment managing lead-generating events.
  • Experience running concurrent, multi-faceted events.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple events, deadlines, and budgets simultaneously.
  • Able to stay calm and professional in high-stress, fast-changing event environments.
  • Comfortable partnering closely with Sales and Product teams, resolving onsite issues, and communicating clearly with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Highly detail-oriented with strong reporting and analytical skills; proficiency with Salesforce, Tableau, Metabase, or similar tools required.
  • Comfortable using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) in daily workflows; curious about applying AI to streamline event planning, lead enrichment, and reporting.
  • Positive, proactive, team-oriented, and able to work independently with minimal oversight.
  • Comfortable with flexible hours, including evenings/weekends during event cycles.
  • Able to lift up to 25 lbs and stand for extended periods during events.

descriptionHtml:

We are seeking an Investor Relations Vice President to join Datadog. They will play a significant role in the design, creation, delivery, and communication of information to the investment community. They will be instrumental in the quarterly earnings process, including writing the press release and script, as well as preparing the management team for Q&A. They will also craft and execute investor outreach events in various formats, and meet with investors and prospective investors. In doing so, this cross-functional role will partner with many groups across the company to unify company messaging, including Finance, Legal, Product, and Marketing.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the quarterly earnings process, including writing the press release and script, and preparing management for Q&A; support and contribution to SEC filings and other public communications.
  • Plan and optimize the engagement with Datadog’s existing shareholders, while targeting new ones 
  • Understand financial statements and performance; formulate quarterly revenue and profit guidance, in partnership with FP&A
  • Lead our interaction with Datadog's 30+ covering sell-side research analysts, as well as analysts performing due diligence
  • Discuss company business model, financials, product innovation, GTM efforts, market opportunities, demand conditions, competitive environment, and long-term strategy with investors and analysts.
  • Ensure regular communication with existing top shareholders, while targeting new potential long-term shareholders
  • Prioritize and organize conferences and analyst sessions for IR/management to participate in or host
  • Organize additional investor outreach opportunities, including analyst/investor days, non-deal roadshows, presentations, bus tours, and other events.
  • Support the preparation of presentations, including board material, investor decks, and other presentations
  • Lead comps analyses versus other SaaS/software companies and other equity market analyses to understand Datadog’s valuation and positioning.
  • Support ad hoc analytical projects from management, finance, etc.

Who You Are and What You Have:

  • BA/BS in finance, accounting, economics, or engineering; MBA, CFA, or other advanced graduate degree or designation preferred
  • 10+ years of experience in investor relations, investment banking, equity research, or equity investing (or similar experience)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to speak confidently with executive leadership, investors, sell-side analysts, and others at senior and junior levels
  • Deep understanding of financial statements and metrics drivers, dependencies, and implications for analysis and forecasting
  • Ability to understand the nuances of Datadog’s business model, product, and market, to distill into investment narrative and investors’ tactical areas of interest
  • Knowledge and ability to discuss the evolution and business models in the enterprise software and cloud spaces
  • Highly proficient with Excel; ability and interest in learning analytical tools and software programming languages as needed
  • Experience at a high-growth tech company is a plus, but not required

title: Senior Procurement Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Procurement Operations to manage vendor onboarding and improve the systems and workflows that support the purchasing lifecycle.

You will guide vendors and internal stakeholders through onboarding requirements, coordinate reviews and approvals, maintain accurate data, and resolve issues that delay requests. You will also help improve Zip and related systems by identifying process gaps, documenting requirements, testing changes, and supporting automation and reporting.

This role is ideal for someone with strong operational judgment, a systems mindset, and the ability to manage a high volume of requests in an evolving environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage vendor onboarding requests from submission through completion.
  • Review submissions for completeness, accuracy, and required documentation.
  • Coordinate reviews, approvals, and follow-ups with Privacy, GRC, IT, Internal Audit, Legal, Finance, and other teams.
  • Help vendors and employees understand requirements, complete outstanding tasks, and resolve system issues.
  • Maintain accurate vendor records, approvals, contracts, documents, and audit trails across Zip and connected systems.
  • Monitor request volumes, aging, and cycle times, prioritizing urgent requests and escalating blockers.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Zip and related procurement systems.
  • Translate policies and business needs into clear requirements for workflows, routing, approvals, notifications, reporting, and exceptions.
  • Test system changes, document results, report defects, and support releases through training and communications.
  • Identify opportunities to improve P2P processes through data, AI, and automation.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in procure-to-pay, vendor management, finance, or purchasing operations.
  • Experience managing vendor onboarding or vendor lifecycle processes.
  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as Zip, Coupa, Oracle, NetSuite, DocuSign, Brex, Ramp, or similar tools.
  • Understanding of how vendor data, purchasing requests, contracts, purchase orders, invoices, approvals, and payments connect.
  • Experience maintaining accurate system data and resolving incomplete, inconsistent, or duplicate records.
  • Ability to document business requirements, test system changes, and work with technical teams to resolve issues.
  • Sound judgment when applying policies, managing exceptions, and escalating risks.
  • An analytical mindset and interest in using data, AI, and automation to improve processes.
  • Strong communication, organization, and prioritization skills.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience is preferred.

title: GTM Strategy & Operations Senior Associate
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Associate to join our growing GTM Strategy & Operations team as the product owner for our GTM data and tooling products. Our team solves complex problems that require insight, creativity, and execution through building scalable processes, tools, and systems for our rapidly growing global business. You will own the roadmap, delivery, and adoption of the data products and sales productivity tools that power our Sales and Customer Success organizations, spanning both internally built products and third-party solutions, with decisions guided by speed, cost, scalability, and long-term maintainability. Doing this successfully requires a deep understanding of the “day in the life” for field teams, strong product management instincts, and the ability to translate business needs into build-versus-buy decisions and tooling solutions that help Datadog grow 10x.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

You Will

  • Own the product roadmap: Set the vision, strategy, and prioritized roadmap for GTM data products and sales productivity tools. Balance field needs, business impact, technical feasibility, cost, and maintainability while making clear decisions about where to invest, consolidate, replace, or retire.
  • Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for in-house tools: Write requirements and user stories, define MVPs, establish acceptance criteria, manage the backlog, and partner with GTM Systems, Data Engineering, and Analytics to ship, iterate, and sunset internally built products.
  • Establish the product operating model: Create a consistent approach to intake, prioritization, roadmap planning, product ownership, release readiness, feedback collection, and lifecycle management across our portfolio of products.
  • Make build-versus-buy calls: Lead structured evaluations (e.g., RFPs, pilots, time-boxed POCs) of third-party tools against in-house alternatives, build business cases, and present investment recommendations to GTM leadership
  • Lead AI product strategy: Identify, evaluate, prototype, and scale AI-powered capabilities, whether built in-house or bought, that improve prospecting, enrichment, personalization, and rep workflows, and help define the forward-looking AI roadmap for the Sales and CS organizations
  • Measure impact: Define and track success metrics across every tool and data product (e.g., adoption, data quality, time saved, pipeline influenced) and use the findings to make data-driven decisions to invest, consolidate, or retire
  • Partner with the field: Work closely with Sales and Customer Success to uncover workflow pain points through interviews, workflow observation, usage analysis and feedback loops. Distinguish user problems from requested features and translate these opportunities into product improvements that directly increase rep productivity.
  • Lead launch and adoption: Own release planning, change management, and onboarding in collaboration with Sales Enablement so field teams get maximum value from every product
  • Ensure seamless integration: Work with GTM Systems to maintain and improve integrations between our tools, Salesforce CRM, and the broader GTM tech stack and data infrastructure
  • Set the standard: Build and enforce governance frameworks, acceptable use policies, and data hygiene standards across all managed tools and data products to ensure consistency and compliance

Requirements

  • Experience: 4-6+ years of experience in GTM Strategy & Operations, data or analytics roles, product management, or management consulting, ideally within SaaS or high-growth B2B technology
  • Product management fundamentals: Proven ability to take a product from problem definition through requirements, prioritization, launch, and iteration, including writing clear PRDs, user stories, scope tradeoffs, and communicating to technical and non-technical teams why the team will or will not invest in a request. 
  • Build-versus-buy judgment: Experience weighing in-house development against third-party solutions on cost, speed, scalability, and strategic fit, and making a clear recommendation
  • Data fluency: Strong understanding of GTM data (contacts, accounts, intent and enrichment signals) and the ability to define data quality standards; comfortable with SQL and working with data warehouses and BI tools to analyze usage and outcomes
  • AI innovation: Strong interest in exploring, launching, and scaling new GTM AI technologies, including practical experience prototyping or deploying AI-enabled workflows
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Strong track record of partnering with Sales, CS, Engineering, and Data teams to identify pain points and deliver solutions from requirements through rollout
  • Analytical mindset: Comfortable defining product metrics, measuring adoption and ROI, and communicating findings clearly to senior stakeholders
  • CRM knowledge: Solid understanding of Salesforce CRM and how data products and sales tools integrate into the broader GTM tech stack
  • Communication: Effective communicator, both written and verbal, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ownership mentality: Self-starter who takes initiative, operates independently, and drives projects through to completion without heavy oversight

Bonus Points

  • SaaS background: Experience at a high-growth B2B SaaS company managing a GTM or sales tool portfolio or an internal data product
  • AI passion: Stays current on the latest AI news, has a passion for experimentation, has fully integrated AI into professional workflows, and vibe codes on the weekend
  • Technical aptitude: Working knowledge of APIs and how sales tools connect to CRM systems and data infrastructure; has shipped a prototype or internal tool of their own
  • Tool fluency: Hands-on familiarity with the B2B sales technology landscape, including contact intelligence (e.g., ZoomInfo, Cognism), outbound sequencing (e.g., Groove, Salesloft, Outreach), and data enrichment tools (e.g., Clay, Clearbit, Crunchbase)
  • Broader stack exposure: Familiarity with adjacent tools such as buyer intent platforms (e.g., Bombora, G2) or conversation intelligence (e.g., Gong)
  • Full-funnel experience: Experience supporting tool adoption across Sales Development, Account Executive, and Customer Success teams

title: Senior Contracts Manager
descriptionHtml:
Your Role:

Datadog is seeking a Senior Contracts Manager based in our New York City office to review and negotiate vendor agreements, including those with non-standard terms and moderate complexity. This role will primarily support vendor transactions across the Americas while collaborating with global Procurement, Legal, and business teams on cross-regional matters. You will advise Procurement and internal stakeholders on contractual, commercial, operational, and compliance risks. You will also help improve contracting processes and support other members of the contracts team.

What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for Procurement and business leaders on supplier and service provider engagements across the Americas. Manage matters across the contract lifecycle, from intake through renewal or termination, and support global or cross-regional transactions as needed. 
  • Review and negotiate vendor agreements, with an emphasis on SaaS and technology-related vendor transactions. Handle moderately complex agreements independently and take on high-complexity agreements and novel issues with attorney or management support. Typical intake includes agreements for software, cloud services, AI tools, privacy, professional services and consulting, marketing and advertising, equipment purchase and rental (including maintenance), office operations and facilities, and benefits.
  • Partner with Product, Privacy, Security, and Procurement to assess risk and recommend practical positions. Advise stakeholders on gaps between proposed contract terms and the business’s technical and compliance requirements, balancing legal protection with operational and commercial goals. Use negotiation and influencing skills with senior stakeholders to resolve complex contract issues.
  • Interpret existing agreements and advise stakeholders on rights, obligations, renewals, amendments, termination, and risk exposure. Support resolution of vendor disputes by developing recommended positions and coordinating with Legal and business stakeholders.
  • Manage contract templates and negotiation playbooks, along with the policies and procedures behind them. Build self-service resources and workflow improvements that scale. Track and report key metrics for contracting process improvements and risk mitigation, and act on what they show.
  • Partner with the Legal Operations team to improve contracting technology, reporting, intake, and automation, including contract systems and AI-assisted contract review tools.
  • Mentor other contracts professionals and support their negotiations on non-standard terms. Train business stakeholders on contracting processes and policy compliance.

Who You Are:

  • At least 8 years of experience negotiating and advising on a broad range of commercial agreements, or 6 years with a master's degree in a relevant field.
  • Demonstrated experience negotiating SaaS, cloud, AI, privacy, security, and professional-services agreements, with working knowledge of data privacy and security issues in technology, benefits, marketing, and other vendor agreements. Experience with real estate contracting and vendor dispute resolution is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage moderately complex commercial matters independently, support high-complexity matters alongside attorneys or management, exercise sound judgment within established risk frameworks (including when to involve an attorney or manager), and develop practical solutions to non-standard issues.
  • A problem solver who identifies efficiency and scalability opportunities and leads their implementation.
  • Organized and process-driven, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple matters at once and reprioritize quickly when business needs change.
  • Curious and adaptable, with an aptitude for technology and legal operations tools.
  • A strong written and verbal communicator who collaborates effectively across functions.
  • A collaborative teammate who shares knowledge openly and pitches in when colleagues are stretched. Comfortable moving between big-picture strategy and hands-on drafting.

title: Senior Technology Partner Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Technology Partnerships Team at Datadog

About the Role

Datadog’s Technology Partnerships team builds and scales partnerships with the technology companies that matter most to our customers from AI/ML platforms to data platform providers. As a Technology Partner Engineer, you will be the technical bridge between Datadog and our partner developer community, acting as a consultant who helps partners build world-class monitoring solutions on the Datadog platform. You will be the primary technical contact for our partners, guiding them through the entire integration lifecycle from initial architectural design to final product integrations, and launching on the Datadog Marketplace. This is a unique role that combines deep technical troubleshooting with high-level consulting and platform advocacy, working directly with external developers and seeing your contributions immediately reflected in the Datadog ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Advisory: Act as the technical lead for partners, advising on OAuth flows, log pipelines, OpenTelemetry, and MCP-based and API-based integrations and configurations.
  • Co-Build: Partner closely with Datadog Partner, Product and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and drive joint integration roadmaps; ensure integrations are built, launched, and continuously improved to meet customer needs.
  • Architectural & Code Review: Perform architectural assessments and deep-dive code reviews for partner integrations and marketplace repositories, ensuring they meet Datadog’s quality rubric.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Solve complex technical challenges for partners via dedicated technical consultations.
  • Platform Advocacy: Identify friction points in the Datadog platform and partner with internal Product and Engineering teams to build a better developer experience.
  • Documentation & Tracking: Maintain public-facing developer documentation including blog posts, and internal tracking systems to ensure transparency and scale.
  • Market Awareness: Track trends across the AI/ML and data platform ecosystems to identify new partnership opportunities and ensure Datadog’s partner strategy stays ahead of a fast-moving market.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related field
  • A technical expert with 7+ years of experience in a technical role (Partner Engineering, Support Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Software Development).
  • Proficient in at least one programming language (Python or Go preferred).
  • An observability enthusiast who understands monitoring fundamentals (Metrics, Logs, Traces) and modern standards like OpenTelemetry.
  • A natural consultant with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to developers of varying skill levels.
  • A tinkerer who is comfortable working with APIs, Linux environments, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Someone who thrives in a hybrid work environment and values pragmatism, honesty, and simplicity.
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment with a bias toward action.
  • Bonus: Demonstrated ability to use AI coding tools in day-to-day workflows and validate, critique, and refine AI-generated output.
  • Bonus: Motivated to push the boundaries of how AI can improve software engineering best practices and contribute to building AI-enabled products.

title: Senior Technology Partner Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Datadog’s Technology Partnerships team builds and scales partnerships with the technology companies that matter most to our customers from AI/ML platforms to data platform providers. As a Technology Partner Manager, you will own the full, 360-degree relationship with a portfolio of strategic Technology Partners, with a particular focus on cutting-edge AI/ML and Data Platform companies. You’ll be the connective tissue across three pillars of partnership: co-build (joint product and integration roadmaps), co-market (joint awareness and demand generation), and co-sell (joint pipeline and revenue). This is a highly cross-functional, relationship-driven role that requires equal comfort in a product roadmap discussion, a marketing planning session, and a sales enablement meeting.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do

  • 360° Relationship Ownership: Own the end-to-end partner relationship for a portfolio of AI/ML and Data Platform technology partners, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor across product, engineering, marketing, and sales stakeholders on both sides.
  • Co-Build: Partner closely with Datadog Product and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and drive joint integration roadmaps; ensure integrations are built, launched, and continuously improved to meet customer needs.
  • Co-Market: Design and execute joint marketing programs including webinars, blog posts, customer case studies, launch campaigns, and event collaboration with Datadog product marketing and partner marketing teams to build awareness and demand for joint solutions.
  • Co-Sell: Build and execute go-to-market and co-sell plans with Datadog channel team, partner field and sales teams; enable Datadog’s global sales organization and partner sellers on joint value propositions, use cases, and co-sell motions to drive pipeline and revenue.
  • Program Management: Track partnership commitments, joint business plans, and success metrics across the co-build, co-market, and co-sell pillars; report regularly to leadership on partnership health, pipeline, and revenue impact.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Act as the connective tissue between partners and internal Datadog teams including Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Channels & Alliances to keep joint initiatives moving and unblock issues quickly.
  • Marketplace & Routes to Market: Ensure Datadog integrations are well-represented in partner marketplaces and directories, and identify new routes to market with partners, including joint listings on cloud and partner marketplaces.
  • Enablement: Create and maintain internal and partner-facing content including playbooks, battlecards, and training  that helps both organizations clearly articulate the joint value proposition.
  • Market Awareness: Track trends across the AI/ML and data platform ecosystems to identify new partnership opportunities and ensure Datadog’s partner strategy stays ahead of a fast-moving market.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field; an MBA is a strong plus.
  • 7+ years of experience in technology partnerships, alliances, partner management, or business development at a software, cloud, or SaaS company.
  • Experience managing the full partnership lifecycle including technical/product collaboration, marketing programs, and sales/co-sell motions 
  • Comfortable working with technical products; able to understand integration architectures and translate them into clear business value for marketing and sales audiences.
  • Familiarity with the AI/ML and/or data platform ecosystem (e.g., LLM providers, vector databases, data warehouses, data pipeline and orchestration tools) 
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with external partners and internal stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.
  • Strong program and project management skills; able to juggle multiple partner relationships and initiatives simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to create compelling partner-facing and internal enablement materials.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to utilize data to inform and drive strategic partnership decisions.
  • Excellent negotiation and executive-level relationship management skills; an outstanding communicator.
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment with a bias toward action.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

  • Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space

title: Product Solutions Architect - FinOps
descriptionHtml:
The Product Solutions Architecture (PSA) team acts as a technical multiplier across Datadog. PSAs are domain experts who partner with Field teams on complex customer use cases across pre- and post-sales engagements and scale their impact by producing reusable collateral, including reference architectures, technical guides, and enablement assets. By feeding real-world customer insights back to Datadog Product teams, PSAs help influence product roadmaps while accelerating adoption, usage, and long-term customer success.

Datadog's Cloud Cost Management (CCM) suite helps Platform, Application Teams, Operations, FinOps, and Finance teams understand, allocate, and reduce cloud spend by putting cost data next to the observability data that explains it. As a Product Solutions Architect, you will partner closely with Datadog customers and the Cloud Cost Management product team to design product use cases, implement best practices, and drive adoption of CCM across customer environments. This includes infrastructure cost allocation, cloud costs, token usage, container costs, budgets, and optimization recommendations.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the in-house subject matter expert for Datadog's Cloud Cost Management products, including cost visibility across AWS, Azure, and GCP, Kubernetes and container cost allocation, custom and SaaS cost ingestion, budgets, anomaly detection, and cost optimization recommendations
  • Provide architectural guidance on capacity planning, comparing cloud service cost models, and balancing performance vs. cost trade-offs across different cloud environments
  • Guide customers on tokenomics and AI cost attribution across providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini, Vertex AI, and GitHub Copilot), helping teams map API keys, models, and usage to teams and business units using Tag Pipelines.
  • Help enterprise clients track real-time AI spend changes, set up cost anomaly monitoring, and connect token usage back to business outcomes and unit economics (such as cost per user or cost per ticket).
  • Partner with Field teams to provide hands-on technical and architectural guidance to enterprise customers adopting CCM, including designing tagging and cost allocation strategies, showback and chargeback models, and cost reporting that connects spend to services, teams, and business units
  • Create high-impact technical collateral, including reference architectures, technical guides, blog articles, and documentation to enable Field teams and the broader customer community, covering topics like cloud billing data onboarding (AWS, Azure, GCP billing), Kubernetes cost attribution, token usage, unit economics, and rightsizing and commitment optimization
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Product Management by delivering actionable feedback informed by real-world field experience, helping shape the roadmap for cost allocation, multi-cloud cost visibility, token usage, optimization workflows, and FinOps integrations

Who You Are

  • You bring a strong engineering foundation, with hands-on experience managing, allocating, or optimizing cloud spend, or building FinOps programs and internal cost tooling in production environments at a large scale, and are comfortable diving deep into billing data and architectural tradeoffs to understand what drives cost
  • You are familiar with cloud infrastructure and core observability concepts, such as tracing, metrics, and logging, and understand how compute, storage, networking, and container platforms (including Kubernetes) translate into cloud bills
  • Deep understanding of cost models, performance characteristics, and capacity planning across various cloud services and managed platforms
  • Experience with languages such as Python and/or SQL, and familiarity with querying and modeling large billing datasets, tagging strategies, and infrastructure-as-code
  • Comfortable operating in rapidly evolving, ambiguous technical domains
  • You build deep context across teams and translate it into reusable, scalable solutions
  • You take ownership from problem definition through implementation and measurable outcomes
  • Highly detail-oriented, particularly when working on architectures and customer-facing technical assets
  • You bring strong listening and consultative skills and are experienced supporting customers across engineering, FinOps, and finance stakeholders, including in high-stakes situations such as cost spikes, budget overruns, and commitment planning
  • Demonstrates capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it 
  • Able to sit up to 4 hours, traveling to and from client sites
  • Able to travel via auto, train, or air up to 40% of the time

Bonus Points

  • Successful track record with 5+ years experience working as a Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or FinOps practitioner supporting cloud cost management, FinOps, or cloud financial optimization tools (e.g., Cloudability, CloudHealth, Vantage, Kubecost, native AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, or GCP Billing)
  • Experience using Datadog and/or other observability tools in an SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering capacity, particularly owning cloud cost accountability or building internal cost reporting and automation
  • Familiarity with FinOps Foundation practices, and with commitment management such as Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and committed use discounts
  • FinOps certification (e.g., FinOps Certified Practitioner) is a plus

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

title: Manager I, Engineering - Anomaly Detection
descriptionHtml:
The Anomaly Detection team’s mission is to build scalable, cost effective systems that can automatically detect anomalies in our customers’ system telemetry. The ultimate goal is to be  able to intelligently find problems in system telemetry proactively without the need for our customers to set up or configure specific alarms or alerts. This is a chance to work on a team that sits at the intersection of distributed systems and machine learning and applying those techniques at massive scale to serve a real world customer need.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Lead and develop an existing engineering team of 8; building trust, setting technical direction, and establishing a high bar for ownership and execution
  • Own the roadmap and execution for our key signal finding systems
  • Work closely with product management and applied scientists to build an effective detection system and the right evaluation mechanisms to ensure the quality of our signals
  • Build and operate both traditional machine learning and LLM based systems in production at scale
  • Drive the team's AI-native development practices, setting high standards for safety, validation, and increasing agent autonomy over time

title: Manager I, Engineering - Language Platform
descriptionHtml:
Application Performance Monitoring (APM) is one of Datadog’s premier products that helps developers see inside complex distributed systems. Our SDKs are both the delivery vehicle for APM and the platform on which all of Datadog’s service and app based products (e.g. Application Security Management, Profiling, Data Stream Monitoring…) are delivered. We believe our SDKs are one of our technical moats and are a key competitive advantage for APM and Datadog more broadly. They’re also open-source.

Leading the evolution of our SDKs is a technically demanding and highly collaborative effort. You’ll work with language experts to deliver cutting-edge observability products across our 9 supported languages, with industry leading performance and a world class developer experience. You’ll rethink our SDKs’ architecture, APIs, data models, and protocol to meet Datadog’s current needs and scale, all while building in the open. And you’ll grow your team’s capacity by fostering a culture focused on customer needs, continuous learning, and innovation. 

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager who cares as much about technical excellence as empowering other engineering teams. 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, grow, and develop a team of roughly 4-8 library engineers — coaching, giving direct feedback, and empowering senior ICs as technical leaders owning outcomes
  • Own team delivery and productivity: planning, milestones, reviews
  • Collaborate with Product teams to:
    • Reshape and grow our platform capabilities to enable product teams 
    • Define and deliver industry leading, open-source, zero-touch APM instrumentation
  • Stay technically close to the work — apply strong technical judgment, set a high standard for quality, contribute code where it matters most, and keep quality and architecture high
  • Build strong relationships and drive alignment across the language teams and product, backend
  • Shape team identity and culture

Who you are

  • An experienced Engineering Manager with a track record of shipping 
  • A strong and empathetic leader with the ability to build and lead high-performing teams to deliver high quality software
  • An ability pivot from high level product narratives to highly technical implementation details 
  • You have significant programming experience in one or more of: Go, C, Rust
  • Bonus: If you possess experience with one or more of these skills: systems programming experience, observability tooling experience, experience shipping client side software, Go runtime expertise

title: Manager II, Engineering - Datadog Agent SDLC
descriptionHtml:
The Datadog Agent is our flagship open-source project and a critical part of how customers experience Datadog, with hundreds of engineers contributing annually across multiple languages and platforms. As Manager II, Engineering for Datadog Agent SDLC, you will lead the systems, tooling, and developer experience that enable engineers to build, test, secure, and ship software that runs in customer environments. You will guide the evolution of our software development lifecycle as AI coding tools reshape how software is developed, while strengthening our approach to software supply-chain security, build infrastructure, correctness, and performance. This is an opportunity to shape engineering practices for the Agent and establish patterns that can influence other open-source projects across Datadog.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the engineering teams responsible for the Agent developer experience, build systems, correctness, and performance benchmarking platforms
  • Own software supply-chain security for a public repository that ships into customer infrastructure - provenance, signing, dependency and contribution review, and the new risks coding agents introduce
  • Evolve the Agent software development lifecycle to support hundreds of contributors while improving developer velocity, reliability, and security
  • Drive AI coding enablement across the Agent ecosystem, adapting development workflows and infrastructure as engineers increasingly work alongside coding agents
  • Guide the evolution of build infrastructure for a complex, multi-language, multi-platform codebase, including the continued adoption and development of modern build systems
  • Hire, mentor, and develop engineering managers and staff engineers across multiple geographies

Who You Are:

  • An engineering leader with experience owning software development lifecycle systems and developer infrastructure
  • First-hand experience with AI coding tools and flows, excited by the opportunities and mindful of challenges created by AI-assisted software development
  • Curious about the art of proving software correct: deterministic simulation testing, fault injection, property-based testing, continuous performance benchmarking
  • Familiar with complex multi-language development environments, CI/CD, remote build execution and caching; experience with Bazel or similar build systems is a plus
  • Experienced leading multiple teams through technical and organizational change while balancing roadmap velocity, reliability, security, and long-term platform investments
  • A proven track record scaling exceptional engineering teams: hiring, coaching, performance management, and building appropriate team structures globally

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

title: Staff Research Scientist - Post-Training for Agents
descriptionHtml:
As a Staff Research Scientist within Datadog AI Research (DAIR), you will drive work on fundamental research in post-training and multimodal observability-native decision models as a hands-on individual contributor. You will advance post-training approaches, simulated environments, synthetic data generation, and evaluation methods for agents operating across complex real-world systems. You will help set the technical direction for ambitious research programs, raise the technical bar for the researchers and research engineers around you, and collaborate with Datadog's product and engineering teams to translate research advances into products.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive post-training research for multimodal decision models and hybrid decision/generative systems to address ambitious research challenges in observability and security.
  • Own research problems end to end, from framing the question through experimentation, model development, and evaluation
  • Design and advance post-training methods and training loops for models operating in complex environments
  • Build simulated environments, synthetic data generation approaches, and evaluation frameworks that enable scalable model training and rigorous measurement
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Research, Product, and Engineering to translate research advances into scalable Datadog capabilities
  • Share research findings with external audiences upon reaching significant project milestones.

Who You Are:

  • You hold a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or have equivalent experience, with deep expertise in areas such as AI agents, decision models, post-training, or generative modeling
  • You have driven technically ambitious research at meaningful scale as an individual contributor, whether in an industry research lab, startup, academic environment, or another research setting
  • You have extensive hands-on experience designing or implementing training methods, simulated environments, synthetic data pipelines, or evaluation frameworks
  • You have a track record of research impact through influential publications, significant model or system contributions, widely used research artifacts, or equivalent technical achievements
  • You have operated at a senior technical level and have experience leading, You set technical direction through influence rather than authority, and you have mentored other researchers or engineers and elevated the quality of work around you
  • You want to stay deeply hands-on in research for the long term, and you can communicate complex research findings effectively across technical and non-technical audiences

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

title: Staff Research Scientist - Foundation & World Models
descriptionHtml:
As a Staff Research Scientist within Datadog AI Research (DAIR), you will drive fundamental research in foundation models and multimodality as a hands-on individual contributor. You will advance large-scale pre-training and multimodal learning across the diverse signals generated by distributed systems, including metrics, traces, logs, topology, and events. You will help set the technical direction for ambitious research programs, raise the technical bar for the researchers and research engineers around you, and collaborate with Datadog's product and engineering teams to translate research advances into products.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive research in foundation models and multimodal learning, shaping the technical direction for ambitious research programs grounded in observability and security
  • Own research problems end to end, from framing the question through experimentation, model development, and evaluation
  • Train large-scale multimodal models on diverse telemetry data, including metrics, logs, traces, topology, events, and other non-text modalities
  • Advance approaches to pre-training, representation learning, scaling, and evaluation for models that learn the dynamics of complex distributed systems
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Research, Product, and Engineering to translate research advances into scalable Datadog capabilities
  • Share research findings with external audiences upon reaching significant project milestones.

Who You Are:

  • You hold a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or have equivalent experience, with deep expertise in areas such as foundation models, world models, multimodal learning, or generative modeling
  • You have driven technically ambitious research at meaningful scale as an individual contributor, whether in an industry research lab, startup, academic environment, or another research setting
  • You have extensive hands-on experience designing, training, or evaluating large-scale deep learning models (such as large language models), with experience in multimodal or non-text data considered a strong plus
  • You have a track record of research impact through influential publications, significant model or system contributions, widely used research artifacts, or equivalent technical achievements
  • You set technical direction through influence rather than authority, and you have mentored other researchers or engineers and elevated the quality of work around you

title: Senior Design Manager - AI Monitoring & Management
descriptionHtml:
This team owns what it takes for an organization to trust the AI it runs in production, from the GPU infrastructure that trains and serves models, to the agents and LLM systems built on top of it, to the cost and return those systems deliver to the business. When something fails, this team's work explains why and shows how it's affecting the outcomes customers actually care about. It's a fast-moving space with few established patterns, which gives this team real room to define what best-in-class looks like.

As Senior Design Manager, you'll lead a team of four designers across these three connected product areas, going deep enough on the domain (AI training and development workflows, evaluations, GPU infrastructure, agent debugging) to raise the quality bar, sharpen the product point of view, and mentor the team already doing this work. This is a leadership role built around modern, AI-native design practice: you'll lead and grow a team that builds directly in code rather than handing off static mocks, and you should have the capability to prototype and ship yourself where it has the most impact.

What You'll Do:

  • Go deep on the domain (AI training/development workflows, evals, GPU infrastructure, agent debugging) to the point of having independent, well-informed points of view
  • Drive end-to-end product experiences across Agent Observability, GPU Monitoring, and Agent Console, ensuring coherence across the three surfaces
  • Prototype and ship directly in code where it has the most impact, to demonstrate direction and quality, not as a substitute for the team's own execution
  • Lead and coach a team of four designers, raising their craft, product thinking, and fluency building with AI-native tools
  • Conduct regular 1:1s and career conversations; foster psychological safety and a culture of continuous improvement
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape strategy, prioritization, and roadmap direction
  • Set and maintain a high bar for design quality across all output, including interaction design, visual design, coded prototypes, and user testing, and lead design critiques within the domain

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years in product design roles, with 3+ years in a design management or leadership position
  • Portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design ownership and deep domain expertise in at least one complex area

  • Strong communication and influence skills; able to partner effectively with senior-level PMs and Engineers
  • Experience designing complex, data-heavy products

descriptionHtml:
The Incident and Escalation Management team (IEM) is part of Datadog's Global Support Engineering (GSE) organization. IEM exists to continuously improve Datadog's overall customer experience during incidents and other critical moments. We're looking for experts with a background in incident management and escalation handling to provide fast incident response, clear ownership, and calm, confident communication for our global customer base.

In this individual contributor role, you will play a key part in customer communication, technical engagement, and incident management for our global customers. You will also implement processes and automations, use the same incident and case management tools we build for our customers, and help shape how they evolve.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture — the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive incidents and escalations to resolution from start to finish, including triage, coordination with our support, engineering and product teams. Own the response and keep customers and internal teams informed throughout.
  • Independently coordinate cross-functional stakeholders through complex incidents and escalations, making the call on prioritization, response strategy, and when to pull in additional teams or leadership.
  • Own communications during active incidents, including sensitive, large-scale, and publicly visible events, adapting the message for customers, internal teams, and leadership.
  • Lead projects that deliver operational improvements to how IEM detects, manages, and communicates during incidents and escalations as Datadog and its products evolve.
  • Create, maintain, and improve incident and escalation documentation, runbooks, and training materials, and lead retrospectives that turn individual incidents into durable process change.
  • Mentor peers on incident and escalation management best practices, and contribute to interviewing and hiring.

As the first dedicated analyst hire supporting Datadog's hosting cost and cloud margin function, you will own key components of the recurring reporting, close, and forecasting processes that provide visibility into one of Datadog’s largest and most strategically important cost areas. title: Senior Network Engineer, Office Technology
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Office Technology team designs, deploys, and operates the network infrastructure that keeps Datadog’s global offices connected, secure, and reliable. The team owns routing, switching, wireless, office firewalls, connectivity, and the observability and operational practices needed to provide a dependable employee experience at scale.

About the Role

As a Senior Network Engineer on the Office Technology team, you will own major network services and complex multi-site initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation, migration, and stable operations. You will act as a technical anchor for the team, leading design reviews and difficult troubleshooting, improving standards and automation, and helping other engineers deliver high-quality work.

This is a senior level role that combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership. You will shape team roadmap proposals and technical decisions through evidence and clear tradeoffs, while remaining accountable for reliable delivery and day-to-day operability.

What You’ll Do

  • Design resilient, scalable solutions across LAN, Wi-Fi, routing, switching, and office firewalls, with explicit failure domains, capacity assumptions, security controls, and migration paths
  • Author RFCs and lead design reviews, clearly documenting goals, constraints, alternatives, decisions, risks, validation, rollout, and rollback
  • Build production readiness into network changes through meaningful service objectives, monitoring, alerting, runbooks, capacity planning, failure testing, and operational handoff
  • Design reusable automation for provisioning, configuration, policy, compliance, telemetry, and change validation, with appropriate testing, peer review, drift detection, staged rollout, and safe rollback
  • Own, alongside other senior engineers and leadership, the health and lifecycle of major network services, using data to improve reliability, coverage, performance, security, supportability, and cost
  • Lead difficult incidents and root-cause investigations, communicate clearly during high-impact events, and ensure follow-up work addresses systemic causes
  • Evaluate technology and vendor options and make pragmatic recommendations grounded in operability, security, scalability, and business impact
  • Partner closely with Security, IT Support, Endpoints, AV, Workplace, Construction, Infrastructure teams, and external vendors on cross-functional initiatives
  • Mentor other engineers, delegate effectively, improve team standards and documentation, and raise the quality of design and operational practices
  • Participate in operational support, incident response, and planned maintenance activities as appropriate for the team

Who You Are

  • A deeply experienced, hands-on network engineer with strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, wireless, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and enterprise network security
  • Experienced designing and operating resilient network infrastructure across distributed offices or campus environments
  • Skilled at diagnosing complex issues using packet captures, logs, flow data, dashboards, and vendor telemetry, and at reasoning from protocols and failure modes
  • Comfortable building maintainable automation using scripting, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, version control, testing, and CI/CD practices
  • Strong in production engineering practices, including observability, service objectives, capacity planning, change safety, incident response, and post-incident improvement
  • Able to take ambiguous problems from problem statement to durable solution, balancing reliability, security, user experience, cost, and delivery speed
  • A clear, concise communicator who can lead technical discussions, explain tradeoffs, and build alignment with technical and non-technical partners
  • A thoughtful mentor who raises the quality of others’ work without becoming a bottleneck or creating unnecessary process
  • Responsible in your use of AI-assisted engineering tools: you protect sensitive data, validate outputs, and know when deterministic automation is the safer choice

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Datadog or other observability platforms, including network device monitoring, flow analytics, synthetic testing, and service-level reporting
  • Experience with Python, Ansible, Terraform, Git-based workflows, or network automation frameworks
  • Experience with network access control, RADIUS or 802.1X, segmentation, VPNs, or identity-aware and zero-trust networking
  • Experience delivering global office expansions, infrastructure refreshes, or complex migrations in a rapidly scaling organization

To conform to US export control regulations, candidates should be eligible for any required authorizations from the US government. This job is available in various departments within our company; to conform to US export control regulations, some of these roles may require candidates to be eligible for any required authorizations from the US government.

title: Technical Program Manager, Technical Solutions
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a motivated and experienced Technical Program Manager to join Datadog’s Technical Solutions organization. This organization is made up of 1,200+ customer-facing technical experts around the world — including Sales Engineers, Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, and Solution Architects — who work with prospects and customers throughout their journey with Datadog to deliver outstanding experiences and drive growth through product adoption.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will lead and support a variety of technical programs that help these customer-facing teams work more effectively. Depending on the needs of the organization, this could include programs related to internal tooling, process improvement, knowledge and content systems, or other cross-functional initiatives. You’ll partner closely with team leads, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders to bring structure and clarity to moderately complex, cross-team programs, and you’ll act as a multiplier for the teams you support by driving programs from planning through delivery. Candidates who have previously led projects for customer-facing technical teams are especially encouraged to apply.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive delivery of cross-team programs that support one or more Technical Solutions teams — coordinating stakeholders, dependencies, and timelines to keep work on track from kickoff through delivery.
  • Partner with team leads, subject matter experts, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate program goals into clear, actionable plans, and document scope, timeline, and quality expectations along the way.
  • Establish and maintain program management fundamentals — project trackers, status updates, risk logs — so stakeholders always have visibility into progress and blockers.
  • Identify unclear or incomplete requirements early and bring structure to ambiguous problems, escalating only when needed to keep execution on track.
  • Use data to track progress against milestones, surface risks, and guide decisions; adjust plans as circumstances change.
  • Apply AI tools to streamline your own program management workflows — synthesizing updates, surfacing patterns in program data, or accelerating documentation — and help identify where AI can improve processes for the teams you support.
  • Communicate program status, risks, and impact clearly to stakeholders at different levels, adapting your message for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Look for opportunities to improve how programs and processes run, and contribute ideas that make execution more efficient over time.

Who You Are

  • Program Management Experience: 3-5 years of experience leading technical programs in a SaaS or technical environment, ideally including cross-team or cross-functional initiatives. Experience supporting customer-facing or technical support functions is a plus.
  • Execution-Oriented: Comfortable driving moderately complex, cross-team initiatives independently, with the judgment to seek guidance on larger or more ambiguous efforts. Solid foundation in project scoping, timeline management, and risk management; PMP, Agile training, or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Data-Informed: Tracks progress against established metrics and uses data to guide decisions, report status, and identify risks early.
  • Clear Communicator: Able to convey project status and ideas concisely to a range of audiences, from peers to senior stakeholders, adapting the level of detail as needed.
  • Collaborative: Builds trust through consistent delivery; works constructively across teams to resolve differing viewpoints and unblock progress.
  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: Able to identify unclear requirements, ask the right questions, and bring structure to partially-defined problems.
  • AI Fluency: Uses AI tools confidently in day-to-day program work and can evaluate where AI can be responsibly and effectively applied to improve program processes.

title: Research Manager - Post-Training for Observability Native Models
descriptionHtml:
As a Research Manager within Datadog AI Research (DAIR), you will lead a team working on fundamental research in post-training and multimodal observability-native decision models while remaining deeply engaged in the technical direction of the work. You will advance post-training approaches, simulated environments, synthetic data generation, and evaluation methods for agents operating across complex real-world systems. You will provide technical leadership to a team of research scientists and engineers, mentor and develop highly technical talent, shape research direction, and collaborate with Datadog’s product and engineering teams to translate research advances into products. This role is designed for an exceptional researcher or technical leader who wants to maintain a strong hands-on research identity while developing and leading a high-performing team.


At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.


What You'll Do:

  • Lead post-training research for multimodal decision models and hybrid decision/generative systems to address ambitious research challenges in observability and security.
  • Guide and mentor researchers and research engineers while remaining closely involved in research strategy, experimentation, model development, and technical problem-solving
  • Design and advance post-training methods and training loops for models operating in complex environments
  • Build simulated environments, synthetic data generation approaches, and evaluation frameworks that enable scalable model training and rigorous measurement
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Research, Product, and Engineering to translate research advances into scalable Datadog capabilities
  • Share research findings with external audiences upon reaching significant project milestones.


Who You Are:

  • You hold a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or have equivalent experience, with deep expertise in areas such as AI agents, decision models, post-training, or generative modeling
  • You have demonstrated the ability to lead technically ambitious research at meaningful scale, whether in an industry research lab, startup, academic environment, or another research setting
  • You have extensive hands-on experience designing or implementing training methods, simulated environments, synthetic data pipelines, or evaluation frameworks
  • You have a track record of research impact through influential publications, significant model or system contributions, widely used research artifacts, or equivalent technical achievements

title: Senior Manager, Product Design - Security
descriptionHtml:
The Datadog Security design team (K9 Design, as we lovingly call it) is hiring a senior product design manager to lead design across our security products. This is a chance to shape an industry-leading experience for a new kind of Datadog user: security practitioners who need to catch threats where they start, stop them when they land, and shut down exposures before they turn into something worse.

You'll lead a team of designers at various stages of their careers across cloud, code and data security, turning an overwhelming amount of signal into something a security team can act on. The goal: build the security product people want to spend their day in. You'll own the design, push for excellence, and partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to get there.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What you’ll do

  • Lead design direction across your team's products, and hold the bar for design excellence end to end: interactions, visual detail, consistency and cohesion.
  • You're in the work. Run critiques, give direct and useful feedback, and push the team toward bolder, more opinionated solutions rather than safe ones.
  • Coach and grow designers across our Paris, Madrid and New York offices, helping each of them do the best work of their careers.
  • Help define a security design system built on top of Datadog's existing components, with the security practitioner's workflows in mind.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to evolve cross-platform thinking, shape roadmaps, and to set how the three disciplines work together day to day.
  • Take accountability for the product and business outcomes your team's design work influences.
  • Bring AI fluency to how your team works, from how design gets explored and validated to how it gets shipped.

Who you are

  • 10+ years in design, including experience leading and growing high-performing teams.

title: Manager II, Developer Advocacy
descriptionHtml:
Developer Advocates at Datadog are engineers who share their expertise with technical practitioners, help customers tell their stories, and represent the perspectives of our community inside Datadog.

As a Manager II on the Advocacy team, you will lead our Community Advocacy functions. You will manage a team of Developer Advocates responsible for global programs such as Datadog Ambassadors, Champions, and User Groups, as well as opportunities for customer engineers to share their expertise through technical writing, public speaking, and other community contributions.


Across these interconnected programs, your team will enable customer engineers to contribute technical knowledge, lead communities, and turn their experiences into compelling content and conference talks for Datadog and third-party channels. This role combines people leadership, program strategy, technical judgment, and cross-functional influence to amplify authentic customer voices, deepen understanding of Datadog and its products, and foster a thriving community of practitioners.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Lead and develop a team of Developer Advocates, setting clear expectations, guiding priorities, coaching performance, supporting career growth, and fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture
  • Own the strategy, goals, and roadmap for Community Advocacy, translating broader Advocacy and company priorities into focused programs and measurable outcomes
  • Guide the continued development of our Ambassador, Champion, and User Group programs, creating clear contributor journeys, expectations, enablement, recognition, and opportunities for customer engineers to increase their impact
  • Build repeatable systems that enable customer engineers to contribute technical knowledge, create content, share best practices, and serve as trusted leaders within their communities
  • Develop a strong pipeline of customer stories by identifying compelling practitioners and helping them shape authentic, technically credible narratives
  • Oversee the support, co-development, and coaching of conference talks by customer engineers—from identifying an idea and developing an abstract through content review, rehearsal, and delivery—for Datadog events, including our flagship user conference, DASH, as well as third-party industry conferences
  • Establish measures of success for Community Advocacy, using qualitative and quantitative insights to evaluate program health, contributor engagement, content quality, audience impact, and customer outcomes
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, Customer Success, and regional teams to align priorities, identify opportunities, and scale customer participation across Datadog initiatives
  • Ensure insights from Ambassadors, Champions, User Group participants, speakers, and other community members are shared with the appropriate teams inside Datadog, strengthening the connection between our customers and our products
  • Balance strategic leadership with selective hands-on contribution, including coaching speakers, reviewing technical content, participating in community programs, and representing Datadog when appropriate

Who You Are: 

  • You are an experienced people manager who has led autonomous technical professionals, coached performance, developed talent, and translated complex goals into achievable plans
  • You have experience defining and delivering successful developer advocacy, developer relations, technical community, or a related functions
  • You have built or meaningfully contributed to programs that enable external practitioners to participate, contribute, create content, or lead communities at scale
  • You have experience helping technical practitioners develop and communicate their stories, including coaching conference speakers or co-developing technically credible talks and content
  • You are a former software developer, SRE, or other technical practitioner—or have equivalent technical depth—with the judgment needed to assess technical accuracy and coach effective technical narratives
  • You are a thoughtful cross-functional leader who can build alignment, make prioritization decisions, and influence partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, and customer-facing organizations
  • You use both data and community insight to evaluate program effectiveness, identify opportunities, and make decisions about where the team should invest
  • You understand how to build trust with technical communities and value authentic practitioner voices over purely promotional messaging
  • You are comfortable operating through ambiguity, establishing structure where needed, and evolving programs as Datadog’s products, customers, and technical audiences grow

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.
