title: Manager, Global Entity Management
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Datadog employs roughly 8,100 people across 35 countries through global subsidiaries, all under a Nevada parent. Some are operating companies. Others came to us through acquisitions. We open in new markets often enough that the structure is always moving, and we manage it in Diligent Entities. This role owns it.

The work is entity formation and maintenance in many jurisdictions, corporate records and statutory filings, and daily coordination with the Finance, Tax and People teams. You will deal directly with government agencies, registries, registered agents and local counsel around the world. You will also be the person the rest of the company asks whenever a question touches our corporate structure.

The role sits in Legal Operations, and you will report to our Senior Director, Legal Operations, who has supported entity management operations in the past. Our Associate General Counsel, Corporate & Securities owns the work product and sets the standards for entity management and for our securities filings. Legal Operations runs the function; Corporate & Securities owns the substance.

The placement also gives you breadth. Legal Operations covers legal technology and systems, process design, outside counsel and spend operations, restricted party and sanctions screening, product legal support, and the department's AI work. We expect to cross-train you across those areas over time, and to cross-train colleagues into entity work. Entity management will remain the substantial majority of this job.

On AI in particular, Legal Operations is where most of that work happens for the legal department. We look at how our current tools could be used better, we assess new ones, and we look for ways to extend AI into systems that were never built with it in mind. If you look at a manual process and wonder whether software should be doing it, there is room here for that.

On the securities side of the role

You will also handle Section 16 filings (Forms 3, 4 and 5), Forms 144 and Rule 10b5-1 plan administration, supervised by our Associate General Counsel, Corporate & Securities, who trains the team on it. Prior public company reporting experience is welcome but not required. We have trained people into this work before and it went well. What we need is someone who wants to learn it and who will hold the deadlines once trained.

What you will do

Global entity management: the core of the role

  • Entity lifecycle. Manage formations, foreign qualifications, branch registrations, conversions, mergers, dissolutions, liquidations and deregistrations for our US and international entities, working with outside service providers and local counsel in each jurisdiction.
  • Good standing. Keep every entity in good standing wherever it operates. That covers annual reports and returns, statutory filings and business licenses. It also covers records for registered agents and agents for service of process, and the local compliance requirements that differ by country.
  • Government agencies and registries. Deal directly with company registries, tax authorities, chambers of commerce and other government bodies on filings, registrations, certificates and inquiries, some of which need regular follow-up.
  • Compliance calendar. Own the global entity compliance calendar. Know what is due, where and when, and flag it early rather than relying on a service provider's reminder.
  • Directors, officers and authority. Track director and officer appointments and resignations, maintain signature and delegation of authority records, and prepare powers of attorney, incumbency certificates and secretary's certificates. Keep internal systems current and make sure the people who need to know about a change in signing authority are told.
  • Portfolio rationalization. Review the legacy and dormant entities we hold, including those that came in through acquisitions. Form a view on which should be maintained, consolidated or wound down, then carry out the plan.

Corporate records and governance

  • Corporate records. Maintain minute books, statutory registers, organizational charts and entity records worldwide, in physical and electronic form, so the portfolio stays audit-ready.
  • Governance documents. Draft board and stockholder resolutions, written consents, minutes for subsidiary matters, and organizational documents such as articles, bylaws and operating agreements, in support of routine governance matters and corporate transactions, for attorney review.
  • Document requests. Turn around internal and external requests for certificates of good standing, certified copies, apostilles and legalizations. These usually block something, so speed matters.

KYC and due diligence support

  • Incoming requests. Respond to and manage Know Your Customer (KYC), Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) and related diligence requests from banks, financial partners, customers and other stakeholders.
  • Supporting documentation. Compile and maintain the entity ownership, formation and governance documentation those requests rely on.

Working with Finance, Tax and People

Entity decisions are rarely made by Legal alone, so a large share of this role is coordination.

  • Tax. Support tax-driven entity changes, restructurings and intercompany arrangements, and provide the corporate approvals, resolutions and records they require.
  • Finance and Treasury. Support statutory audits, bank account openings and closures, and signatory changes. Supply the entity data behind financial reporting and audit requests.
  • People. Work with the People team when we open in a new country. That covers employer registrations, local entity setup and the corporate steps that have to happen before anyone can be hired or paid.
  • Across the company. Be the reliable answer when Procurement, Sales, Real Estate or anyone else needs to know which entity to use, or how Datadog is structured.

Systems, data and process

  • Diligent Entities. Own Diligent Entities as our system of record, covering data integrity, configuration and reporting. You will be the internal expert who trains others on it.
  • Data quality. Run periodic audits of entity records, fix records where the data has drifted, and get the register to a point where it can be trusted without a manual check.
  • Process. Build and maintain the trackers, workflows and standard operating procedures the function runs on, and document them well enough that someone else can pick them up.
  • Automation and AI. Work with the wider Legal Operations team to automate the repetitive parts of entity work, and help assess where AI tools earn their place, both here and elsewhere in the department. Entity management is full of high-volume, rules-based work, which makes it a good place to test them. No prior AI experience is needed. Curiosity and judgment about where AI does and does not belong matter more.

Securities support

Supporting work, learnable on the job, performed for and supervised by our Associate General Counsel, Corporate & Securities.

  • Section 16. Prepare, file and track Forms 3, 4 and 5 for our Section 16 officers and directors, and maintain the supporting ownership records.
  • Forms 144 and 10b5-1. Prepare and file Forms 144 and administer the mechanics of Rule 10b5-1 plan adoptions, modifications and terminations.
  • Entity data for reporting. Supply the entity information behind our periodic SEC filings, including the subsidiary list filed with the Form 10-K.
  • Board support. Support board and committee matters as needed. Board and committee administration sits with our Corporate & Securities group.

Your team and the wider function

  • Your direct report. Manage, develop and set priorities for one Corporate Paralegal, and bring them along on the entity work as you standardize it.
  • Shared services. Legal Operations runs as a shared services team. You will be cross-trained across other Legal Operations workstreams, and colleagues will be cross-trained into entity work, so the team can cover for each other and hold consistent standards.

Who you are

What we need

  • Seven or more years of hands-on entity management experience, with substantial time on a multi-jurisdictional portfolio, whether in-house at a multinational, at a law firm or at a corporate services provider.
  • Practical experience with entity formation and ongoing maintenance in multiple countries, including foreign qualification, good standing, annual filings, registered agents and local statutory requirements.
  • Direct experience dealing with government agencies, company registries and regulators on corporate filings. You have chased a registry, fixed a rejected filing, and learned how long these things take.
  • A track record of working with internal partners outside Legal, such as Finance, Tax and People, where the work only lands if the coordination is good.
  • Proficiency with an entity management platform. We use Diligent Entities. If you have used a comparable system and will become an expert in ours, that works too.
  • Strong document and spreadsheet skills. Legal and Finance work in Word and Excel, and Excel in particular carries a lot of the tracking and reporting in this role. The rest of the company runs on Google Workspace, so you will use both.
  • Drafting skills for corporate governance documents such as resolutions, consents, certificates and minutes.
  • Comfort with the local mechanics of an international portfolio, such as nominee and minority shareholder arrangements, local director requirements and statutory filings that vary by jurisdiction.
  • Organization and attention to detail, and the capacity to hold a high volume of deadlines at once.
  • Judgment about what you handle, what you flag and what you escalate, and the confidence to escalate early.
  • Experience managing or mentoring a junior colleague.
  • Willingness to learn the securities reporting side of the role and to hold those deadlines once trained.
  • Willingness to be cross-trained more broadly across Legal Operations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with outside counsel, registered agents and service providers in many countries and time zones.
  • A bachelor's degree, an associate degree or a paralegal certificate from an ABA-approved program. If you have none of these, we will consider equivalent relevant experience.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to Section 16, Forms 144, Rule 10b5-1 administration or public company reporting.
  • Implementing or migrating an entity management system, or materially improving the data quality of an existing one.
  • Rationalizing a legacy entity portfolio by consolidating or winding down dormant companies, including entities acquired through M&A.
  • Evaluating, piloting or rolling out legal technology or AI tools.
  • Supporting restricted party or sanctions screening.
  • Work at a multinational technology or SaaS company, or supporting one from a firm or service provider.
  • A notary public commission in New York, or willingness to obtain one.
  • Certification from NALA, the National Association of Legal Assistants (Certified Paralegal or Advanced Certified Paralegal), or from NFPA, the National Federation of Paralegal Associations (CORE Registered Paralegal or PACE Registered Paralegal).

If you are strong on the entity management core and lighter on some of the rest of the two lists above, we would still like to hear from you. We are hiring for depth in the part of this role that is hardest to teach.

descriptionHtml:
The Team

The APJ Enablement Team empowers our Sales, Customer Success, and Technical Solutions teams with the right information, skills, and tools throughout their tenure at Datadog in order to maximize their ability to land, expand, and drive Datadog’s next phase of growth across the region. We act as strategic partners to the APJ Leadership Team, ensuring they have the support they need to achieve their goals. We regionalize and contextualize global programs, custom-build regional programs, and provide just-in-time support in order to deliver quantifiable impact on go-to-market performance in APJ.

The Opportunity

Datadog continues to grow at a rapid rate and with this exciting growth, our onboarding and ongoing training is also quickly increasing in scale and complexity. This position is responsible for providing onboarding and ongoing enablement training/programs to all of our regional go-to-market teams. We are looking for a structured communicator with a knack for simplifying the complex to deliver the training content, curriculum, and programs that enable our sales people to be successful in their jobs.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Deliver engaging live and virtual enablement sessions for regional Sales and Customer Success teams, including onboarding, ongoing training, and reinforcement programs.
  • Conduct ongoing field listening (shadows, 1:1s, syncs with first-line leaders) to maintain a strong pulse on business needs, gaps, and strengths across APAC markets; share insights with the broader enablement team to shape programs and priorities.
  • Lead reinforcement and coaching to drive post-program adoption, including designing activities (role plays, deal clinics, skill practice sessions) that connect training to measurable behavior change in real, complex customer scenarios.
  • Partner with Curriculum, Program Management, and Operations to share field insights and pilot or co-build content, and work closely with first-line Sales leaders to build trusted relationships, diagnose challenges, and deliver ad hoc training in response to emerging needs.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate delivery and reinforcement — including synthesizing field feedback and surfacing patterns — and model effective AI use for the teams you train.

Who You Are:

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales enablement, field enablement, training, or a related GTM role, with a proven delivery track record supporting Sales and/or Customer Success teams in a SaaS or technology environment. 
  • Strong facilitator with experience delivering engaging live and virtual training sessions to senior, sophisticated audiences, and familiarity with sales methodologies/frameworks such as MEDDICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, Sandler, etc. (certification a plus).
  • Strong business acumen and comfort using performance data, field feedback, and qualitative insights to inform enablement decisions; experience with Asana or similar project management tools is a plus.
  • Foundational understanding of Datadog and/or the broader technology industry, including foundational knowledge of Datadog's core product pillars (Infrastructure, APM, Logs) and the ability to connect product capabilities to customer value.
  • Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented — you build trust quickly with sellers, managers, and cross-functional partners.
  • Organized, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently across a large, diverse region.
  • Willing and able to travel approximately 25% across APAC.

title: Manager I, Engineering - Reference Tables Access
descriptionHtml:
The Reference Tables Access team owns the UI, MCP, APIs, and control plane that customers use to bring external data into Datadog. Reference Tables lets them use their own reference data to enrich and filter observability data without leaving the platform. The team also owns the table identity, metadata, permissions, quotas, validation, and lifecycle services behind these experiences.

Beyond the current product, the team is developing a consistent tabular abstraction that product teams can use without needing to manage the details of the underlying storage systems. This abstraction supports use cases from log enrichment and security to emerging analytical workflows built on Datadog’s internal Data Lake (ADP Lakehouse).

We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader to guide the team’s roadmap and develop these capabilities into a reliable platform. This role will shape how Datadog teams manage and build product experiences on top of tabular data.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with product managers and staff engineers to define and drive the team’s technical direction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to shape the team’s roadmap and contribute to the broader organization’s technical direction.
  • Establish and uphold engineering best practices, ensuring consistency and quality.
  • Mentor and coach engineers, supporting their career growth and development.
  • Foster an inclusive and collaborative team culture.

Who You Are:

  • Technically adept, with a strong foundation in large-scale distributed systems and/or customer-facing platform development. You can dive deep into technical details in code and designs when needed.
  • A problem solver at heart, eager to take on complex technical challenges with confidence and experience.
  • An engineering leader, skilled in prioritization, escalation, and clear communication, helping teams make progress through ambiguity.

title: Information Security Analyst II - Federal Programs
descriptionHtml:
As an Information Security Analyst II for the Federal Programs team, you will support efforts to respond to U.S. Government regulations and standards, including FedRAMP Rev. 5, FedRAMP 20x, NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, the DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (CC SRG), and applicable Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) , as applicable. You will provide subject matter expertise for the design, implementation, operations, management, and maintenance of the Datadog product in all aspects of Information Assurance and Information Security as it relates to Datadog’s Federal Programs activities. This includes being able to assess and mitigate system security threats and risks, validate system security requirements, analyze and collaborate on system security designs, verify compliance with system security requirements, manage the complete internal and external assessment and audit lifecycle, testing, and act as a liaison with other departments and business units to support ongoing system security operations and maintenance. You will evaluate the suitability of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-backed products for Federal regulated industry customers and you will leverage AI to build automations which will allow Datadog to demonstrate compliance with current and future requirements.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do: (Describe role responsibilities here)

  • Support security efforts in pursuit of U.S. Government certifications and accreditations (FedRAMP, GovRAMP, Cloud Computing SRG).
  • Document Datadog practices to provide transparency to customers, prospects and other stakeholders.
  • Communicate directly with Datadog customers, prospects and other stakeholders.
  • Work across security and engineering teams to design, implement, and monitor security and compliance features.
  • Support assessment and continuous monitoring and reporting activities.
  • Engage with external stakeholders (auditors, regulators, customers) to clearly explain Datadog’s compliance posture
  • Design and maintain defensive policies that allow the Datadog security and general engineering teams to move quickly and adapt to an evolving threat landscape.
  • Synthesize complex customer documents (MSAs, Security Addendums, etc.) into concrete requirements for the Datadog Engineering, Legal and Finance teams.
  • Use modern tooling to increase the capabilities and efficiency of existing compliance programs.

Who You Are: (Describe role qualifications here)

  • You have a BS and a minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience
  • You have a proven track record working in security policy, compliance, information security operations or security consulting
  • You have a strong understanding of cloud services architecture (Amazon Web Services)
  • You have demonstrable experience designing, supporting, advising, and assessing the implementation of security controls for a FedRAMP certified and/or DoD Impact Levels ⅘ authorized system. 
  • You have managed and/or implemented Federal continuous monitoring activities with external stakeholders
  • You have demonstrable experience partnering with stakeholder teams to implement standards and procedures that provide business value first while meeting control requirements
  • You have experience with implementing the Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide, STIGs, and working with Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS)

title: Senior Field Marketing Manager - Public Sector, Federal & Defense
descriptionHtml:
Datadog is looking for an experienced Senior Field Marketing Manager - Public Sector to own marketing strategy and execution for our U.S. Federal and Defense business. In this role, you will build and run an integrated, multi-channel field marketing program across Federal Civilian agencies, Federal Systems Integrators, the Department of War (DoW/DoD), and the Defense Industrial Base. 

This will span mission-focused events, executive briefings, account-based programs, and digital campaigns, in close partnership with Public Sector sales leadership.

The role is a full-funnel mandate with the latitude to prioritize the programs that move pipeline in a market where the buying cycle, the procurement path, and the compliance bar all look different from commercial tech.

Datadog for Government operates in a FedRAMP High-certified, AWS GovCloud (US) environment, with work underway toward DoD Impact Level 5. You will be the marketer who translates that platform and compliance story into mission language for program offices, CIOs, and the integrators who build for them.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Set the strategy for, and execute, the integrated Federal and Defense field marketing plan — aligned to Public Sector sales priorities, target agencies and programs, and pipeline goals. You will propose the pipeline target for this segment, not just deliver against one handed to you.
  • Build segment-specific program tracks for Federal Civilian, Federal Systems Integrator, DoW/DoD, and Defense Industrial Base audiences, recognizing that each buys on a different cycle and responds to different proof.
  • Own Datadog’s presence across the federal event calendar, from large-scale defense and civilian conferences to service association events, agency industry days, virtual events, and targeted executive gatherings.
  • Build the program formats that move federal buyers through the funnel — executive briefings, technical workshops, roundtables, and webinars — owning Federal and Defense field marketing budget, audience strategy, target account recruitment, and follow-through.
  • Work with Product Marketing to shape Federal-specific messaging and content: FedRAMP High, IL5 progress, data residency, U.S.-persons operations, continuous ATO, zero trust, and the compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53, CMMC, DISA STIGs) your audience is actually measured against.
  • Partner with Demand Generation on campaign strategy and execution. Adapt nurture tracks and email motions for a federal audience, manage lead flow and follow-up SLAs with sales, and tune programs based on funnel performance You bring the market context that makes a central campaign land with the audience, and you own stage-over-stage conversion for the segment.
  • Raise the bar for the wider field marketing team — mentor less experienced marketers, and bring federal market expertise back into how the broader org plans.

Who You Are:

  • 6+ years of field marketing experience in B2B SaaS, including 4+ years marketing to the U.S. Federal government, with a demonstrated track record of driving pipeline for a public sector segment or business unit.
  • Direct experience with Defense buyers — DoW/DoD services and combatant commands, or the Federal Systems Integrator and Defense Industrial Base firms that serve them.
  • Fluent in the federal buying cycle: appropriations and fiscal-year dynamics, contract vehicles (GSA, SEWP, CIO-SP, GWACs), the role of resellers and integrators, and how an ATO actually gets granted.
  • Proven experience planning and executing large-scale federal events, executive forums, and sponsored trade shows.
  • Comfortable with the technical subject matter — observability, cloud, DevSecOps, or cybersecurity — and tune messaging that holds up with a technical federal audience.
  • Experience with account-based marketing against named agencies and programs.
  • Experience owning a program budget and reporting against a pipeline number you are accountable for.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with strong executive presence, and a track record of influencing sales leadership and driving alignment across marketing functions.
  • A self-starter who makes confident decisions without a playbook in front of you, and who is comfortable being handed an ambiguous goal and coming back with the plan.
  • Hands-on with Salesforce, marketing automation, ABM platforms, and attribution tooling.
  • U.S. citizenship required.
  • Based in or willing to relocate to the Washington, D.C. metro area, with willingness to travel roughly 40% for events.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
  • Continuous career development and pathing opportunities
  • Employee-focused best in class onboarding
  • Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program
  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

title: Immigration and Mobility Program Lead
descriptionHtml:
This role supports Datadog's immigration and employee mobility programs across the Americas, helping employees and new hires navigate immigration processes, work authorization requirements, and relocations. You'll partner with employees, Recruiting, People teams, Legal, and external providers to deliver consistent, compliant, and employee-focused support. You'll also maintain accurate program data, coordinate time-sensitive cases, and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency. As our programs evolve, you'll have opportunities to strengthen processes, improve the employee experience, and contribute to scalable immigration and mobility operations.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage day-to-day immigration processes across the Americas, partnering with employees, candidates, internal stakeholders, and external counsel to coordinate employment-based immigration cases, work authorization, renewals, and filings.
  • Coordinate U.S. immigration programs, including H-1B cap submissions, F-1, TN, E-3, O-1, J-1, permanent residence, and related processes, while supporting I-9 reverification and immigration compliance requirements.
  • Manage domestic and international relocation programs for new hires and internal transfers, coordinating vendors, employee communications, eligibility, cost estimates, and policy exceptions.
  • Partner with Recruiting, Legal, Payroll, Tax, Finance, Benefits, and People teams to address immigration and relocation requirements, resolve escalations, and support employees throughout their mobility experience.
  • Maintain accurate immigration and mobility records in Workday, monitor critical deadlines, conduct data audits, and develop reporting to track program activity, costs, compliance, and operational effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with external providers and internal stakeholders to monitor regulatory developments, maintain process documentation, and identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale immigration and mobility programs.

Who You Are:

  • You have at least six years of relevant experience in Human Resources, People Operations, immigration, global mobility, or a related field, including at least two years directly managing employment-based immigration processes.
  • You have hands-on experience supporting immigration and employee relocation programs, with strong working knowledge of U.S. employment-based immigration processes, including H-1B, F-1, TN, E-3, O-1, J-1, and permanent residence.
  • You understand the operational, tax, payroll, and compliance considerations associated with domestic and international employee relocations.
  • You have experience partnering with immigration counsel, relocation providers, and cross-functional teams to manage cases, resolve issues, and deliver a supportive employee experience.
  • You communicate complex processes clearly, manage competing priorities with sound judgment, and maintain accurate, confidential records while navigating time-sensitive requirements.
  • You use data to monitor program performance and recommend improvements, with experience supporting immigration or mobility processes in Latin America considered a plus.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

title: Manager I, Engineering - Agent Data Plane
descriptionHtml:
The Agent Data Plane team is building the next foundation for the Datadog Agent: a new Rust-based platform for the telemetry pipelines (logs, metrics, traces, checks, and more) that run on our customers' infrastructure. Designed for performance, a small and predictable resource footprint, and resiliency, Agent Data Plane will take over the Agent's existing Go-based data pipelines. See a recent episode of Datadog On to hear more about the origins of this project from its technical lead: Datadog On: Return of Rust.

As the team's first dedicated Engineering Manager, you'll guide a team of five engineers, partner closely with the project's technical lead, and help other Agent teams build their pipelines on the platform. Your work will lower the cost customers pay to run the Agent, reduce Datadog's own infrastructure costs, and make the Agent's performance and reliability a lasting competitive advantage. This is also a very public evolution of the Agent's architecture: the codebase is open source, and the work lends itself to technical blog posts and conference talks. As the Agent organization grows, you'll have the opportunity to take on broader scope and grow into the next level of engineering management.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of five engineers across Madrid and the US, ranging from early-career to senior, helping each of them build their impact and career
  • Own planning and delivery for Agent Data Plane, including the phased migration of the Datadog Agent's data pipelines from Go to Rust
  • Build strong relationships with the teams that own the logs, metrics, traces, and checks pipelines built on Agent Data Plane, as well as the APM Agent team, aligning priorities and working through competing requests
  • Evolve Agent Data Plane into a true platform that other teams can build on with minimal support, while staying consistent with the project's architecture and goals
  • Partner with the technical lead and senior engineers on design decisions, bringing your own technical judgment to performance, resource usage, and reliability tradeoffs
  • Represent the team in cross-team and technical discussions, and help shape the team's new on-call rotation

Who You Are:

  • You have 2+ years of experience managing software engineering teams
  • You have a strong individual contributor background (typically 5+ years) and the technical depth to earn the trust of senior engineers, including those who know more about the details than you do
  • You have 2+ years of hands-on systems programming experience in a language such as Rust, C++, Go, or C
  • You've owned systems that other teams or customers depend on, and you've guided your team through incidents when things broke
  • You've led a team through a significant migration or the replacement of widely used technology, communicating clearly with the teams affected

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Rust
  • Experience building software that runs on customer infrastructure, such as agents or collectors, rather than internal services
  • Experience on a platform team whose work other teams build on
  • Experience with open source software, such as working with external contributors and maintaining public repositories

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)
  • Access to Inclusion Talks, our internal panel discussions
  • Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+
  • Competitive global benefits

title: Senior Product Manager, Chat, Video, and Collaboration Integrations
descriptionHtml:
As the Senior Product Manager for Chat, Video and Collaboration Integrations, you will own and lead the development of integrations that connect Datadog with the tools engineers use every day, such as Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, Zoom, Google Meet, ServiceNow, Jira and Linear. You will ensure that teams can receive alerts and notifications, collaborate in channels and meetings, take action on Datadog data, and manage tickets with bi-directional syncing between Datadog and external platforms.

Products across Datadog, including Incident Response, Security, Alerting, and Bits AI, use these integrations to meet teams in their existing workflows. Linking these tools with Datadog streamlines communication, accelerates issue resolution, and enhances system visibility.  These integrations also support Datadog’s agentic initiatives by giving agents like Bits AI real time context from Slack, Teams, meetings, and tickets, enabling them to understand events and act where teams work.

We are looking for an experienced product manager who will engage with some of the world's leading tech organizations, as well as our partners, to gain a deep understanding of their chat and collaboration needs. You will set the vision for the platform, drive the development of new capabilities, including agentic workflows grounded in real-time context, and identify new integrations as customer needs evolve.

What You'll Do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Datadog's chat (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat), video (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams) and collaboration (ServiceNow, Jira, Linear and others) integrations, end-to-end.

  • Build integrations as a platform: frameworks, APIs and guidelines that let product teams across Datadog ship great chat, video and collaboration experiences without starting from scratch.

  • Standardize how Datadog issues and tickets sync bi-directionally across external work management systems like ServiceNow and Jira.

  • Integrate AI capabilities across collaboration tools using real-time contextual data from chats, meetings, and tickets to automate actions.

  • Deliver scalable enterprise management features, including identity mapping, administrative governance, and security controls.

  • Partner with PMs across Datadog to plan joint OKRs and decide where to invest each quarter.

  • Talk to customers constantly, from fast-moving startups to the largest enterprises. Turn what you learn into crisp PRDs, design partnerships and prioritized roadmaps.

  • Support Sales, Solutions and Customer Success on strategic deals and migrations, and equip them to sell the integration story.

  • Define and track adoption, engagement and revenue-influence metrics. Make roadmap bets and be ready to defend them.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience shipping technical B2B SaaS products, including ownership of a product area with multiple engineering teams.

  • Deep experience with integrations, platforms or developer-facing APIs, ideally on chat or collaboration surfaces (Slack, Microsoft Teams) or ITSM / work-management systems (ServiceNow, Jira).

  • A track record of driving roadmaps across organizational boundaries: aligning many stakeholders with competing needs without losing speed or focus.

  • Experience working with strategic technology partners, or a clear point of view on how to build partner relationships that move a product forward.

  • Strong technical depth: you can work through webhooks, sync models, auth, rate limits and AI/LLM trade-offs with engineers. You don't need to code, but you can go deep.

  • Enterprise instincts: you understand how large organizations run IT operations, and you've designed for their complexity without giving up simplicity for everyone else.

  • Experience (or genuine interest) in developer platforms, observability, incident response, ITSM, or AI-assisted and agentic product experiences.

  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication. You're comfortable presenting to executives, customers and partner leadership, on stage and in a working session.

  • A bias for action in ambiguity. This is a high-impact area where the roadmap is yours to shape.

Benefits and Growth

  • High income earning opportunities based on individual performance

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

  • Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message

  • Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

  • An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)

  • Free, global Spring Health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+, competitive global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

title: Senior UX Researcher, Core Pillars
descriptionHtml:
Datadog is looking for a Senior UX Researcher to shape strategically important products across Core Pillars. The researcher’s initial focus will be Agent Console, an emerging product area helping teams understand and improve the performance, usage, cost, reliability, and business value of AI agents. As priorities evolve, the role may support other product areas within Core Pillars.

You’ll establish a foundational understanding of our users while supporting product and design decisions happening today. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What you’ll do:

  • Build and own an ongoing research program across Core Pillars, beginning with Agent Console and spanning foundational discovery, product evaluation, and post-launch learning.
  • Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering to identify consequential decisions and conduct focused mixed-methods research using qualitative and quantitative evidence.
  • Develop a strong understanding of AI agents, complex technical workflows, and enterprise users so you can identify meaningful questions and engage credibly with customers and partners.
  • Develop a clear point of view from the evidence, influence product strategy and design, and remain involved through implementation and measurement.
  • Advance how research is practiced by using AI-assisted workflows, connecting qualitative insight with behavioral data, building reusable knowledge, and enabling partners to conduct focused research.

  • You can independently own a meaningful portfolio of research from opportunity identification through execution, decision-making, and follow-through.

title: Staff Product Manager, Metering and Attribution
descriptionHtml:
Revenue Engineering builds the platform that measures how customers use Datadog and turns that measurement into usage and cost data they can act on. Every product Datadog ships is metered here. Every customer who wants to see which team, service, or business unit drove their usage sees it through this layer.

As a Staff Product Manager for Metering and Cost Attribution, you will own product direction for that platform. You will set the standard for how usage is measured, attributed, and presented across Datadog.

The role starts with tagging: the mechanism customers use to attribute usage to owners inside their organization, and the foundation that cost allocation, chargeback, quotas, and governance build on. From there you will shape the metering capabilities that new pricing and packaging models draw on, and extend the platform's speed and scale as Datadog's portfolio grows. Over time you will own the vision and roadmap for a usage platform used by every team at Datadog and relied on by every customer.

The usage layer is the system of record for consumption, and it is what billing draws from. What you own is the path from usage events to billable output, along with the consumption models, cost attribution, and usage analytics that customers and their finance teams use to understand their spend. You will partner closely with the billing platform team across that boundary.

Usage and cost attribution reach across a broad portfolio of billable metrics, several regions, and customers organized into parent and child organizations and reseller hierarchies, and they surface in units and in dollars, in-app, through the API, and in agentic workflows. Designing for that range means making deliberate choices about granularity, timeliness, and flexibility, and holding those choices steady across the many teams that build on them.

This is a highly visible individual contributor role spanning several engineering teams, every product vertical that emits billable telemetry, and partners in Sales, Support, and Finance.

What You'll Do:

  • Set product direction for metering and attribution by defining the problems and outcomes that matter from usage events through billable output, holding a multi-quarter view of how the platform should evolve, and collaborating with multiple engineering teams to sequence work into phases that deliver clear customer value along the way.
  • Own the tagging model as a customer-facing product, giving customers a consistent way to define tags across every product, translating those tags into granular usage and cost breakdowns wherever they surface, and designing how customers adjust and reconstruct attribution when their tagging changes.
  • Define the metering and rating capabilities that pricing and packaging depend on, working ahead of launches on usage aggregation, unit definitions, commitments, included usage, and overage, so that the metering platform stays ahead of Datadog's commercial needs.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for metering and cost attribution across Datadog, setting the standard that product verticals build against when they bring a new SKU into usage attribution, aligning engineering, Cloud Cost Management, Support, Sales, and Finance on a single cost allocation model, and mentoring product managers taking on metering work in their own areas.
  • Own the quality standard for usage data, translating what customers need in accuracy, timeliness, and auditability into product requirements and service objectives, keeping measured usage, attribution, and billing consistent with one another, and producing the sizing and impact analysis that engineering leadership and pricing partners need to resource the work.
  • Build agentic capabilities on top of usage, surfacing an unexpected change in consumption early, explaining which teams and services drove it, and recommending what the customer can do next. Own the data contracts and interfaces that let agents across Datadog reason about usage.
  • Anticipate market movement in cost allocation and cost governance, tracking how FinOps practice, cloud provider primitives, and specialist vendors are evolving, shaping Datadog's investment in response, and engaging customers directly through preview programs, design partnerships, and industry forums.

Who You Are:

  • A strong systems thinker: you can follow cause and effect from telemetry intake through metering, aggregation, attribution, and the bill, you reason about unit economics and cost-to-serve alongside customer experience, and you hold the throughline as scope evolves across quarters.
  • Fluent in data models and pipelines: you are at home in the concepts that usage data depends on, including event pipelines, usage aggregation, cardinality, deduplication, backfills, and processing latency, and you understand how they shape what a customer can be shown.
  • A cross-org synthesizer: you read across engineering teams, Support, Sales, Finance, and product verticals, and turn diffuse signals into a defensible product position.
  • Rigorous about quality: you treat accuracy in usage and cost data as a product standard you personally own, and you know how to balance investment in quality with new capability.
  • Collaborative and opinionated: you build trust quickly with engineers, PM peers, designers, and commercial partners, you influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, and you adapt when new evidence emerges.
  • Experienced in product management: you have 8+ years of Product Management experience, or a track record showing Staff-level capabilities in related software roles, with significant ownership of complex technical products. You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and breadth in platform work where the scope shapes itself over multiple quarters.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with high-cardinality telemetry and the cost and pricing tradeoffs it creates.
  • Experience with usage-based or consumption-based monetization, including metering, rating, and cost allocation.
  • Familiarity with usage-based billing infrastructure such as Metronome, Orb, m3ter, Amberflo, Zuora, or Stripe Billing, or with FinOps tooling such as CloudZero, Vantage, or Finout.
  • Experience owning a platform capability consumed by many internal product teams, including the adoption and onboarding motion that goes with it.
  • Experience with pricing and packaging, and comfort reasoning about margin and cost-to-serve alongside a packaging change.
  • Exposure to the FinOps Foundation framework or the FOCUS specification, and to chargeback, showback, and tag governance at enterprise scale.

Benefits and Growth:

  • High income earning opportunities based on individual performance

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

  • Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

  • Free, global Spring Health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+, competitive global benefits

title: Video Script Writer
descriptionHtml:
The Technical Content team is looking for a Technical Video Writer to create practitioner-focused videos that make complex technical concepts clear, engaging, and useful. You’ll develop scripts and narratives that show customers how to get more from our products across formats, including technical explainers, feature roundups, podcast-style conversations, and new video concepts.

You’ll bring a strong sense of visual storytelling and hands-on knowledge of video production to the scripting process, thinking beyond the words on the page to how a story will come together on screen. Working closely with our video team, motion graphics animators, and technical experts, you’ll develop new topics and formats, translate technical details into compelling stories, and ensure every piece is clear, accurate, and relevant to practitioners.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace, in the office three days per week, to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders—including video producers, product managers, product marketing managers, technical advocacy, and engineers—to create project briefs, outlines, storyboards, and scripts for original videos.
  • Write companion content, including YouTube descriptions, blog posts, and social content.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate outlining, research, and development workflows.
  • Identify relevant visual elements and record precise, high-quality screen captures of Datadog products and features.
  • Ensure content is technically accurate, reflects Datadog’s voice and tone, and clearly communicates customer value.
  • Support post-production tasks, including video editing, sound mixing, and closed captioning.

Who You Are:

  • You have a talent for video storytelling, demonstrated through writing samples and a portfolio of past work.
  • You have hands-on video editing experience and proficiency with video editing software such as Premiere or Final Cut Pro, motion graphics tools such as AfterEffects, and AI tools to support video editing.
  • You are comfortable with taking initiative and managing multiple concurrent projects with limited supervision.

title: Incident and Escalations Manager 2 - NYC
descriptionHtml:
The Incident and Escalation Management team (IEM) is part of Datadog's Global Support Engineering (GSE) organization. IEM exists to continuously improve Datadog's overall customer experience during incidents and other critical moments. We're looking for experts with a background in incident management and escalation handling to provide fast incident response, clear ownership, and calm, confident communication for our global customer base.

In this individual contributor role, you will play a key part in customer communication, technical engagement, and incident management for our global customers. You will also implement processes and automations, use the same incident and case management tools we build for our customers, and help shape how they evolve.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture — the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive incidents and escalations to resolution from start to finish, including triage, coordination with our support, engineering and product teams. Own the response and keep customers and internal teams informed throughout.
  • Independently coordinate cross-functional stakeholders through complex incidents and escalations, making the call on prioritization, response strategy, and when to pull in additional teams or leadership.
  • Own communications during active incidents, including sensitive, large-scale, and publicly visible events, adapting the message for customers, internal teams, and leadership.
  • Lead projects that deliver operational improvements to how IEM detects, manages, and communicates during incidents and escalations as Datadog and its products evolve.
  • Create, maintain, and improve incident and escalation documentation, runbooks, and training materials, and lead retrospectives that turn individual incidents into durable process change.
  • Mentor peers on incident and escalation management best practices, and contribute to interviewing and hiring.
  • Design and implement real-time and proactive monitoring of customer infrastructure to surface customer-impacting risks before they escalate.
  • Identify recurring cloud infrastructure and product issues across incidents and escalations, and partner with Engineering to feed findings back and reduce recurrence.

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of related professional experience, including experience in incident management and customer escalations, with demonstrable ownership of complex incidents and critical customer situations; experience in a SaaS, cloud, or observability environment is a plus
  • 2+ years of experience in a hands-on technical role at a software or cloud company, such as Support Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a similar technical function
  • Strong familiarity with cloud computing and modern software architectures; scripting ability in Python, JavaScript, or shell is a plus
  • Ability to correlate behaviors across known system interdependencies, assess customer and technical impact, and make sound decisions while remaining calm in high-pressure and ambiguous situations

title: Senior Video Editor
descriptionHtml:
Datadog is the observability and security platform for cloud applications. Engineers at tens of thousands of companies use us to understand what their systems are doing in real time. We are a public company with the pace and ambition of a much smaller one, and we build products for a technical audience that has very little patience for marketing fluff.

We are hiring a Senior Video Editor to join our video team and own video end to end — from concept and script through edit, motion, color, and final delivery. You will work across two kinds of content: brand and marketing video (campaigns, customer stories, event films, social and paid cutdowns) and product and technical video (launch films, feature demos, release explainers, conference keynote support).

You will partner closely with brand designers, product marketing, developer relations, and the events team. You will also help develop AI tools to speed up the pipeline. 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Cut brand and product video from raw footage to final delivery in Premiere Pro, working across multiple active projects and deadlines.
  • Script and storyboard your own pieces — take a rough brief or a product demo and shape it into a story with a clear arc before a single clip is on the timeline.
  • Create motion graphics as projects require — lower thirds, UI callouts, titles, and simple data visualizations — in After Effects, and build supporting illustration and vector assets in Illustrator.
  • Color grade in DaVinci Resolve Studio, including conform, node-based grading, and matching shots across multi-camera and mixed-source footage.
  • Prep, retouch, and composite stills and textures in Photoshop for use in motion work and thumbnails.
  • Use AI-assisted tools in production — transcript-based rough cuts, auto-reframe, speech enhancement, rotoscoping and masking, generative fill and extend, upscaling — and tell us honestly which ones earn their place in the workflow.
  • Deliver versioned cutdowns and aspect-ratio variants for YouTube, LinkedIn, paid social, event screens, and the Datadog website, with correct specs every time.
  • Keep projects organized: clean bins, consistent naming, archived masters, and handoff files a teammate can actually open and finish.
  • Set and defend the quality bar — give direction to freelancers where necessary and review their work.

Who You Are:

  • 6+ years of professional video editing experience, with a reel that shows both narrative/brand work and clear, well-structured technical or product content.
  • Advanced Premiere Pro — multicam, nested sequences, proxy workflows, dynamic link, Essential Graphics templates, and the keyboard-driven speed that comes from years in the application.
  • Highly Competent in After Effects — expressions, shape layers, 2D/3D camera work, motion tracking, and original graphic and illustration design rather than template assembly.
  • Highly Competent in Illustrator and Photoshop — you create assets from scratch, not just resize them.
  • Hands-on color grading in DaVinci Resolve Studio — primaries and secondaries, power windows, LUT and color-space management, and delivery-safe output.
  • Proven ability to script and storyboard: you can write a VO, structure a demo, and pitch a board before production starts.
  • Demonstrated ability to edit highly technical content in an engaging way through product screens. 
  • Familiarity with developer tooling, cloud infrastructure, or observability concepts.
  • Active, practical use of AI tools in an editing workflow, with a clear point of view on where they help, where they fall apart, and how to use them without compromising quality or accuracy.
  • Strong audio instincts — mix, music selection, dialogue cleanup, and knowing when silence is the right choice.
  • Comfortable working on technical subject matter and willing to learn enough about the product to cut it accurately.
  • Self-directed and unfazed by shifting priorities, short turnarounds, and simultaneous projects.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience filming — camera operation, lighting, and location or studio audio.
  • Live event and conference production experience, including keynote playback and show graphics.
  • 3D work in Cinema 4D, Blender, or Element 3D.
  • Experience building reusable motion systems and Essential Graphics templates for other teams to use.

title: Manager I, Engineering - Zero Trust Networking
descriptionHtml:
Fabric Zero Trust Networking builds the infrastructure that makes secure service connectivity the default across Datadog. Our team develops workload-identity, authorization, network-segmentation, and egress-control mechanisms that help protect customer data while keeping our production platform reliable and efficient. As an engineering manager, you'll grow a team of engineers, shape its roadmap alongside technical leaders, and drive adoption across Datadog's infrastructure. You'll work at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and security, turning complex requirements into platforms that other engineers can use confidently.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers, creating clear expectations, ownership, and career-development opportunities.
  • Partner with senior engineers to set technical direction and deliver a roadmap for secure service connectivity and least-privilege network access.
  • Lead development and adoption of identity-based authorization, TLS/mTLS enforcement, network-segmentation mechanisms, and egress controls.
  • Make security capabilities straightforward to adopt through secure defaults, clear policy abstractions, migration tooling, and useful diagnostics.
  • Maintain high standards for reliability, performance, and safe production rollouts, including testing, observability, and incident learning.
  • Collaborate with Fabric, Security, and production-infrastructure partners to align priorities and deliver improvements across teams.

Who You Are: 

  • You have built and operated distributed systems, backend infrastructure, or internal platforms in production.
  • You communicate clearly, build productive cross-team relationships, and have experience working with engineers across multiple locations and time zones. 
  • You understand networking and security fundamentals and are interested in building the mechanisms that enforce security on production traffic.
  • You have led complex infrastructure changes or migrations with a thoughtful approach to adoption, compatibility, and rollout safety.
  • You combine technical curiosity with pragmatic judgment and care about making platforms reliable, secure, and easy to use.
  • You have experience leading software engineers and helping them grow through coaching and feedback.

title: Technical Escalations Engineer 2 (Web Platform)
descriptionHtml:
As Datadog’s in-house product experts, the Technical Escalation Engineering (TEE) team plays a critical role in driving our global success. We enable our customers, from the world’s most innovative startups to the largest enterprises.

Through deep technical expertise, relentless problem-solving, and exceptional customer engagement, we educate, guide, and troubleshoot, delivering high-impact solutions that shape the customer experience. Whether through hands-on technical call, in-depth fact findings meeting, or complex investigations, we set the gold standard for technical excellence and customer advocacy.

As part of our TEE team, you’ll tackle the most challenging technical problems, collaborate directly with Engineering and Product to refine and evolve our platform, and mentor teams worldwide, elevating the technical bar at every level.

As part of the Technical Escalation Engineering (TEE) team, you’ll operate at the heart of Datadog’s ecosystem, working at the intersection of Technical Solutions, Engineering, Product, and our Customers. Every challenge you take on will directly impact the performance, scalability, and success of both our clients and our platform. You’ll be in an environment that moves fast, challenges you daily, and rewards curiosity, ownership, and technical excellence.

This is your chance to shape the future of observability and security, driving innovation, mentoring teams, and influencing product direction while witnessing your expertise make an immediate and lasting impact. 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop deep technical expertise and continuously learn as the product evolves.
  • Investigate complex escalations, lead high-stakes technical calls, and drive solutions for our most critical customer challenges with urgency and precision.
  • Run engaging office hours, deliver impactful learning sessions, and mentor the Global Support Engineering team (GSE), ensuring they’re equipped to handle any challenge.
  • Partner with Engineering and Product to proactively identify gaps, drive improvements, and advocate for customers in shaping the evolution of our platform.
  • Become the go-to expert for the Web Platform experience at Datadog, owning investigations across authentication, authorization, identity, enterprise administration, and the full visualization stack of our graphing features (e.g. dashboards, notebooks, sheets, DDSQL)
  • Handle complex escalations related to login failures, broken dashboards, permission mismatches, audit discrepancies, and visualization bugs.

descriptionHtml:

As Datadog’s in-house product experts, the Technical Escalation Engineering (TEE) team plays a critical role in driving our global success. We enable our customers, from the world’s most innovative startups to the largest enterprises.

Through deep technical expertise, relentless problem-solving, and exceptional customer engagement, we educate, guide, and troubleshoot, delivering high-impact solutions that shape the customer experience. As part of our TEE team, you’ll tackle the most challenging technical problems, collaborate directly with Engineering and Product to refine and evolve our platform, and mentor teams worldwide, elevating the technical bar at every level.

Role Summary

As part of the Technical Escalation Engineering (TEE) team, you’ll operate at the heart of Datadog’s ecosystem, working at the intersection of Technical Solutions, Engineering, Product, and our Customers. Every challenge you take on will directly impact the performance, scalability, and success of both our clients and our platform. You’ll be in an environment that moves fast, challenges you daily, and rewards curiosity, ownership, and technical excellence.

This is your chance to shape the future of observability and security, driving innovation, mentoring teams, and influencing product direction while witnessing your expertise make an immediate and lasting impact.

title: Manager I, Engineering - Client SDKs (Mobile & Browser)
descriptionHtml:
Datadog's client SDKs run inside our customers' mobile apps and websites, and every Datadog client-side product depends on them, including Real User Monitoring, Session Replay, Product Analytics, and Feature Flags. We maintain 11 open source SDKs across Browser, iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, Unity, and more. 

As the Engineering Manager for Client SDKs, you'll build and lead the team that makes it easy for any team at Datadog to ship into those SDKs safely: fast CI, predictable releases, a shared spec across SDKs, and tooling that lets engineers and coding agents contribute without waiting on a review queue. It's a rare chance to own a developer platform that ships in public, at a scale where small decisions reach a lot of customers, and to shape how Datadog builds client-side products in the AI-native era. Both the team and its scope are expanding, so there's plenty of room to grow.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Build, lead, and grow a team of mostly senior software engineers, hiring well and helping senior and staff engineers grow their impact and careers

  • Own CI and test infrastructure across the SDK repositories: set health targets, detect and quarantine flaky tests, and provide test frameworks that engineers and coding agents can run locally

  • Define release cadences and help customers adopt updates, managing breaking changes in SDKs that can't be rolled back once they're installed in customers' apps

  • Keep SDKs consistent through a shared specification, and remove the review bottleneck so product teams can ship SDK changes without waiting on a small group of experts

  • Partner with product teams such as Session Replay, Product Analytics, and Feature Flags, along with our SDK guilds and server SDK teams, to guide SDK changes from design to release

  • Build feature sets for new product capabilities and bring that to all partner teams

  • Bring AI coding agents into how the team builds, tests, and ships, and take part in business-hours release, hotfix, and support escalation duty (no 24/7 pager)

Who You Are:

  • Experienced in managing a team of software engineers, including senior engineers

  • Someone who has shipped and maintained SDKs, libraries, or developer tools that other engineers depend on

  • Strong in at least one of Mobile Platforms, including iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin) , or Browser (TypeScript), and able to hold a technical conversation about applications development.

  • Knowledgeable in release engineering, CI/CD, versioning, and backwards compatibility

  • Able to influence other teams without formal authority and build alignment across product teams

Nice to Have:

  • Open source maintainer experience, especially working with outside contributors

  • Experience with observability, crash reporting, analytics, or OpenTelemetry SDKs

  • Familiarity with cross-platform frameworks such as React Native, Flutter, or Kotlin Multiplatform

  • Experience leading a platform or developer experience team

  • Experience using AI coding agents in your team's workflow

title: Senior AI Research Engineer - LLM Training & Inference Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to build the systems that run large-scale LLM training, reinforcement learning, and inference at Datadog. You will build and operate an in-house distributed runtime that schedules work across large GPU clusters, and you will own how quickly researchers can iterate and how reliably long training runs complete. 

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security. 

The Frontier Foundations team builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas: 

Trained Agents for Observability -- Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost. 

What You'll Do: 

  • Design, build, and operate distributed training and inference infrastructure for large language models, including Mixture-of-Experts models 
  • Scale training with parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, and expert), memory optimization, checkpointing, and failure recovery
  • Build inference and rollout systems that support evaluation, experimentation, and RL without slowing down training
  • Build execution environments and sandboxes for online RL and agent post-training
  • Own continuous performance validation: regular benchmarks of rollout speed, training throughput, and learning behavior, with dashboards that make regressions visible 
  • Improve the researcher experience: job submission, scheduling, quotas, GPU utilization, and observability
  • Work with platform teams on cluster capacity, networking, and scheduling across GPU providers 
  • Investigate performance and reliability problems across hardware, software, and distributed systems 

Who You Are:

  • You have depth in distributed systems and ML infrastructure for training and inference at scale; experience with Ray, Kubernetes, Slurm, or similar frameworks is a plus
  • You are proficient in Python and in at least one systems language (e.g., Rust, C++, or Go) ● You have experience operating large-scale training or serving infrastructure, or schedulers and orchestration systems for GPU or other high-performance workloads
  • You understand what limits throughput/latency in distributed inference workloads: communication, memory, scheduling, and stragglers
  • You have strong debugging, profiling, and incident-diagnosis skills, ideally including on-call experience 
  • You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences 
  • Prior experience training machine learning models is valuable but not essential for engineers with strong distributed systems or HPC backgrounds 

Bonus Points (any of the following): 

  • You are familiar with distributed training frameworks such as Megatron-LM, TorchTitan, or DeepSpeed
  • You have experience with LLM inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang, including batching and KV-cache management 
  • You have experience with RL training systems and rollout infrastructure 
  • You have experience with collective communication (NCCL), RDMA, or low-latency networking 
  • You have experience with GPU benchmarking, profiling, and cluster performance monitoring 
  • You have experience building sandboxed code execution or large-scale evaluation infrastructure 
  • You have contributed to open-source ML or distributed systems projects 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior AI Research Engineer - GPU Systems & Kernels
descriptionHtml:
As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to make large-scale model training and inference as fast and efficient as the hardware allows. You will work at the lowest level of our stack, writing and tuning GPU kernels and removing the memory and communication bottlenecks that limit large Mixture-of-Experts models on the latest GPUs.

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security.

Frontier Foundations builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas:

Trained Agents for Observability - Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost.

What You'll Do:

  • Write, tune, and debug GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton, or similar) for the operations that dominate LLM training and inference.
  • Optimize for the latest NVIDIA GPU generations, including memory hierarchy, tensor cores, and low-precision formats such as FP8 and FP4
  • Reduce communication cost in distributed workloads (all-to-all, all-reduce) and overlap communication with compute across NVLink and across nodes
  • Profile end-to-end training and rollout workloads to identify whether they are compute-, memory-, or communication-bound, and quantify the headroom
  • Build benchmarks, profiling tools, and regression tests that guide optimization decisions
  • Collaborate with Research Scientists to turn new model architectures into efficient implementations
  • Explore emerging techniques such as low-precision training and serving, speculative decoding, and fused or persistent kernels

Who You Are:

  • You have depth in at least one of: GPU kernel development and optimization (CUDA or similar), low-latency communication and collective operations (e.g., RDMA, NCCL), or large-scale training infrastructure
  • You can reason about hardware constraints (memory, bandwidth, interconnect topology) and explain where a bottleneck is and how you would confirm it
  • You are proficient in a systems language (e.g., C++, Rust, or CUDA C) and in Python
  • You have strong debugging and profiling skills, including tools such as Nsight
  • You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Bonus Points (any of the following):

  • You have experience with Mixture-of-Experts models, expert parallelism, or sparse model inference
  • You are familiar with GPU communication libraries such as NCCL or NVSHMEM, and with compute/communication overlap
  • You have experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or similar kernel frameworks
  • You are familiar with distributed training frameworks such as Megatron-LM, TorchTitan, or DeepSpeed
  • You have built GPU-intensive systems in graphics, rendering, simulation, or scientific computing
  • You have contributed to open-source ML or systems infrastructure projects

title: Senior Sales Engineer - Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
仕事内容

日本の公共部門を担当するシニア・セールスエンジニアとして、中央省庁や政府機関、地方自治体、教育機関、その他の公共機関にとって信頼される技術アドバイザーの役割を担います。お客様のミッション上の優先事項、モダナイゼーション施策、運用上のリスクと技術ソリューションを結び付け、規制要件の厳しい環境における複雑な技術評価をリードします。また、ハイブリッド、オンプレミス、パブリッククラウド環境にまたがる案件の技術戦略を策定します。

ディスカバリーから意思決定に至るまで、技術評価プロセス全体を主体的に推進します。お客様のさまざまなステークホルダーに働きかけるとともに、システムインテグレーター、リセラー、テクノロジーパートナー、マネージドサービスプロバイダー、クラウドプロバイダーと連携します。既存の技術環境、調達プロセス、導入要件を整理しながら、製品・ソリューションの機能、前提条件、設計について正確かつ適切な期待値を設定し、お客様の意思決定を支援します。

Datadogでは、社員同士の関係性やコラボレーションを育み、新たな創造性を生み出すオフィスカルチャーを大切にしています。社員一人ひとりが自分に合ったワークライフハーモニーを実現できるよう、ハイブリッドな働き方を採用しています。

主な業務内容

  • アカウントエグゼクティブと連携して営業プロセスを推進し、PGからClosed Wonに至るまで、案件全体の技術戦略をリード・策定する
  • 営業サイクル全体を通じてディスカバリーを主導し、技術的な課題、ミッションおよび事業目標、意思決定基準、成功指標を明らかにする。そのうえで、適用されるセキュリティ、コンプライアンス、調達、導入要件を踏まえ、ソリューション戦略と測定可能なビジネス成果を策定する
  • 経営層を含む多様なステークホルダーに対し、プラットフォームの機能とお客様が目指す成果を結び付けた、説得力のある製品デモ、技術プレゼンテーション、ソリューションワークショップを実施する
  • RFI、RFP、提案書、アーキテクチャレビューにおける技術戦略および回答品質に責任を持つ。社内チームやパートナーと連携し、提案内容、依存関係、導入に関する前提条件が正確かつ適切な範囲で提示されるよう管理する
  • 技術評価（POV）をエンドツーエンドで主導する。ユースケースと要件の整理、競合を意識した成功基準の設定、公共機関およびパートナーのステークホルダーとの合意形成、明確なスケジュールと意思決定ポイントを含むプロジェクト計画の策定、リスクと依存関係の特定を行い、すべての関係者がプロセスに沿って役割を果たすよう推進する
  • 複数のステークホルダーが関与する環境において、技術的なチャンピオンを特定・育成・活用し、案件サイクル全体を通じてチャンピオンの育成と影響力向上に向けた体系的な計画を構築する
  • 体系化されたプロダクトおよびエンジニアリング向けフィードバックセッションに積極的に参加し、現場で得た知見や顧客ニーズの傾向をプロダクトマネジメントおよびエンジニアリングチームに共有することで、製品の方向性に貢献する
  • 活動内容、案件の進捗、お客様とのやり取りを関連システムに正確かつ最新の状態で記録し、オペレーショナルエクセレンスを推進する
  • Product、Support、GTMの各チームと連携し、技術面および組織面の障壁を特定して、お客様への影響が生じる前に主体的に解決する
  • 同僚へのメンタリング、ベストプラクティスの共有、再利用可能なアセットの作成を通じて、チームのイネーブルメントと地域全体におけるナレッジの拡大に貢献する

応募資格

  • セールスエンジニアリング、ソリューションエンジニアリング、またはエンタープライズ領域における技術的な顧客対応職の経験が7年以上ある方
  • 官公庁または地方自治体、教育機関、その他の公共機関を含む公共部門において、複雑な営業サイクルおよび技術評価をリードした経験がある方
  • 技術部門、ビジネス部門、経営層など、相手に応じてコミュニケーションを適切に調整し、影響力を発揮できる方
  • ハイブリッド環境、パブリッククラウド（AWS、Azure、GCP）、Kubernetes、APM／トレーシング、セキュリティ、開発者体験、オブザーバビリティに関する高度な知識・経験がある方
  • 幅広い相手に技術的な概念を分かりやすく説明できる、優れたコミュニケーション能力を有する方
  • 問題解決および顧客対応において、コンサルティブかつ成果志向のアプローチを取れる方
  • スピード感のある環境で、複数の案件や優先事項を同時に管理できる方
  • 同僚へのメンタリング、またはチームのイネーブルメント施策に貢献した経験がある方
  • AIツールを実務で活用し、その活用方法をチームや組織へ展開・拡大した実績がある方
  • 変化を前向きに受け入れ、好奇心を持って学び続ける成長志向を有する方
  • お客様対応のため、必要に応じて出張が可能な方

title: Manager I, Engineering - Observability Pipelines
descriptionHtml:
Observability Pipelines (OP) is Datadog's on-premise, vendor-agnostic telemetry pipeline product. As an Engineering Manager on the team, you'll own people management and engineering execution for one of OP's core missions, spanning areas like intelligence (a pipeline that decides on its own where every piece of data goes, and why), integrations (ingesting from and routing to the many source and destination systems customers rely on), streaming insights, cost control, or pipeline capabilities, reliability and scalability. You'll partner directly with Product to help shape the roadmap, and work closely with your peer EMs and senior ICs to define how OP operates and grows. This is an opportunity to build your management craft while having real influence over the technical direction of a fast-growing product area.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Own people management and engineering execution for a team of 5 engineers
  • Establish a strong operating rhythm for the team, and drive high standards for on-call rotations and incident response, reliability and release quality
  • Partner closely with Product Management on the roadmap, balancing product priorities with technical realities
  • Lead, coach, and grow the careers of engineers on your team

Who You Are: 

  • Experienced managing engineers directly, comfortable owning a team’s operating rhythm end-to-end, from planning through execution and stakeholder communication to incident and on-call ownership
  • Have a technical background in one or more of the following areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, systems programming or high-throughput data plane environments 
  • Strong product sensibility, and a track record for shipping. You enjoy working with Product on strategy and execution

Preferred Experience: 

  • Experience with high-performance or Rust-based data pipeline systems
  • Experience with on-premise or customer-installed software concepts

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 

Benefits and Growth:

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)
  • Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions
  • Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+
  • Competitive global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.
